5074.risks: Mild gastrointestinal upset in some individuals, risk of magnesium overdose if excessively consumed

5132.name: Vitamin B6
5132.description: Water-soluble vitamin involved in amino acid metabolism, neurotransmitter synthesis, and immune function.
5132.benefits: Supports amino acid metabolism, neurotransmitter production, immune system function
5132.risks: Risk of sensory neuropathy at very high supplemental doses over prolonged periods

5136.name: Vitamin B12
5136.description: Water-soluble vitamin essential for red blood cell formation, neurological function, and DNA synthesis.
5136.benefits: Supports hematopoiesis, neurological health, and DNA synthesis
5136.risks: Rare hypersensitivity or allergy, especially in injectable or high-dose forms

5187.name: Black Tea
5187.description: Processed leaves from Camellia sinensis containing polyphenols, caffeine, and tannins; used as a beverage ingredient for flavor and mild stimulant effects.
5187.benefits: Source of antioxidants (polyphenols), mild stimulant from caffeine, may contribute to hydration
5187.risks: Contains caffeine which may cause sensitivity or sleep disruption, tannins can reduce iron absorption, possible risk of pesticide residues depending on source

5190.name: Green Tea
5190.description: Beverage and extract derived from the leaves of Camellia sinensis, rich in polyphenols such as catechins.
5190.benefits: Antioxidant activity, may support cardiovascular health, source of polyphenols
5190.risks: Mild gastrointestinal irritation in sensitive individuals, potential liver toxicity at very high doses of concentrated extracts

5211.name: Sorbitol
5211.description: Sorbitol is a sugar alcohol used as a low-calorie sweetener and humectant in food products and pharmaceuticals.
5211.benefits: Low-calorie sweetener, humectant properties to retain moisture
5211.risks: Gastrointestinal discomfort and laxative effects at high doses

5222.name: Red 40
5222.description: Synthetic azo dye used as a color additive in foods and cosmetics to provide red coloration.
5222.benefits: Provides vibrant red color to food and cosmetic products
5222.risks: Potential allergenicity, hypersensitivity reactions, hyperactivity concerns in children, regulatory restrictions in some countries

5224.name: Artificial Flavoring
5224.description: Synthetic compounds used to mimic natural flavors, often chemically derived and typically added in small amounts to enhance taste.
5224.risks: Potential metabolic disruption, allergenicity, ultra-processing, possible unknown contaminants

5226.name: Acacia
5226.description: Powdered form of Acacia gum obtained by drying the natural exudate from Acacia trees. Used as a food additive for its emulsifying, stabilizing, and thickening properties.
5226.benefits: Dietary fiber source, prebiotic effects supporting gut microbiota, functional ingredient for texture and stability in foods
5226.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, minor gastrointestinal discomfort at high intake, potential for contamination if improperly processed

5240.name: Neotame
5240.description: Intense artificial sweetener derived from aspartame and neohesperidine dihydrochalcone, used to provide sweetness without calories.
5240.benefits: High-intensity sweetener with negligible calories, enhances sweetness, useful in sugar reduction
5240.risks: Potential allergen for individuals sensitive to aspartame, limited long-term safety data, possible digestive irritation at high doses

5244.name: Tangerine
5244.description: Tangerine is a citrus fruit (Citrus reticulata) rich in vitamin C, dietary fiber, and various phytochemicals such as flavonoids and carotenoids. It is consumed as a whole fruit or juice and provides antioxidants that can support immune function and overall health.
5244.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, source of dietary fiber, contains antioxidants, supports immune health, may reduce inflammation
5244.risks: Allergic reactions (rare), possible digestive upset if consumed in excess

5246.name: Lime
5246.description: Citrus fruit ingredient used for flavor and fragrance, containing vitamin C and organic acids.
5246.benefits: Flavoring agent, source of vitamin C, antioxidant properties
5246.risks: Irritation and sensitization in sensitive individuals, photosensitization risk with dermal exposure to UV light

5247.name: Grapefruit
5247.description: Citrus fruit commonly consumed fresh or as juice, containing vitamin C, flavonoids, and other phytochemicals.
5247.benefits: Source of vitamin C and antioxidants, low calorie, may support general nutritional intake
5247.risks: Drug interaction risk due to inhibition of cytochrome P450 enzymes, potential skin photosensitivity if applied topically

5266.name: Sweetener
5266.description: The term 'sweetener' is a vague label applied to a wide range of compounds used to provide sweetness in foods and beverages. It may refer to sugar, artificial sweeteners (such as sucralose, aspartame, or acesulfame K), sugar alcohols (like erythritol or xylitol), or even natural calorie-free options (like stevia or monk fruit). When unspecified, it commonly indicates the use of artificial or highly processed substances.
5266.risks: Lack of transparency, potential for ultra-processed artificial sweeteners, possible gut microbiome disruption, may cause metabolic effects depending on sweetener type

5288.name: Disodium Phosphate
5288.description: Inorganic salt used as an emulsifier, buffering agent, and pH adjuster in foods.
5288.benefits: Functions as emulsifier, pH stabilizer, and sequestrant in food processing
5288.risks: Excessive intake may contribute to elevated phosphate levels affecting kidney function, possible irritation at high concentrations

5304.name: Lemon Peel
5304.description: Outer rind of lemon fruit, containing essential oils, flavonoids, and dietary fiber. Used for flavoring and aroma in food products.
5304.benefits: Natural flavoring agent, source of vitamin C and antioxidants, may contribute dietary fiber
5304.risks: Potential skin and mucosal irritant, phototoxicity due to citrus oils, allergy risk in sensitive individuals

5307.name: Peach
5307.description: Peach is a fruit providing vitamins, dietary fiber, and antioxidants. The 4.6% indicates its proportion in a formulation.
5307.benefits: Source of dietary fiber, vitamins (notably vitamin C), antioxidants
5307.risks: Potential allergen for sensitive individuals, minimal risk at typical intake

5309.name: Organic Sugar
5309.description: Sucrose derived from organic sources, commonly used as a sweetener to provide sweetness and energy.
5309.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain, dental caries, disruption of blood glucose homeostasis

5353.name: Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)
5353.description: Water-soluble vitamin B6 form important for amino acid metabolism, neurotransmitter synthesis, and enzymatic reactions.
5353.benefits: Supports neurological function, amino acid metabolism, red blood cell production
5353.risks: High-dose supplementation can cause sensory neuropathy, rare allergic reactions, photosensitivity

5472.name: Vanilla Extract
5472.description: A mixture obtained by macerating and percolating vanilla beans in an ethanol-water solution, used primarily as a flavoring agent in foods and beverages.
5472.benefits: Flavor enhancement, aromatic compound providing sensory appeal in foods
5472.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential ethanol ingestion concerns in large amounts

5480.name: Lactic Acid
5480.description: Organic acid produced by fermentation or synthetically, used primarily as a pH adjuster, preservative, and exfoliant in foods and cosmetics.
5480.benefits: pH regulation, antimicrobial properties, supports shelf-life extension, mild exfoliation in skincare
5480.risks: Irritation potential at high concentrations, sensitization rare, ingestion generally safe at typical levels

5485.name: Locust Bean Gum
5485.description: A polysaccharide extracted from the seeds of the carob tree, used as a thickening and stabilizing agent in food products.
5485.benefits: Thickening, stabilizing, emulsifying agent, increases viscosity, fiber source
5485.risks: Minor gastrointestinal discomfort at high intake, potential allergen in sensitive individuals

5492.name: Lemon Juice Concentrate
5492.description: Concentrated form of lemon juice obtained by removing water, commonly used as a flavoring and acidulant.
5492.benefits: Provides natural flavor, source of citric acid, contains vitamin C and antioxidants
5492.risks: Irritation to skin and mucous membranes in concentrated form, potential allergen for citrus-sensitive individuals

5510.name: Agave Syrup
5510.description: Sweetener derived from the agave plant, high in fructose content.
5510.benefits: Sweetening agent, used as alternative to sucrose
5510.risks: High fructose content associated with excessive caloric intake and potential metabolic effects

5541.name: Pantothenic Acid
5541.description: Water-soluble B vitamin (B5) involved in synthesis of coenzyme A, essential for energy metabolism and synthesis of fatty acids.
5541.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, synthesis of fatty acids, promotes skin and hair health
5541.risks: None at typical nutritional levels, rare mild gastrointestinal upset at very high doses

5660.name: Purple Carrot Juice Concentrate
5660.description: Purple carrot juice concentrate is made by extracting juice from purple carrots and reducing it to a concentrated form, mainly for use as a natural colorant or to boost antioxidant content in foods. Purple carrots are rich in anthocyanins and other polyphenols, which are known for antioxidant activity.
5660.benefits: Rich in anthocyanins, source of polyphenols, potential antioxidant properties, natural colorant

5689.name: Strawberry Extract
5689.description: Concentrated compounds extracted from strawberries, including polyphenols, flavonoids, and organic acids.
5689.benefits: Contains antioxidants and natural flavor compounds
5689.risks: Possible skin irritation or sensitization in topical use, potential allergen for sensitive individuals

5718.name: Calcium-D-Pantothenate
5718.description: Calcium D-pantothenate is vitamin B5 form, pyridoxine hydrochloride is vitamin B6, both water-soluble vitamins essential for metabolism.
5718.benefits: Supports energy metabolism and nervous system function

5814.name: Vegetable Juice
5814.description: Liquid extracted from various vegetables used as a flavoring or coloring agent in food products.
5814.benefits: Natural colorant, adds vegetable-derived flavor, contains minor nutrients

5815.name: Lemon Juice
5815.description: Juice extracted from lemons, primarily composed of water, citric acid, vitamin C, and various flavonoids. Used for flavoring and preservation.
5815.benefits: Natural flavoring agent, antioxidant source (vitamin C), preservative properties
5815.risks: Irritation risk to skin or mucous membranes in sensitive individuals, potential acid erosion in dental use at high concentrations

5841.name: Mint
5841.description: Herb commonly used for flavoring, containing essential oils such as menthol with characteristic aroma and taste.
5841.benefits: Flavoring agent, provides sensory cooling effect
5841.risks: Irritation and sensitization potential in sensitive individuals, possible mild gastrointestinal upset if ingested in large amounts

5842.name: Hemp Extract
5842.description: Hemp extract is derived from the aerial parts of the Cannabis sativa plant, excluding the psychoactive THC component. It contains various phytochemicals, including cannabinoids (mainly CBD), terpenes, and flavonoids, and is used for its potential anti-inflammatory and anxiolytic effects.
5842.benefits: Anxiolytic effects, anti-inflammatory properties, potential pain relief, antioxidant activity
5842.risks: Potential drug interactions, mild digestive discomfort, possible liver enzyme elevation at high doses

5861.name: Pyridoxine HCl
5861.description: Pyridoxine HCl, also known as vitamin B6, is a water-soluble vitamin that plays a vital role in metabolism, brain development during pregnancy and infancy, and immune function. It is commonly used in dietary supplements and food fortification. The FDA recognizes pyridoxine HCl as generally recognized as safe (GRAS) for its intended use.
5861.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, essential for neurotransmitter synthesis, promotes immune system health, reduces risk of B6 deficiency
5861.risks: Rare toxicity possible with high-dose supplements, peripheral neuropathy at excessive doses

5914.name: Spices
5914.description: Dried seeds, fruits, roots, bark, or vegetative substances primarily used to flavor or preserve food.
5914.benefits: Flavor enhancement, antimicrobial properties, antioxidant content
5914.risks: Irritation or sensitization risk in sensitive individuals, potential contamination with heavy metals or adulterants depending on source and processing

5935.name: Chamomile Extract
5935.description: Extract derived from the flowers of Matricaria chamomilla or related species, commonly used for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and soothing properties in topical and ingestible formulations.
5935.benefits: Anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, skin-soothing properties, mild antimicrobial effects
5935.risks: Potential for allergic sensitization, especially in individuals allergic to plants in the Asteraceae family, possible mild skin irritation

5951.name: Vitamin A
5951.description: A fat-soluble vitamin essential for vision, immune function, and cellular growth.
5951.benefits: Supports vision, immune response, skin health, and cellular differentiation
5951.risks: Toxicity risk at high doses leading to symptoms such as liver damage and teratogenicity; no concern at recommended dietary levels

5952.name: Pineapple Juice Concentrate
5952.description: Concentrated form of pineapple juice obtained by removing water content, used as a flavoring or sweetening agent in foods and beverages.
5952.benefits: Provides natural fruit flavor, source of vitamins and minerals found in pineapple such as vitamin C
5952.risks: High sugar content, potential for allergenic reactions in sensitive individuals, may contribute to dental erosion if consumed excessively

5962.name: Flavouring
5962.description: Substances added to food to impart or modify flavor, can include natural or synthetic compounds.
5962.benefits: Improves palatability and taste of food products
5962.risks: Potential allergenicity, sensitization, lack of transparency in chemical composition

5978.name: Sulfites
5978.description: Sulfites are preservatives commonly used to prevent oxidation and microbial growth in food products.
5978.benefits: Preservative action to inhibit spoilage and maintain product stability
5978.risks: Irritant and sensitization risk including allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential respiratory distress in asthmatic persons

6006.name: Pink Himalayan Sea Salt
6006.description: Pink Himalayan sea salt is a minimally processed, natural salt harvested from mines near the Himalayas. It contains sodium chloride as the main component, along with trace minerals such as potassium, magnesium, and calcium, which give it a pink color.
6006.benefits: Essential electrolyte balance, trace minerals present
6006.risks: Sodium sensitivity, hypertension risk with excess intake

6011.name: AstraGin
6011.description: Proprietary blend of highly purified plant extracts primarily from Astragalus membranaceus and Panax notoginseng, used to enhance nutrient absorption.
6011.benefits: Reported to enhance absorption of amino acids, vitamins, and minerals in some studies
6011.risks: Potential herb-drug interactions, limited safety data, risk of contamination depending on source

6071.name: DL-Malic Acid
6071.description: An organic acid commonly used as a flavoring agent and acidulant in food products to impart tartness and enhance flavor.
6071.benefits: Enhances flavor by providing tartness, helps maintain pH balance in food
6071.risks: Irritation to skin and eyes at high concentrations, gastrointestinal discomfort if ingested in large amounts

6172.name: Guava
6172.description: Fruit ingredient derived from guava, commonly used for flavoring and nutritional value in food products at low concentrations.
6172.benefits: Provides flavor, minor source of dietary vitamins and antioxidants

6175.name: Ginger
6175.description: Root spice derived from Zingiber officinale, used for flavor and culinary purposes.
6175.benefits: Flavoring agent, culinary use, traditional use for digestive support
6175.risks: Irritation or sensitization risk in some individuals, especially at high doses

6176.name: Natural Coffee Bean Extract
6176.description: Extract derived from coffee beans containing caffeine, antioxidants, and other phytochemicals used for flavoring and stimulation.
6176.benefits: Antioxidant properties, central nervous system stimulation, potential cognitive enhancement in typical doses
6176.risks: Irritation in sensitive individuals, potential caffeine-related effects such as nervousness or insomnia at high ingestion levels

6194.name: Carrot Juice Concentrate
6194.description: Concentrated juice extracted from carrots, used for flavor and natural color in food products.
6194.benefits: Source of natural carotenoids (such as beta-carotene), natural flavoring, natural colorant

6197.name: Carbonic Acid
6197.description: Carbonic acid formed when carbon dioxide dissolves in water, commonly found in carbonated water.
6197.benefits: Provides effervescence and sensory enhancement in beverages
6197.risks: Mild dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, minor gastrointestinal irritation in sensitive individuals

6198.name: Mate tea
6198.description: Mate tea, also known as yerba mate, is an herbal infusion made from the dried leaves of Ilex paraguariensis. It is popular in South America and contains caffeine, polyphenols, and a range of bioactive compounds. It is consumed for its stimulating effects and as a source of antioxidants.
6198.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, may improve mental alertness, may support cardiovascular health, may aid metabolic health
6198.risks: Possible increased cancer risk with very hot consumption, high caffeine content, potential interactions with medications

6206.name: Lime Juice Concentrate
6206.description: Concentrated juice from limes, primarily composed of citric acid, water, and natural flavor compounds used for flavoring and acidity regulation.
6206.benefits: Provides natural flavor, acidity regulation, source of vitamin C
6206.risks: Irritation risk in sensitive skin or mucous membranes if used topically, potential photosensitivity with topical exposure, acidity-related dental erosion if ingested excessively

6218.name: Organic Natural Flavors
6218.description: Chemically extracted flavor compounds from natural sources, often with undisclosed solvents or processing aids.
6218.risks: Lack of transparency, potential for chemical residues, ultra-processed

6425.name: Pear Juice Concentrate
6425.description: Concentrated juice derived from pears, used as a natural sweetener and flavoring agent in foods and beverages.
6425.benefits: Provides natural sweetness, contains some vitamins and antioxidants present in pears
6425.risks: High sugar content when consumed excessively, potential allergen for sensitive individuals

6427.name: Spearmint
6427.description: Spearmint (Mentha spicata) is a widely used culinary herb known for its bright, minty flavor and aroma. It is commonly consumed fresh, dried, or as an extract in foods and beverages. Traditionally, spearmint has been used for digestive comfort and as a mild antimicrobial agent. It has FDA GRAS (Generally Recognized as Safe) status when used in food.
6427.benefits: Antioxidant activity, possible anti-inflammatory effects, potential cognitive benefits, may aid digestion
6427.risks: Allergic reactions (rare), mild gastrointestinal discomfort (rare, typically only with large amounts)

6451.name: Vegetable Juice Concentrate
6451.description: Concentrated extract from various vegetables used as a natural coloring agent.
6451.risks: Irritation or sensitization rare, potential allergen if derived from allergenic vegetables

6569.name: Mushroom Extract
6569.description: Extract derived from various mushroom species, used as a natural additive potentially to protect color stability in products.
6569.benefits: Antioxidant properties that may help protect color stability, natural origin, potential bioactive compounds
6569.risks: Possible allergenicity or sensitization in sensitive individuals, variability in composition depending on mushroom source, low risk of contamination if improperly processed

6640.name: Filtered Sparkling Water
6640.description: Filtered sparkling water is water that has been purified to remove impurities and then carbonated with dissolved carbon dioxide gas. It is commonly used as a base in beverages and provides effervescence without added flavors or nutrients.

6643.name: Natural Strawberry Flavor
6643.description: Flavoring ingredient derived from natural sources including strawberries and other fruits or extracts, used to impart strawberry taste.
6643.benefits: Provides strawberry aroma and flavor without bulk or sugar, enhances sensory properties
6643.risks: Potential skin or respiratory sensitization in some individuals, variability in composition, possible presence of processing solvents or allergens

6665.name: Organic Green Tea
6665.description: Green tea is made from the leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant, which undergo minimal oxidation during processing. It is rich in catechins, a type of antioxidant, and offers various health benefits when consumed. Being organic, it is cultivated without synthetic fertilizers and pesticides, adhering to organic farming standards. Green tea is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA.
6665.benefits: Antioxidant effects, supports cardiovascular health, may aid in metabolic rate, neuroprotective properties
6665.risks: Caffeine sensitivity, potential heavy metal contamination, possible gastrointestinal discomfort in high doses

6667.name: Organic Passion Fruit Juice
6667.description: Juice extracted from the organic passion fruit (Passiflora edulis), a tropical fruit known for its high vitamin C, polyphenols, carotenoids, and fiber. Commonly used for flavoring, antioxidants, and nutritional value in foods and beverages.
6667.benefits: Antioxidant properties, vitamin C, vitamin A, potential anti-inflammatory effects

6671.name: Organic Brewed Yerba Mate Leaf
6671.description: Brewed infusion of the leaves of Ilex paraguariensis, traditionally consumed as a caffeinated beverage rich in antioxidants and polyphenols.
6671.benefits: Antioxidant content, mild stimulant effect, source of polyphenols
6671.risks: Caffeine content may cause stimulant effects, potential risk of irritation or sensitization for some individuals, possible contamination with polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) if smoked-dried

6681.name: Organic Flavor
6681.description: Complex mixture of organic-derived compounds used to impart specific flavors in food products, typically less than 2% of formulation.
6681.risks: Unknown specific composition, potential for allergenicity, ultra-processed, possible presence of solvent residues

6682.name: Retinyl Palmitate (Vitamin A)
6682.description: Retinyl palmitate is a preformed, fat-soluble vitamin A ester commonly used as a supplement and food additive to fortify products. In the body, it is converted to retinol and retinoic acid, which are essential for vision, immune function, cell growth, and skin health.
6682.benefits: Supports vision, supports immune function, promotes healthy skin, vital for cellular growth and differentiation
6682.risks: Hypervitaminosis A with excessive intake, potential teratogenic effects during pregnancy, may cause liver toxicity at high doses

6690.name: Yerba Mate
6690.description: Traditional South American beverage made from the dried leaves of Ilex paraguariensis, commonly consumed as an infusion.
6690.benefits: Contains antioxidants, provides mild stimulant effect, source of polyphenols
6690.risks: Contains caffeine which may cause mild stimulation and insomnia, potential irritant for sensitive individuals, high-temperature consumption linked to increased risk of esophageal cancer

6785.name: Clarified Watermelon Juice Concentrate
6785.description: A concentrated form of watermelon juice that has been clarified to remove pulp and solids. Used as a flavoring or sweetening ingredient in foods and beverages. It contains natural sugars, vitamins, and antioxidants from watermelon but in concentrated form, which may increase sugar content per serving. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) when used as intended.
6785.benefits: Contains natural antioxidants (like lycopene), vitamins (vitamin C), hydration support, natural flavoring
6785.risks: High sugar content in concentrated form, potential for increased calorie intake

6788.name: Concord Grape Juice
6788.description: Concord grape juice is made by pressing Concord grapes, a dark purple-skinned grape rich in polyphenols, anthocyanins, and various micronutrients. It is commonly used as a beverage and sweetener, and is recognized for its potential antioxidant capacity.
6788.benefits: Rich in polyphenols, antioxidant effects, may improve vascular function, potential cognitive support
6788.risks: High natural sugar content, potential dental erosion, possible gastrointestinal discomfort, may increase blood glucose levels in diabetics

6831.name: Ozone
6831.description: A triatomic form of oxygen (O3) known for strong oxidative properties used in disinfection and deodorization processes.
6831.benefits: Effective antimicrobial and deodorizing agent in water and air treatment
6831.risks: Inhalation toxicity causing respiratory irritation, airway inflammation, impaired lung function, potential exacerbation of asthma and other respiratory diseases

6852.name: Blackberry Juice Concentrate
6852.description: Juice derived from blackberries that has been concentrated by removing water content and then reconstituted. Used to provide flavor and color in food and beverages.
6852.benefits: Source of natural flavor, contains antioxidants and phenolic compounds

6858.name: Hops
6858.description: Flower cones from the hop plant used primarily as a bittering and aroma agent in beverages and flavorings.
6858.benefits: Flavoring agent providing bitterness and aroma, preservative effect due to antimicrobial properties
6858.risks: Irritation potential, possible allergic sensitization, minor endocrine activity reported in some studies

6860.name: Silicon
6860.description: Silicon is a mineral that is naturally present in certain foods and is sometimes added as a food additive, mainly in the form of silicon dioxide. It is involved in various functions including bone formation and connective tissue health. In food products, it is often used as an anti-caking agent. The FDA generally recognizes silicon dioxide as safe (GRAS) for use in food.
6860.benefits: Potential support for bone health, connective tissue formation
6860.risks: High intake may cause kidney dysfunction in susceptible individuals, possible respiratory irritation (occupational exposure), limited nutritional value

6972.name: Rice Protein
6972.description: Protein extracted from rice grains, commonly used as a plant-based protein source.
6972.benefits: Good source of plant protein, hypoallergenic compared to other plant proteins, supports vegetarian/vegan diets
6972.risks: Potential allergenicity in rare cases, lower digestibility compared to animal proteins

7092.name: Minerals
7092.description: Inorganic elements essential for various physiological functions including bone health, enzyme activity, and fluid balance. Common dietary minerals include calcium, potassium, magnesium, and iron. Generally recognized as safe and necessary nutrients by the FDA when consumed in appropriate amounts.
7092.benefits: Support bone health, enzyme function, nerve transmission, fluid and electrolyte balance
7092.risks: Toxicity from excessive intake (e.g., iron overload, hypercalcemia), imbalance of mineral levels

7164.name: Gamma-aminobutyric acid
7164.description: An endogenous neurotransmitter in the central nervous system that functions primarily to inhibit nerve transmission and reduce neuronal excitability.
7164.benefits: Neurotransmitter with inhibitory function, potential calming effects on nervous system
7164.risks: None at typical dietary or topical exposure levels

7182.name: Polyvinyl Alcohol
7182.description: Synthetic, water-soluble polymer used commonly as a film-forming agent in cleaning products. Generally regarded as safe for dermal contact with low toxicity.
7182.benefits: Forms water-soluble films, biodegradable under certain conditions, non-toxic at typical use levels
7182.risks: Mild skin irritation in sensitive individuals, low inhalation risk from dust

7183.name: Coconut Flavor
7183.description: Flavoring compound designed to mimic the taste and aroma of coconut; typically consists of natural or synthetic chemicals used in food and beverages.
7183.benefits: Provides characteristic coconut taste and aroma to products
7183.risks: Possible allergenicity, potential for synthetic chemical impurities, ultra-processed ingredient

7449.name: Natural Lemon Lime Flavor with Other Natural Flavors
7449.description: A blend of volatile compounds extracted from lemon, lime, and other natural sources used to impart flavor in foods and beverages. The term 'natural flavors' encompasses complex mixtures of naturally derived chemical constituents, often processed and purified. FDA classifies these as generally recognized as safe (GRAS), but they lack transparency in exact composition.
7449.benefits: Provides desirable citrus flavor, enhances palatability
7449.risks: Lack of transparency, potential allergens, ultra-processed, no nutritional value, potential minor irritants for sensitive individuals

7458.name: Organic Ginger Juice
7458.description: Organic ginger juice is derived from fresh ginger root and processed into liquid form. It contains bioactive compounds such as gingerols and shogaols, known for their anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and digestive properties.
7458.benefits: Antioxidant effects, anti-inflammatory properties, may aid digestion, may reduce nausea
7458.risks: Potential for mild digestive upset in large quantities, possible allergic reactions

7506.name: Organic Jalapeño Pepper Powder
7506.description: Organic jalapeño pepper powder is made from dehydrated and ground organic jalapeño peppers. It is rich in capsaicin, vitamins (such as vitamin C and B6), and antioxidants, which contribute to its pungent flavor and potential health effects. Used as a spice, it adds heat and flavor to foods.
7506.benefits: Antioxidant properties, potential metabolic boost, may support cardiovascular health
7506.risks: Possible mild digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals

7518.name: Natural Fruit Flavors
7518.description: Natural fruit flavors are compounds extracted from fruits to mimic or enhance a fruit's taste and aroma in food products. These flavors rely on a blend of chemical compounds, potentially including solvents and preservatives, making them a processed ingredient despite their 'natural' origins. These are generally considered safe to consume, but the exact composition is often not disclosed.
7518.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, potential for allergenic reactions

7574.name: Orange Extract
7574.description: Orange extract is a concentrated flavoring derived from oranges. It is commonly used in cooking and baking to impart a citrus flavor. The extract usually contains a combination of alcohol and orange oil or zest. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA.
7574.benefits: Potential antioxidant compounds from citrus oils, flavor enhancement
7574.risks: Minimal nutritional value, possible solvents or additives from processing, potential allergen for some individuals

7575.name: Blood Orange Juice Concentrate
7575.description: Blood orange juice concentrate is a processed form of blood orange juice in which most of the water is removed, preserving flavor and nutrients in a condensed form. Blood oranges are rich in vitamin C, anthocyanins, and other antioxidants, and the concentrate is commonly used as a flavoring or coloring agent in foods and beverages.
7575.benefits: Source of vitamin C, source of antioxidants (anthocyanins), potential anti-inflammatory effects, may support cardiovascular health
7575.risks: Mild nutrient loss during processing, increased sugar concentration compared to whole fruit

7618.name: Silicone
7618.description: Silicone is a synthetic polymer commonly used in medical devices and baby product nipples for its flexibility and durability.
7618.benefits: Durable, heat-resistant, flexible, inert material suitable for repeated use in feeding products
7618.risks: Potential for physical irritation in sensitive individuals, low risk of chemical leaching, minimal inhalation or ingestion toxicity at typical use

7797.name: Non-carbonated spring water
7797.description: Non-carbonated spring water is water sourced from a natural spring, typically filtered to remove impurities but not further processed or chemically altered beyond basic filtration. It contains naturally occurring minerals and is commonly consumed for hydration.
7797.benefits: Hydration, source of essential minerals, supports normal body function

7832.name: Cordyceps Extract
7832.description: Extract derived from the hyphal form of Cordyceps fungi, used as a dietary supplement ingredient.
7832.benefits: Contains bioactive compounds with antioxidant properties, traditionally used in herbal supplements
7832.risks: Potential allergenicity, lack of standardization in extract composition, limited toxicity data

7924.name: Stabilizer
7924.description: General term for substances added to cleaning formulations to maintain product stability, prevent separation or degradation. The specific chemical nature varies widely and impacts safety profile.
7924.benefits: Helps maintain formulation consistency and effectiveness over time
7924.risks: Unknown due to non-specific term; potential mild irritation or sensitization depending on chemical class

7926.name: Rose Hips
7926.description: Rose hips are the fruit of the rose plant, particularly Rosa canina. They are rich in vitamin C and various plant compounds such as polyphenols and carotenoids, and are often used in herbal teas and supplements for their antioxidant properties.
7926.benefits: High vitamin C content, antioxidant activity, anti-inflammatory properties, potential support for joint health
7926.risks: Mild digestive upset in sensitive individuals, potential allergic reaction in rare cases

7933.name: Licorice Root
7933.description: Dried root of Glycyrrhiza glabra commonly used as herbal tea ingredient and flavoring agent.
7933.benefits: Flavoring agent in teas, traditional use supports digestive comfort and mild soothing effects
7933.risks: Potential for hypertension and hypokalemia with excessive ingestion due to glycyrrhizin, possible interactions with medications such as diuretics and corticosteroids

7966.name: Grape Juice
7966.description: Liquid extracted from grapes, primarily used for flavor and sweetness in small concentrations.
7966.benefits: Flavoring agent, natural source of sugars and antioxidants at higher concentrations

8053.name: Organic Lion's Mane Mushroom Extract
8053.description: Lion's Mane Mushroom (Hericium erinaceus) extract is derived from the fruiting body or mycelium of the fungus, often standardized for bioactive compounds like hericenones and erinacines. It is commonly marketed as a nootropic or adaptogen and used in supplements for potential cognitive and neurological benefits. The organic designation refers to mushrooms grown and processed without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. The FDA classifies general mushroom powders as GRAS, but specific extracts are not fully evaluated for all health claims.
8053.benefits: Potential neuroprotection, possible cognitive support, may support nerve growth factor production, antioxidant activity
8053.risks: Possible allergic reactions, insufficient long-term safety data

8056.name: Organic KSM-66 Ashwagandha Extract
8056.description: A concentrated root extract of Withania somnifera standardized for high withanolide content, used as an adaptogen.
8056.benefits: Adaptogenic properties, may support stress resilience, cognitive function, and endurance, generally well tolerated in typical doses
8056.risks: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort, potential interactions with thyroid or immunomodulatory medications, rare allergic reactions

8123.name: Preservative
8123.description: Generic term for substances added to cleaning products to prevent microbial growth and extend shelf life. Safety and toxicity depend on the specific chemical used.
8123.benefits: Prevents microbial contamination, extends product shelf life, ensures product safety
8123.risks: Varies by compound; potential skin sensitization, irritation, allergic reactions, toxicity especially with isothiazolinones and formaldehyde-releasing agents

8222.name: Organic Lemon Juice Powder
8222.description: Powdered form of lemon juice typically made by dehydrating lemon juice, used as a flavoring agent and source of vitamin C.
8222.benefits: Flavor enhancement, source of vitamin C and antioxidants
8222.risks: Potential mild skin and mucous membrane irritation on contact, acidity may cause dental enamel erosion with excessive intake

8273.name: Natural flavor
8273.description: A broad category for flavoring substances derived from natural sources, often processed and extracted using various methods, with chemical composition not fully disclosed.
8273.benefits: Enhances taste and aroma in food products
8273.risks: Lack of transparency, potential presence of solvents or processing residues, ultra-processed nature, no nutritional value

8386.name: Flavours
8386.description: Complex mixture of natural and/or synthetic compounds used to impart taste and aroma to food products.
8386.benefits: Enhances palatability and consumer acceptance of foods
8386.risks: Possible allergens, sensitizers, variable chemical composition, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed

8388.name: Organic Color (Organic Black Carrot, Organic Black Currant Extracts)
8388.description: This ingredient consists of natural plant extracts from organically grown black carrot and black currant, used as colorants in food products. These extracts are rich in anthocyanins and other polyphenols, which contribute to their characteristic dark purple color and exhibit antioxidant properties.
8388.benefits: Natural source of anthocyanins, antioxidant activity, low risk of adverse effects

8389.name: Organic Natural Flavor
8389.description: Complex mixtures of volatile and non-volatile compounds extracted from natural sources used to impart flavor.
8389.benefits: Flavor enhancement in food and beverages
8389.risks: Lack of transparency in composition, possible presence of solvents or allergens, ultra-processed nature, no direct nutritional value

8419.name: Maple Syrup
8419.description: A natural sweetener derived from the sap of maple trees, primarily composed of sucrose with small amounts of minerals and antioxidants.
8419.benefits: Natural sweetener, contains small amounts of antioxidants and minerals such as manganese and zinc
8419.risks: High sugar content, potential for dental caries, excessive caloric intake associated with weight gain

8436.name: Organic Yerba Mate
8436.description: Yerba mate is a traditional South American herbal tea made from the leaves of the Ilex paraguariensis plant. It's naturally rich in caffeine, antioxidants, vitamins, and polyphenols and is consumed as a stimulant beverage for increased energy and mental alertness.
8436.benefits: Antioxidant properties, cognitive stimulation, potential anti-inflammatory effects, micronutrient source
8436.risks: Caffeine-related side effects, interaction with certain medications, increased risk of esophageal cancer with extremely hot consumption, potential heavy metal contamination

8441.name: Organic Lemon Natural Flavor
8441.description: Organic lemon natural flavor refers to flavoring agents derived from organic lemons, but processed and concentrated into extracts or additives. Despite the 'organic' claim, the term 'natural flavor' covers a wide range of chemical extraction processes and may include non-lemon ingredients for flavor stabilization or preservation.
8441.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or carriers, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

8522.name: Pomegranate Juice Concentrate
8522.description: Pomegranate juice concentrate is a syrup-like product made by removing water from pomegranate juice, resulting in a sweeter and more concentrated source of pomegranate polyphenols and antioxidants. It is commonly used as an ingredient for beverages, sauces, and supplements.
8522.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, contains polyphenols (punicalagins, anthocyanins), may reduce inflammation, possible cardiovascular support
8522.risks: High in natural sugars, possible dental caries with excess intake, calorie-dense if consumed in large amounts

8523.name: Cranberry Juice Concentrate
8523.description: Cranberry juice concentrated by removing water, then reconstituted; contains natural sugars, acids, and phytochemicals from cranberries.
8523.benefits: Source of antioxidants, vitamin C, supports urinary tract health through proanthocyanidins
8523.risks: High sugar content, acidity may cause dental erosion or gastric discomfort in sensitive individuals

8573.name: Natural Flavour
8573.description: A general term for flavor compounds extracted from natural sources, which may involve various chemical solvents and processes.
8573.risks: Lack of transparency, potential presence of undisclosed solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

8595.name: Linalool
8595.description: A naturally occurring terpene alcohol commonly used as a fragrance and flavoring agent.
8595.benefits: Provides floral and citrus scent characteristics in fragrances and flavors
8595.risks: Skin sensitization and allergic contact dermatitis in sensitive individuals

8652.name: Ginseng
8652.description: Herbal root used primarily for its adaptogenic properties and potential to support cognitive function and energy.
8652.benefits: Adaptogenic effects, potential cognitive support, may improve energy and reduce fatigue
8652.risks: Mild irritation, potential for allergic reactions, possible interactions with medications such as anticoagulants and diabetes drugs

8765.name: Purified Drinking Water
8765.description: Water intended for human consumption, essential for hydration and physiological functions.
8765.risks: Contamination with pathogens or pollutants if untreated

8768.name: Pyridoxine Hydrochloride (Vitamin B6)
8768.description: Water-soluble vitamin B6 form used as a nutritional supplement to support metabolism and neurological function.
8768.benefits: Supports amino acid metabolism, neurotransmitter synthesis, and red blood cell production
8768.risks: High doses may cause sensory neuropathy, rare allergic reactions

8815.name: Tart Cherry Juice Concentrate
8815.description: Juice derived from cherries that has been concentrated by removing water and then reconstituted to the desired strength. Used as a flavoring and colorant in foods and beverages.
8815.benefits: Contains natural fruit phytochemicals and antioxidants, provides flavor and color
8815.risks: Potential for sugar content contribution, possible allergen in sensitive individuals

8835.name: Fulvic Acid
8835.description: Water-soluble mixture of organic acids and molecules derived from humic substances found in soil and peat, used as a supplement or soil conditioner.
8835.benefits: Chelating properties that may enhance mineral absorption in plants, proposed antioxidant properties, used in soil amendment for improved nutrient uptake
8835.risks: Potential contamination with heavy metals or pollutants depending on source and purification, inconsistent composition, possible irritation on skin contact at high concentration

8865.name: D-Calcium Pantothenate
8865.description: A stable calcium salt form of pantothenic acid (vitamin B5), essential for synthesizing coenzyme A and involved in energy metabolism.
8865.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, involved in synthesis of coenzyme A, important for skin and hair health

8874.name: Naturlig arom
8874.description: "Naturlig arom" is the Scandinavian/Swedish term for "natural flavor" or "natural aroma"—a catch-all for chemically isolated flavoring substances derived from plant or animal sources. The precise composition is rarely disclosed. These additives undergo significant processing and may include solvents, carriers, or preservatives not listed on labels.
8874.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

8905.name: Rosemary
8905.description: Herbal plant extract used primarily as a flavoring and antioxidant in foods and cosmetics.
8905.risks: Possible skin irritation or allergic sensitization in some individuals, ingestion at high doses may cause gastrointestinal upset

8912.name: Organic Saffron Extract (Crocus sativus) (flower) (0.3% Safranal)
8912.description: Extract derived from the flower of Crocus sativus, commonly used as a flavoring, coloring agent, and traditional medicine. Recognized for bioactive compounds like crocin and safranal with antioxidant and potential mood-enhancing properties. Generally considered safe for consumption in culinary and supplemental amounts.
8912.benefits: Antioxidant effects, mood enhancement, anti-inflammatory properties, potential cognitive benefits
8912.risks: Possible allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, high dose toxicity rare but possible

8928.name: Reb M (Onosweet)
8928.description: Rebaudioside M is a steviol glycoside used as a high-intensity sweetener derived from Stevia rebaudiana leaves. OnoSweet refers to a fermented form of Reb M produced via bioconversion to enhance purity and taste profile.
8928.benefits: High-intensity non-nutritive sweetener, low caloric contribution, does not raise blood glucose
8928.risks: Potential allergenicity, minor gastrointestinal effects at high intake, limited long-term data

8930.name: Passion Fruit Juice
8930.description: Juice extracted from passion fruit, used as a flavor and aroma component in foods and beverages.
8930.benefits: Provides natural flavor, source of antioxidants and vitamin C
8930.risks: Potential allergen for sensitive individuals, minor risk of irritation in high concentrations

9087.name: Unrefined Salt
9087.description: Unrefined salt is a natural salt product that retains trace minerals and is minimally processed compared to refined table salt. It is used as a seasoning and preservative. The FDA recognizes salt as generally safe for consumption.
9087.benefits: Essential electrolyte, supports nerve transmission, aids fluid balance, contains trace minerals
9087.risks: Hypertension and cardiovascular risk with excessive intake

9165.name: Organic Fruit and Vegetable Juice (Color)
9165.description: Natural juices extracted from fruits and vegetables used as colorants in food products.
9165.benefits: Provides natural coloring from plant sources, may contain minor amounts of vitamins and antioxidants
9165.risks: Allergic reactions possible in sensitive individuals, potential for microbial contamination if improperly processed

9180.name: Cannabidiol (CBD)
9180.description: Cannabidiol is a non-intoxicating compound derived from Cannabis sativa, commonly used for its potential effects on the nervous system and as an ingredient in supplements and topical products.
9180.benefits: Neurological effect modulation, anti-anxiety potential, non-intoxicating cannabinoid
9180.risks: Potential drug interactions, possible liver enzyme alterations, limited regulation and standardization, irritant/sensitizer in topical use

9207.name: Pressed Apple Juice
9207.description: Juice extracted from apples, typically containing natural sugars, vitamins, and organic acids.
9207.benefits: Source of vitamin C, hydration, natural antioxidants
9207.risks: High sugar content, potential for dental erosion, minimal digestive irritation in sensitive individuals

9213.name: White Guava Purée (5%)
9213.description: White guava purée is made by blending the pulp of white guava fruit into a smooth, thick consistency. Guava is a tropical fruit renowned for its vitamin C, antioxidants, dietary fiber, and other micronutrients. In food products, purée is used as a flavoring, natural sweetener, and for its nutrient content.
9213.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, antioxidant effects, supports immune health, provides dietary fiber

9284.name: Green Tea Solids
9284.description: Green tea solids are the dried concentrated extract of green tea leaves containing polyphenols (notably catechins like EGCG), caffeine, and other bioactive compounds. Used as an antioxidant, flavoring, or functional ingredient in supplements and food products.
9284.benefits: Antioxidant properties, cardiovascular health support, may aid in blood sugar regulation, possible neuroprotective effects
9284.risks: Caffeine-related side effects, potential liver toxicity in very high doses

9290.name: Niacinamide (B3)
9290.description: Niacinamide, also known as nicotinamide, is a water-soluble form of vitamin B3. It functions as a precursor for NAD+/NADP+ in the body, playing a critical role in cellular energy metabolism and DNA repair.
9290.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, essential nutrient, supports DNA repair, may improve skin health, may reduce inflammation
9290.risks: High-dose supplementation may cause liver toxicity, mild gastrointestinal discomfort, potential interactions with certain medications

9411.name: White Grape Juice from Concentrate
9411.description: Concentrated juice derived from white grapes, used as a sweetener and flavoring agent in food and beverages.
9411.benefits: Source of natural sugars for energy, contains small amounts of antioxidants and vitamins
9411.risks: High sugar content, potential dental caries risk, possible contribution to caloric excess

9546.name: Beetroot Powder
9546.description: Powdered form of beetroot commonly used as a natural colorant in foods and beverages. Derived from red beet roots.
9546.benefits: Natural coloring agent, source of dietary nitrates which can support vascular function, contains antioxidants
9546.risks: Low allergenic potential, possible beeturia (pink urine) in some individuals, high nitrate content may affect sensitive individuals

9548.name: Hibiscus Extract
9548.description: Concentrated extract from Hibiscus sabdariffa flowers, used for flavoring and antioxidant properties.
9548.benefits: Contains antioxidants, may support cardiovascular health, used as natural colorant and flavor enhancer
9548.risks: Potential mild skin irritation or sensitization, possible hypotensive effect with excessive oral intake

9584.name: Natural Flavor (Grapefruit)
9584.description: Natural grapefruit flavor refers to chemically extracted compounds from grapefruit or substances synthesized to mimic grapefruit’s flavor, used as additives in foods and beverages. The specific formulation is proprietary and can include solvents, carriers, and preservatives alongside aromatic compounds.
9584.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, possible undisclosed allergens, no nutritional value

9660.name: Organic Cordyceps Mushroom Extract
9660.description: Cordyceps Mushroom extract is derived from the Cordyceps genus of fungi, traditionally used in Chinese medicine. Its extracts contain bioactive compounds like cordycepin and polysaccharides, which may influence energy metabolism, immune function, and inflammation.
9660.benefits: Potential antioxidant properties, possible immune system support, may improve exercise performance, anti-inflammatory effects
9660.risks: Rare allergic reactions, limited safety data for long-term use, may interact with immunosuppressant drugs

9696.name: Passionfruit
9696.description: Passionfruit is the fruit of Passiflora edulis, commonly used for flavoring and as a source of vitamins and antioxidants.
9696.benefits: Source of vitamin C and antioxidants, natural flavoring agent
9696.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, possible irritation in high concentrations

9710.name: Lion's Mane
9710.description: Edible mushroom (Hericium erinaceus) used as a food and supplement ingredient. Contains bioactive compounds such as hericenones and erinacines.
9710.benefits: Source of dietary fiber, bioactive compounds with neuroprotective and cognitive support potential
9710.risks: Mild allergenic potential, possible gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals

9797.name: Mandarin Juice Concentrate
9797.description: Mandarin juice concentrate is made by removing water from mandarin orange juice, resulting in a thicker, sweeter product often used in processed foods and beverages. It retains most nutrients and bioactive compounds from mandarins, though concentration can mildly affect antioxidant content and flavor.
9797.benefits: Source of vitamin C, antioxidants, flavonoids
9797.risks: High sugar content, caloric density, potential loss of heat-sensitive vitamins

9889.name: Natural Flavorings
9889.description: Likely a typographical variant of 'natural flavoring', which refers to flavor compounds derived from natural sources through various extraction and processing methods.
9889.risks: Lack of transparency, potential allergenicity, may contain residual solvents or processing chemicals, ultra-processed

9896.name: Additives
9896.description: \"Additives\" is a broad, non-specific term referring to substances added to food to modify its properties, such as taste, appearance, shelf life, or texture. Examples include preservatives, colorants, flavor enhancers, emulsifiers, and stabilizers. The safety and health impact of additives varies wildly depending on the specific compound. The lack of specificity in this label raises concerns regarding transparency and the possibility of including ingredients with potential health risks.
9896.risks: Lack of transparency, may include synthetic chemicals, potential for gut irritation, possible allergenic reactions, ultra-processed

9898.name: Organic Strawberry Juice from Concentrate
9898.description: Juice obtained by concentrating strawberry juice and then reconstituted to original concentration. Used as flavor and colorant ingredient in foods.
9898.benefits: Provides natural flavor, color, and some vitamins and antioxidants
9898.risks: Potential allergen for sensitive individuals, minimal risk at typical use levels

9912.name: Organic Lemon Juice from Concentrate
9912.description: Lemon juice concentrated by removal of water, reconstituted to achieve desired acidity and flavor.
9912.benefits: Provides vitamin C, organic acids, and flavoring
9912.risks: Acidic pH may cause dental enamel erosion with excessive exposure, potential minor allergen for citrus-sensitive individuals

9925.name: Natural Flavoring
9925.description: Complex mixture of volatile compounds extracted or synthesized to provide aroma and taste, derived from natural sources.
9925.benefits: Enhances flavor and aroma in food products
9925.risks: Potential allergenicity, lack of transparency, possible trace contaminants or solvents

10119.name: Natural Flavourings
10119.description: Mixtures of flavor compounds derived from natural sources used to enhance taste in food products.
10119.risks: Lack of transparency, variable composition, potential allergenicity, may contain undisclosed solvents or processing aids

10120.name: Pink Grapefruit Juice
10120.description: Pink grapefruit juice is the liquid extracted from the fruit of the pink grapefruit (Citrus × paradisi), known for its distinctive tart-sweet flavor and pink hue due to the presence of lycopene. It is a source of vitamin C, potassium, antioxidants, and other phytonutrients. In the body, it supports hydration, immune function, and acts as an antioxidant.
10120.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, source of antioxidants, may support immune system, hydration, contains potassium, contains lycopene
10120.risks: Interacts with certain medications, potential for high sugar content, acid can erode tooth enamel

10138.name: Black Carrot Juice
10138.description: Juice derived from black carrots, rich in anthocyanins used as a natural food colorant.
10138.risks: Possible allergenicity in sensitive individuals, mild irritation in rare cases

10181.name: Natural Peach Flavor with Other Natural Flavors
10181.description: This ingredient refers to a blend of chemically extracted flavor compounds derived from peaches and other unspecified natural sources. The process often includes solvents, carriers, and additives not disclosed to consumers. While 'natural flavors' must be sourced from plants or animals, they are purified and manipulated, resulting in an ultra-processed product that provides no nutritional value. The formulation lacks transparency, and the specific sources and processing methods are rarely specified to consumers.
10181.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, possible allergen exposure, no nutritional value

10199.name: Natural Flavours
10199.description: Complex mixtures of flavor compounds extracted from natural sources and/or synthesized, used to impart specific tastes and aromas in food and beverages.
10199.benefits: Enhances flavor and palatability of food and beverages
10199.risks: Lack of transparency, potential presence of solvent residues, possible allergens, ultra-processed nature, no nutritional value

10280.name: Natural Grapefruit Flavor
10280.description: Natural grapefruit flavor is a chemically extracted concentrate derived from grapefruit and/or its essential oils, used to impart citrus flavor to food products. The production process typically involves the use of solvents and processing aids, and the final composition may contain a mix of volatile compounds. This ingredient is regulated by the FDA as Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS), but the exact formulation is usually proprietary and may include undisclosed additives.
10280.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, potential allergenicity, no nutritional value

10468.name: Citra Hops
10468.description: Citra hops are a variety of hop (Humulus lupulus) commonly used in brewing to impart strong citrus and tropical fruit flavors and aromas to beverages, especially craft beers. They provide flavor, aroma, and some natural preservation due to their polyphenols and essential oils. Hops are generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA for use in foods and beverages.
10468.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, anti-inflammatory properties, potential mild antimicrobial effects
10468.risks: Allergic reactions (rare), estrogenic effects (very high intake), possible mild digestive discomfort

10470.name: Mosaic Hops
10470.description: Dried flower cones from the Humulus lupulus plant variety 'Mosaic,' used primarily as a flavoring and bittering agent in beer production.
10470.benefits: Natural flavoring and bittering agent in alcoholic beverages, contains bioactive compounds with antioxidant properties
10470.risks: Allergic sensitization, contact dermatitis, respiratory irritation from inhalation of dust

10519.name: Red Amaranth
10519.description: Red amaranth (Amaranthus cruentus or Amaranthus dubius) is a leafy green vegetable, known for its vibrant red or purple leaves. It is traditionally consumed as a food in many cultures and is valued for its nutrient density, offering high levels of vitamins (such as vitamin C, vitamin A), minerals (like calcium and iron), antioxidants, and dietary fiber. Red amaranth is minimally processed when used as a fresh green, and it is regarded as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) by the FDA when consumed as a food.
10519.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, high in vitamins and minerals, good source of dietary fiber, supports eye health, supports immune health, potential anti-inflammatory properties

10543.name: Indian Gooseberry
10543.description: Indian Gooseberry, also known as Amla (Emblica officinalis), is a fruit widely used in traditional medicine and as a dietary supplement. It is rich in vitamin C, polyphenols, and antioxidants. Amla is considered a whole food and is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) in food products.
10543.benefits: Antioxidant activity, anti-inflammatory properties, supports immune function, may improve cholesterol profile, supports blood sugar regulation

10609.name: Natural Butter Flavor
10609.description: Complex mixture of flavor compounds derived from dairy to replicate butter taste, often combined with maltodextrin as a carrier or filler.
10609.benefits: Provides butter flavor without fat, used in flavor enhancement
10609.risks: Potential allergens from dairy source, processed additive, possible irritant, ultra-processed ingredient

10631.name: Natural Cucumber Flavor
10631.description: Natural cucumber flavor refers to flavoring compounds derived from cucumber or synthesized to mimic cucumber's taste, labeled as 'natural' according to FDA regulations. This ingredient is typically produced using extraction and purification processes, and can include added solvents or carriers. Its exact composition is not disclosed, leading to lack of transparency and potential inclusion of unlisted additives.
10631.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain added solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

10711.name: Red Grape Juice from Concentrate
10711.description: Grape juice concentrated by removing water, then reconstituted; primarily composed of sugars, organic acids, and phytochemicals from grapes.
10711.benefits: Provides hydration, source of antioxidants such as polyphenols, contains vitamins and minerals
10711.risks: High sugar content, potential for dental caries, lacks fiber, possible oxidation of sensitive compounds

10751.name: Organic Peach Juice Concentrate
10751.description: Organic peach juice concentrate is a fruit-derived liquid produced by removing water from the juice of organically grown peaches. It is commonly used in foods and beverages as a natural sweetener and flavoring. The concentrate retains some vitamins and antioxidants present in peaches but is higher in sugar concentration and lower in fiber compared to whole fruit. As an organic product, it is produced without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers, and is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used as intended.
10751.benefits: Contains vitamins (such as vitamin C), provides antioxidants, natural source of some phytonutrients
10751.risks: High sugar content, lower fiber than whole fruit

10820.name: Hemp Seed Oil
10820.description: Hemp seed oil is a vegetable oil extracted from the seeds of the hemp plant. It contains a balanced ratio of omega-6 to omega-3 fatty acids and is rich in polyunsaturated fats. It is generally regarded as safe for food consumption and is valued for its nutritional profile.
10820.benefits: Rich in omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids, anti-inflammatory properties, supports cardiovascular health, contains vitamin E and antioxidants
10820.risks: Possible oxidation if highly processed, mild allergenicity in sensitive individuals

10844.name: Organic Acerola Extract
10844.description: Acerola extract is derived from the acerola cherry (Malpighia emarginata), a fruit known for its exceptionally high vitamin C content and antioxidant compounds. Organic acerola extract refers to the extract obtained from acerola cherries grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. It is commonly used as a natural source of vitamin C fortification in foods and supplements. The FDA generally recognizes acerola cherry as safe (GRAS) when used in food.
10844.benefits: Rich source of vitamin C, provides antioxidants, may support immune function

10870.name: Black Tea Essence
10870.description: Concentrated extract derived from organic black tea leaves, used for flavoring. Black tea contains bioactive compounds such as polyphenols and flavonoids which have antioxidant properties. It is generally recognized as safe for consumption and is valued for its flavor and mild stimulant effects due to caffeine content.
10870.benefits: Antioxidant properties, may improve cardiovascular health, provides mild cognitive stimulation
10870.risks: Caffeine sensitivity, potential for mild stimulant-related side effects such as insomnia and jitteriness

11018.name: Natural Black Cherry Flavor
11018.description: Natural Black Cherry Flavor is a flavoring made from natural sources, designed to mimic or enhance the taste of black cherries. While labeled 'natural,' these flavors are commonly manufactured using chemical extraction and may contain numerous undisclosed compounds, solvents, or preservatives. The production process is highly industrial, and the ingredient is considered ultra-processed. The FDA classifies natural flavors as GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe), but their specific composition remains largely unregulated and undisclosed.
11018.risks: Lack of transparency, ultra-processed, may contain solvents or preservatives, no nutritional value

11270.name: Clementine Juice Concentrate
11270.description: Clementine juice concentrate is produced by removing water from clementine juice to create a denser, shelf-stable product. Used mainly as a flavoring or sweetening ingredient, juice concentrates are more processed than fresh juice but retain many of the original juice's nutrients, such as vitamin C. The process may reduce certain phytonutrients and can increase sugar concentration per serving. Generally regarded as safe (GRAS) by the FDA.
11270.benefits: Source of vitamin C, provides antioxidants, natural flavor
11270.risks: Higher sugar concentration, potential loss of some phytonutrients through processing

11300.name: Dark Sweet Cherry Juice Concentrate
11300.description: Dark sweet cherry juice concentrate is produced by removing water from the juice of dark sweet cherries (Prunus avium), typically to increase shelf life and sweetness. It contains naturally occurring sugars, vitamins, minerals, and polyphenols such as anthocyanins, which are responsible for the deep red color. It is sometimes used as a natural flavoring or sweetener in foods and beverages. The ingredient is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used as intended.
11300.benefits: Contains polyphenols, antioxidant activity, source of vitamin C, potential support for inflammation reduction, possible support for muscle recovery
11300.risks: High sugar content, potential for elevated blood glucose, caloric density

11397.name: Clarified Pineapple Juice Concentrate
11397.description: Pineapple juice concentrate that has been filtered to remove solids and impurities, resulting in a clear liquid with concentrated sugars and flavor compounds.
11397.benefits: Provides natural sugars and flavor, source of some vitamins and antioxidants from pineapple
11397.risks: High sugar content, potential for dental caries with excessive consumption, possible minor allergenicity

11435.name: Non-GMO Digestion Resistant Maltodextrin
11435.description: A modified polysaccharide used as a soluble dietary fiber and bulking agent, derived from starch and resistant to digestion in the small intestine.
11435.benefits: Source of soluble fiber, supports digestive health, may improve bowel regularity
11435.risks: Possible mild gastrointestinal discomfort (bloating, gas) at high intake, ultra-processed carbohydrate

11484.name: Natural Orange Extract
11484.description: Natural orange extract is a flavoring made by extracting aromatic compounds from orange peel or oil, typically using alcohol or other solvents. It is used as a flavor enhancer in food products, providing a citrus aroma and taste. As a flavoring, it is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA, though its composition can be variable depending on the extraction process and may involve minor undisclosed additives.
11484.benefits: Flavor enhancement, may contain trace antioxidants
11484.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain undisclosed solvents or carriers, potential for ultra-processing

11558.name: Elderflower Extract
11558.description: Elderflower extract is derived from the blossoms of the Sambucus nigra plant. Traditionally used in herbal medicine, elderflower is valued for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and potential immune-supporting properties. In food products, it is mainly used for its floral flavor and aromatic qualities. Elderflower extract is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) when used according to intended food applications.
11558.benefits: Antioxidant activity, potential anti-inflammatory properties, mild immune support
11558.risks: Allergic reactions (rare), mild gastrointestinal upset (in large quantities)

11561.name: Lime Peel Extract
11561.description: Lime peel extract is derived from the outer skin of the lime (Citrus aurantiifolia or Citrus latifolia). It is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and essential oils such as limonene. In food applications, it is used as a flavoring or preservative due to its aromatic compounds and natural antimicrobial properties. There is no FDA GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe) status specifically for lime peel extract, but limonene and natural citrus oils are generally considered safe for consumption in typical amounts.
11561.benefits: Antioxidant activity, antimicrobial properties, potential anti-inflammatory effect
11561.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, possible phototoxicity in large amounts

11596.name: Natural Pineapple Flavor
11596.description: Natural pineapple flavor refers to flavor compounds derived from pineapples or created from other plant or animal sources to mimic pineapple's taste. While labeled 'natural,' such flavors are often obtained through extraction, concentration, or enzymatic processes, and may contain carrier solvents, emulsifiers, or preservatives. The FDA generally recognizes natural flavors as GRAS (Generally Recognized as Safe), but the exact composition is not required to be disclosed, leading to potential transparency concerns.
11596.risks: Lack of transparency, ultra-processed, may contain solvents or preservatives, possible allergens

11629.name: Patented Liquid Silica
11629.description: Patented liquid silica refers to a proprietary, soluble formulation of silicon (often as orthosilicic acid or stabilized silica), marketed for potential health benefits such as supporting skin, hair, nails, and connective tissues. Silica is naturally found in foods and is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used in its purified forms (e.g. silicon dioxide) as a food additive. However, 'patented' formulations may contain undisclosed additives and their bioavailability and efficacy can vary by brand.
11629.benefits: Essential trace mineral, supports connective tissue, may improve skin, hair, nail strength
11629.risks: Possible contamination with additives or preservatives, unsubstantiated health claims, overconsumption may lead to mild kidney issues

11630.name: Purified Spring Water
11630.description: Purified spring water is water sourced from a spring and then processed to remove impurities and contaminants such as bacteria, viruses, and chemical pollutants. It is commonly used as a base ingredient in beverages and processed foods. While it must meet safety standards and is considered safe for general consumption, it contains no nutrients and offers no particular health benefit beyond hydration.

11700.name: Natural Lemon and Lime Flavourings
11700.description: Flavoring derived from lemon or its components, used to impart lemon aroma and taste in food and beverages.
11700.benefits: Provides natural lemon aroma and taste, enhances flavor profile in food and beverages
11700.risks: Potential for allergic reactions, possible irritation in sensitive individuals, variability in composition due to manufacturing processes

11927.name: Organic Reishi Extract
11927.description: Organic Reishi extract is a concentrated preparation derived from the fruiting body or mycelium of Ganoderma lucidum, commonly known as Reishi or Lingzhi mushroom. It is used in traditional medicine and marketed for its potential health-promoting properties, including immunomodulation and antioxidant activity. The ‘organic’ designation means the mushrooms are grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. There is no FDA GRAS status, but it is widely consumed as a supplement.
11927.benefits: Immunomodulatory effects, anti-inflammatory properties, antioxidant activity, possible support for liver health
11927.risks: Possible interaction with anticoagulants, mild digestive upset, allergic reactions

12081.name: Raspberry Juice from Concentrate
12081.description: Raspberry juice concentrated and reconstituted; used as flavor and color additive in foods and beverages.
12081.benefits: Source of natural flavor compounds and antioxidants

12294.name: Humic Acid
12294.description: Complex mixture of organic acids derived from the decomposition of plant and microbial material in soil, often used as a soil conditioner or dietary supplement.
12294.benefits: May improve nutrient absorption in soil applications, proposed benefits in gut health though evidence limited
12294.risks: Potential contamination with heavy metals or toxins depending on source, ingestion toxicity at high doses not well studied

12378.name: Quinine
12378.description: Quinine is an alkaloid used primarily as a bitter flavoring agent in tonic water beverages. It has historical medicinal use for malaria but is now consumed mainly in beverages at low doses.
12378.benefits: Provides bitter flavor characteristic of tonic water
12378.risks: Potential for hypersensitivity reactions and rare serious adverse effects at high doses, photosensitivity, possible cardiac effects in overdose, ingestion toxicity at supratherapeutic levels

12471.name: Black Tea Extract
12471.description: Concentrated extract derived from black tea leaves containing polyphenols and caffeine.
12471.benefits: Source of antioxidants, may support antioxidant activity
12471.risks: Irritation or sensitization on skin contact in sensitive individuals, potential caffeine-related effects if ingested in large amounts

12897.name: Natural Flavourings including Quinine
12897.description: Natural flavourings are chemically extracted compounds derived from plant or animal sources, labeled as 'natural' but often highly processed and non-specific. Quinine is a bitter alkaloid extracted from the bark of the cinchona tree, commonly used as a flavoring in tonic water and classified as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) by the FDA for limited use in beverages.
12897.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain undisclosed solvents or carriers, possible allergenic compounds, excessive quinine intake may cause cinchonism (nausea, tinnitus, visual disturbances), not suitable for pregnancy in high doses

12898.name: Sodium Saccharin
12898.description: Synthetic non-nutritive sweetener used to provide sweetness without calories.
12898.benefits: Calorie-free sweetness, useful for sugar reduction and diabetes management
12898.risks: Potential allergenic reactions, controversies about carcinogenicity though low risk at approved levels, not metabolized by body

12986.name: Calcium beta-Hydroxy-beta-Methylbutyrate Monohydrate (HMB-Ca)
12986.description: Calcium is an essential mineral important for bone health, muscle function, and nerve transmission. Present at 2 mg/L concentration.
12986.benefits: Supports bone mineralization, muscle contraction, nerve signaling
12986.risks: None at typical dietary or environmental concentrations

13192.name: Orange Blossom
13192.description: Orange blossom refers to the fragrant flower of the orange tree (Citrus aurantium), commonly used in culinary applications as a flavoring or garnish, and in traditional medicine and aromatherapy. Orange blossom water is also a byproduct of distilling these flowers. As a minimally processed, plant-based ingredient, it is generally considered safe for food use and is not classified as an additive requiring FDA GRAS status when used in traditional forms.
13192.benefits: Contains flavonoids and antioxidants, aromatic compounds may support relaxation
13192.risks: Rare allergic reaction, potential pesticide exposure if not organic

13257.name: Seedless Raspberry Purée
13257.description: Purée made from raspberries, containing natural sugars, dietary fiber, vitamins, and antioxidants.
13257.benefits: Source of dietary fiber, vitamin C, antioxidants, natural flavoring
13257.risks: Irritation possible in sensitive individuals due to acidity, potential allergen in rare cases

13322.name: Organic Blackberry Flavor
13322.description: Organic blackberry flavor is a food ingredient comprised of volatile aromatic compounds isolated or synthesized to mimic the taste and aroma of blackberries. Even when labeled 'organic,' this ingredient is typically processed and lacks meaningful nutritional content. The 'flavor' designation means it could include multiple substances besides direct extracts, often utilizing organic carriers and solvents.
13322.risks: Lack of transparency, ultra-processed, may mask use of synthetic carriers, no nutritional value

13357.name: INS 331iii (Trisodium Citrate)
13357.description: Trisodium citrate, designated as INS 331(iii), is the trisodium salt of citric acid. It is widely used as a food additive for its buffering, anticoagulant, and preservative properties. Recognized as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) by the FDA, it is commonly found in processed foods and beverages for pH regulation and flavor enhancement.
13357.benefits: Regulates acidity, enhances stability, extends shelf life, generally recognized as safe
13357.risks: Excessive intake may cause mild gastrointestinal upset, very rare allergic reactions

13396.name: Organic Blood Orange Juice from Concentrate
13396.description: Organic blood orange juice from concentrate is produced by removing water from organic blood orange juice and later reconstituting it with water, allowing for easier storage and transport. Blood oranges are a variety of citrus known for their high vitamin C and antioxidant anthocyanin content. The concentrate process may slightly reduce some volatile compounds and nutrient density compared to fresh juice, but it generally retains most of its nutritional value. 'Organic' labeling indicates production without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. This ingredient is regarded as safe (GRAS) by the FDA.

13400.name: Organic Black Carrot Juice from Concentrate
13400.description: Juice derived from black carrots concentrated by removal of water; contains anthocyanins and natural sugars.
13400.benefits: Source of anthocyanin antioxidants, natural colorant, provides vitamins and minerals found in black carrots
13400.risks: Potential allergenicity, natural sugars contributing to caloric intake, risk of oxidative instability due to anthocyanins

13425.name: Grapefruit Juice Concentrate
