13425.description: Concentrated form of grapefruit juice obtained by removing water content, used for flavor and sweetness.
13425.benefits: Provides natural flavor and sweetness, source of vitamin C and antioxidants
13425.risks: Potential interaction with certain medications due to furanocoumarins, possible allergen, minor irritation in sensitive individuals

14069.name: Mandarin Flavor
14069.description: Mandarin flavor typically refers to an artificial or natural flavoring compound formulated to mimic the taste of mandarin oranges. Most commercial products use a combination of natural extracts and synthetic chemicals that are not disclosed in detail. These flavors are highly processed, can contain solvents or carriers, and are regulated by agencies such as the FDA but do not provide nutritional value. Labeling is often vague, and the actual source and formulation are rarely transparent to consumers.
14069.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

14171.name: Soursop Juice
14171.description: Juice extracted from the fruit of Annona muricata (soursop), consumed as a beverage.
14171.benefits: Source of vitamin C and antioxidants, hydrating beverage
14171.risks: Potential neurotoxicity from annonacin with excessive consumption, possible allergic reactions, microbial contamination risk if not pasteurized

14196.name: Kale Powder
14196.description: Dehydrated and powdered form of kale, a leafy green vegetable rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants.
14196.benefits: High in vitamins A, C, K, antioxidants, dietary fiber, supports nutrient intake
14196.risks: Potential oxalate content affecting kidney stone risk in susceptible individuals, possible pesticide residues depending on cultivation

14234.name: Anthocyanins
14234.description: Water-soluble pigments found in many fruits and vegetables responsible for red, purple, and blue colors.
14234.risks: Rare allergenicity, generally low irritation potential

14316.name: Natural Caffeine (Green Coffee Beans)
14316.description: Caffeine is a central nervous system stimulant naturally found in green coffee beans. It is used to increase alertness and reduce fatigue.
14316.benefits: Increased alertness, cognitive performance enhancement, mild metabolic stimulation
14316.risks: Irritation at high doses, potential for dependence, sleep disruption with excessive intake

14334.name: Natural Identical Soursop Flavor
14334.description: Natural identical soursop flavor refers to flavor compounds chemically synthesized to be molecularly identical to those found in natural soursop fruit (Annona muricata). Used in processed foods and beverages to mimic the taste of soursop, these are not extracted directly from the fruit but rather created from other natural or synthetic sources. Often grouped with flavor additives, these undergo processing and may include solvents, carriers, or emulsifiers.
14334.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain ultra-processed compounds, potential presence of solvents or carriers, no nutritional value

14347.name: Pineapple Syrup
14347.description: Pineapple syrup is a sweetened liquid made by combining pineapple juice or concentrate with added sugar and sometimes preservatives or stabilizers. It is used as a sweetener and flavor enhancer in beverages, desserts, and processed foods. Pineapple syrup is not considered a whole food and is typically a source of added sugars. It is regarded as safe for consumption (GRAS) by the FDA when used in typical food amounts.
14347.risks: High in added sugars, may contribute to increased calorie intake, potential for increased risk of obesity and metabolic disease when consumed in excess

14382.name: Organic Black Currant Juice Concentrate
14382.description: Concentrated extract of black currant fruit, typically rich in vitamin C, anthocyanins, and other antioxidants.

14449.name: Ammonium Hydrogen Carbonate
14449.description: Ammonium hydrogen carbonate is a leavening agent used in baking to release carbon dioxide and cause dough to rise.
14449.benefits: Effective leavening agent that promotes dough rising
14449.risks: Irritation to respiratory tract and mucous membranes from inhalation of dust, potential allergen cross-contact with sesame traces

14450.name: Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances
14450.description: Compounds used to impart flavor, either extracted from natural sources or chemically synthesized to be identical to natural flavors.
14450.risks: Potential allergenicity, irritation, lack of transparency, ultra-processed, unknown solvents or additives

14495.name: Natural Flavor Identical to Passion Fruit
14495.description: This term refers to a chemically synthesized flavoring compound that replicates the taste profile of passion fruit. Although labeled 'natural', such flavors may be produced via chemical processes and may include solvents, preservatives, or carrier agents. These ingredients are regulated for safety (FDA GRAS) but lack transparency regarding their precise composition and source.
14495.risks: Lack of transparency, may include solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, potential for allergic reactions, no nutritional value

14547.name: Plant-Based Mineral Calcium
14547.description: Calcium is a mineral essential for bone structure, muscle function, nerve transmission, and intracellular signaling.
14547.benefits: Supports bone health, muscle function, nerve transmission
14547.risks: Excessive intake can lead to kidney stones or impaired absorption of other minerals

14568.name: Organic Vegetable Juice Color
14568.description: Coloring agent derived from concentrated organic vegetable juices, used to impart natural color to food products.
14568.benefits: Natural source of color, minimal processing, may contain minor nutrients
14568.risks: Allergic reactions possible in sensitive individuals, potential for variability in color stability

14586.name: Shiitake (Lentinula edodes)
14586.description: An edible mushroom widely used in Asian cuisine (also spelled “shiitake”). It contains beta-glucans (notably lentinan) and the alkaloid eritadenine, as well as B vitamins and minerals. UV-exposed shiitake can be a dietary source of vitamin D2. As a conventional food, shiitake is generally recognized as safe when properly cooked.
14586.benefits: Rich in polysaccharides which may support immune function, antioxidant properties, source of B vitamins and copper, contains lentinan with potential anti-inflammatory and antitumor effects
14586.risks: Rare allergic reactions, rare shiitake dermatitis (skin rash when consumed raw or undercooked)

14667.name: Blackcurrant
14667.description: Blackcurrant is a berry fruit known for high levels of vitamin C, polyphenols, and anthocyanins. It is consumed as fresh fruit, juice, or extracts.
14667.benefits: Rich source of antioxidants, vitamin C, may support immune function, provides dietary fiber
14667.risks: Potential allergen, possible gastrointestinal irritation with excessive consumption

14912.name: Lychee Juice
14912.description: Lychee juice is the liquid extracted from the lychee fruit (Litchi chinensis), typically consumed as a beverage or used in culinary applications. It is rich in vitamin C, antioxidants, and provides natural sugars. Lychee and its juice are considered generally safe and are recognized as food worldwide, with no GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe) issues according to the FDA for traditional fruit juice use.
14912.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, contains polyphenols and antioxidants, may support immune function
14912.risks: High in natural sugars, possible allergic reactions (rare), potential hypoglycin A toxicity from unripe fruit (rare in juice)

15085.name: Polypropylene
15085.description: Thermoplastic polymer widely used in packaging, textiles, automotive components, and consumer goods.
15085.benefits: Durable, chemical resistant, lightweight, low cost material with broad industrial and consumer applications
15085.risks: Potential inhalation of microplastics or degradation fumes during high heat processing, very low dermal and ingestion toxicity in typical use, environmental persistence

15254.name: Lime Juice from Concentrate
15254.description: Juice from limes that has been evaporated to remove water, concentrating flavor and acidity. Used primarily for flavoring and acidification.
15254.benefits: Provides natural acidity and flavor, source of vitamin C and flavonoids with antioxidant properties
15254.risks: Irritation risk to skin and mucous membranes in concentrated form, possible allergen. Potential dental enamel erosion with excessive ingestion.

15433.name: Polyurethane
15433.description: A synthetic polymer used in coatings, adhesives, foams, and elastomers for its durability and flexibility.
15433.benefits: Strong, flexible, durable material with wide industrial application
15433.risks: Potential irritant and sensitizer on skin contact, respiratory sensitization risk during aerosol or dust exposure, possible contamination with residual isocyanates during manufacturing

15528.name: Natural Orange Flavouring
15528.description: Flavoring derived from orange peel or juice, used to impart citrus aroma and taste. Typically contains complex mixtures of volatile compounds.
15528.risks: Irritant/sensitizer potential, allergen risk especially in sensitive individuals

15636.name: Organic Watermelon Juice Concentrate
15636.description: Organic watermelon juice concentrate is produced by removing water from organic watermelon juice, resulting in a denser, sweeter liquid often used as a natural sweetener or flavoring in foods and beverages. It provides natural sugars, some vitamins, and phytonutrients like lycopene. As a concentrate from organic watermelon, it retains many beneficial plant compounds but is more calorie-dense and less hydrating than fresh watermelon. Recognized as safe for consumption by regulatory agencies such as the FDA when derived from safe handling and organic sources.
15636.benefits: Contains natural antioxidants, source of vitamins (notably vitamin C), contains lycopene and citrulline, organic source with less exposure to synthetic pesticides
15636.risks: High natural sugar content, increased calorie density when overconsumed

15662.name: Permitted Class II Preservatives (INS 211)
15662.description: Also known as sodium benzoate, a widely used food preservative to inhibit microbial growth and extend shelf life.
15662.benefits: Effective antimicrobial preservative, extends shelf life of food products
15662.risks: Potential irritant, possible formation of benzene under certain conditions, concerns about hyperactivity in children, ingestion toxicity at high doses

15782.name: Coconut Acid
15782.description: Mixture of fatty acids derived from coconut oil, commonly used as a mild surfactant or cleansing agent in cleaning products.
15782.benefits: Biodegradable, effective mild surfactant, derived from natural sources, low toxicity
15782.risks: Mild skin irritation in sensitive individuals, eye irritation at concentrated exposure

15839.name: Natural Orange Mango Flavor
15839.description: Natural Orange Mango Flavor refers to flavoring compounds derived or synthesized to mimic the taste and aroma of orange and mango. These are typically mixtures of extracts, oils, or chemically isolated aromatic compounds, which may include a wide range of undisclosed carriers, solvents, or preservatives. While 'natural' indicates origin from plant or animal sources, processing often involves physical and chemical extraction steps. The FDA considers natural flavors as Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS), but their ingredient transparency and nutritional value are minimal.
15839.risks: Lack of transparency, ultra-processed, may contain solvents or preservatives, potential for allergenic byproducts, no nutritional value

16154.name: Polymethyl Methacrylate
16154.description: Polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) is a synthetic polymer commonly used as a plastic and resin, also known as acrylic, acrylic glass, or Plexiglas. In the context of food and nutrition, PMMA is not a food ingredient but has occasional use in non-edible applications such as food packaging, medical devices, and dental materials. It is not recognized as safe for human ingestion and is not listed as Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS) by the FDA for food use.
16154.risks: Not intended for ingestion, potential toxicity if ingested, chemical contamination, not GRAS for food use

16235.name: Pear Juice
16235.description: Juice extracted from pears, commonly used as a flavoring and sweetener in food and beverage products.
16235.benefits: Source of natural sugars, provides flavor enhancement

16532.name: Ethylene Vinyl Acetate
16532.description: Ethylene Vinyl Acetate (EVA) is a synthetic copolymer often used in food processing equipment, packaging, and sometimes as a coating for food-contact surfaces. It is not a food ingredient but may migrate into foods from packaging materials. EVA is evaluated by food safety authorities for its use in indirect food contact, and the FDA recognizes certain forms of EVA as generally safe under specific conditions, but concerns remain over potential leaching of additives or monomers.
16532.risks: Potential migration of chemical additives, possible exposure to vinyl acetate monomer, ultra-processed, not a food ingredient

16560.name: Wasser
16560.description: Water, essential for hydration and a universal solvent in food preparation.
16560.benefits: Hydration, solvent for food ingredients, essential for life

16859.name: Beech Tree Spirit Essence
16859.description: A 'flower essence' preparation typically made by sun-infusing beech (Fagus sylvatica) blossoms in water and preserving the dilute solution with ethanol (brandy). Marketed within Bach flower remedies, it contains negligible measurable phytochemicals and is not a nutrient. It is not FDA GRAS for use as a food ingredient and is sold as a homeopathic/alternative remedy; randomized trials and systematic reviews find no efficacy beyond placebo.
16859.risks: Lack of proven efficacy, misleading or non-evidence-based claims, ethanol exposure (concern for children, pregnancy, alcohol-sensitive individuals), potential delay of effective treatment

16936.name: Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET)
16936.description: PET is a synthetic thermoplastic polyester used for food and beverage packaging (bottles, containers). It is not a food ingredient but an FDA- and EFSA-approved food-contact material (indirect additive). Under typical use, overall migration is low and within regulatory limits, though heat and prolonged storage can increase migration of certain compounds.
16936.risks: Potential antimony migration from catalyst, increased leaching with heat and prolonged storage, possible estrogenic activity signals in bottled water (inconsistent evidence), microplastic/nanoplastic shedding and exposure (health effects under investigation), potential taste/odor from acetaldehyde at high temperatures

16952.name: Rum
16952.description: Fermented and distilled alcoholic beverage typically made from sugarcane byproducts, containing ethanol.
16952.benefits: None at typical use levels for non-beverage applications
16952.risks: Ingestion toxicity due to ethanol, potential for acute and chronic alcohol-related harm, risk of addiction

17165.name: Cherry Puree
17165.description: Purée made from cherries, providing flavor and natural fruit solids typically used as a food ingredient.
17165.benefits: Source of natural sugars, antioxidants such as anthocyanins, and vitamins
17165.risks: Low risk of allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential for mild gastrointestinal upset in excessive amounts

17370.name: Calcium Acetate
17370.description: Calcium acetate is a calcium salt of acetic acid used as a buffering agent, sequestrant, and stabilizer in cleaning products. It is generally considered safe with low toxicity and mild irritant potential.
17370.benefits: Buffering agent, calcium source for stability, low toxicity, biodegradable
17370.risks: Mild skin irritation at high concentrations, eye irritation in concentrated form

17473.name: Organic Peach Flavor
17473.description: Organic peach flavor refers to flavoring derived from organic peaches. It is used to impart the taste and aroma of peaches in food products. Though labeled as organic, these flavors can still go through extensive processing, including extraction and concentration.
17473.risks: Ultra-processed, potential lack of transparency in ingredient sourcing and processing

17527.name: Niacin (Vitamin B-3)
17527.description: Niacin, also known as vitamin B3, essential nutrient involved in energy metabolism and DNA repair.
17527.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, skin health, and nervous system function
17527.risks: High doses may cause flushing and gastrointestinal discomfort

17662.name: Reverse Osmosis Sparkling Water
17662.description: Reverse osmosis sparkling water is purified water that has undergone reverse osmosis to remove impurities and ions, followed by carbonation to add effervescence. Reverse osmosis is a filtration process that effectively removes contaminants, making the water cleaner and with reduced mineral content.

17941.name: Artesian Spring Water
17941.description: Water sourced from an artesian aquifer, which is a confined underground layer of water-bearing permeable rock, rock fractures, or unconsolidated materials. It is usually naturally filtered and often contains minerals picked up as it travels through the aquifer.
17941.benefits: Natural hydration source, often contains natural minerals

17964.name: Beta Carotene Powder
17964.description: A carotenoid pigment and precursor of vitamin A, commonly used as a dietary supplement and food colorant.
17964.benefits: Provitamin A activity, antioxidant properties, supports vision and immune function
17964.risks: Potential for carotenodermia at high intake, possible increased lung cancer risk in smokers and asbestos-exposed individuals, photosensitivity

18245.name: Mountain Spring Water
18245.description: Mountain spring water is naturally sourced water that flows from underground springs located in mountainous areas. Known for its mineral content, it is often preferred for its purported purity and refreshing taste. However, its composition can vary based on the spring's location. It is generally considered safe by health authorities, including the FDA.

18379.name: Pasteurized 100% Carbonated Apple Juice from U.S. Grown Fresh Organic Apples
18379.description: A beverage made by carbonating apple juice that has been pasteurized to kill harmful bacteria and increase shelf life. It uses apples grown organically in the U.S., ensuring minimal pesticide use and a focus on sustainable farming practices.
18379.benefits: Source of vitamins and minerals, source of antioxidants, no added sugars

18400.name: Lemon Balm
18400.description: Herbal extract from Melissa officinalis leaves with culinary and traditional uses.
18400.benefits: Mild calming effect, culinary flavoring, antioxidant content
18400.risks: Mild skin irritation or allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, rare gastrointestinal upset if ingested in large amounts

18526.name: Korean Red Ginseng Root Powder
18526.description: Korean Red Ginseng Root Powder is derived from the root of the Panax ginseng plant, often used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. It is known for its potential to enhance energy, reduce fatigue, and boost the immune system. Korean Red Ginseng is generally recognized as safe by regulatory bodies like the FDA in appropriate doses.
18526.benefits: Boost immune function, improve mental performance, reduce fatigue, enhance physical performance
18526.risks: Potential interactions with medications, may affect blood sugar levels, headache, digestive upset

18617.name: Purified Reverse Osmosis De-Ionized Carbon Filtered Water
18617.description: This is purified water that has undergone multiple processes including reverse osmosis, de-ionization, and carbon filtration to remove contaminants and impurities. It is generally safe for consumption and used in various applications requiring high purity water.

18992.name: Sparkling Purified Water
18992.description: Sparkling purified water is water that has undergone filtration to remove impurities and then carbonation to add effervescence. It provides hydration without any calories or sugars. Sparkling water is considered to be a healthy alternative to sugary sodas, and it can be consumed without health concerns.

19547.name: Tangerine Juice from Concentrate
19547.description: Tangerine juice from concentrate is juice that has been concentrated by removing the water content and then reconstituted with water before packaging. The process may involve heating and filtration, which can affect nutrient levels compared to fresh juice. It is often used as a base in beverages and food products for its flavor and vitamin content.
19547.benefits: Good source of vitamin C, contains antioxidants
19547.risks: Potential nutrient loss during processing, high in natural sugars

19559.name: Australian Grass-fed Hydrolysed Bovine Collagen Peptides
19559.description: Hydrolysed bovine collagen peptides are derived from the connective tissues of cattle, specifically those that have been grass-fed in Australia. This form of collagen is broken down into smaller peptides for improved bioavailability. It is commonly used for its purported benefits to skin, joint, and bone health.
19559.benefits: Improves skin elasticity, supports joint health, may improve bone density

19896.name: E445 (Glycerol Esters of Wood Rosin)
19896.description: A food additive derived from wood rosin combined with glycerol; used primarily as a stabilizer and emulsifier in beverages such as citrus-flavored sodas.
19896.benefits: Provides emulsion stabilization, improves cloud stability in beverages
19896.risks: Potential allergenicity, irritation in sensitive individuals, minor gastrointestinal discomfort at high intake, processing-related impurities

19936.name: Acerola Extract
19936.description: Acerola extract is derived from the acerola cherry, which is rich in vitamin C and other antioxidants. It is often used in dietary supplements and functional foods for its potential immune-boosting and antioxidant properties. It is generally considered safe and is often included in food products under the FDA's GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe) status.
19936.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, antioxidant properties, potential immune-boosting effects

20184.name: Fruit Juice
20184.description: Liquid extracted from fruits, used primarily as a flavoring and coloring agent.
20184.benefits: Natural source of flavor and color, may contain vitamins and antioxidants depending on fruit type
20184.risks: Potential sugar content, minor allergen risk depending on fruit source

20394.name: Carbonated Mineral Water
20394.description: Carbonated mineral water is natural water that contains minerals, such as calcium, magnesium, and sodium, and has carbonation added either naturally or artificially to make it fizzy. It is often consumed as a refreshing beverage and can be used as a mixer in various drinks. The water retains its natural mineral content, which can vary depending on the source.
20394.benefits: Provides essential minerals like calcium and magnesium, may aid in digestion
20394.risks: Mild digestive discomfort if consumed in excess, potential dental enamel erosion

20482.name: Potassium Sulfate
20482.description: Potassium sulfate is an inorganic compound commonly used as a fertilizer to provide potassium and sulfur. In the context of food and dietary products, potassium is an essential mineral that plays a critical role in maintaining electrolyte balance, nerve transmission, and muscle contraction.
20482.benefits: Electrolyte balance, nerve transmission support, muscle contraction support

20685.name: Natural Flavouring
20685.description: Complex mixtures of volatile compounds extracted from natural sources to impart flavor. Composition often undisclosed and may include solvents or processing aids.
20685.risks: Lack of transparency, possible residual solvents, ultra-processed ingredient, no nutritional value

20758.name: Fruit Juice Concentrate
20758.description: Concentrated fruit juice used primarily as a colorant and sweetener derived from the reduction of fruit juice content.
20758.benefits: Natural source of color and flavor, can replace synthetic colorants and sweeteners
20758.risks: Possible allergen presence from source fruits, increased sugar content (fructose), potential for contributing to caloric intake

20829.name: Natural Cucumber Flavouring
20829.description: Natural Cucumber Flavouring likely refers to a flavor extract derived from cucumbers or artificially manipulated to mimic cucumber flavor. It falls under the broader category of natural flavors, which are often chemically extracted and highly processed. This makes it difficult to ascertain the exact nature of the ingredients used.
20829.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

20913.name: Strawberry Juice Concentrate
20913.description: Concentrated juice derived from strawberries, used primarily as a flavoring and colorant in food products.
20913.benefits: Provides natural flavor and color, contains antioxidants such as vitamin C and polyphenols
20913.risks: Possible allergen for individuals sensitive to strawberries, minor risk of irritation or sensitization in sensitive individuals

21850.name: Acai
21850.description: Berry fruit from the acai palm, rich in antioxidants, fiber, and micronutrients. Used as a food ingredient and supplement.
21850.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, dietary fiber, and micronutrients, supports antioxidant intake and dietary diversity
21850.risks: Potential allergen, contamination risk from improper processing, gastrointestinal upset in sensitive individuals

22027.name: Orange Oil
22027.description: Essential oil extracted from orange peel, primarily used for flavoring and fragrance.
22027.benefits: Provides natural citrus flavor and aroma, used as a flavoring agent and fragrance
22027.risks: Skin sensitization, phototoxicity, respiratory irritation if inhaled in high concentrations

22073.name: Fulvic Minerals
22073.description: Fulvic minerals are a group of natural compounds found in humus, the organic component of soil, resulting from the decomposition of plant and animal materials. They contain fulvic acid, which is touted for its ability to boost nutrient absorption, detoxification, and antioxidant activity, although scientific evidence supporting these claims is limited. Fulvic minerals are not officially designated as a nutrient or dietary supplement by major health organizations like the FDA.
22073.benefits: May enhance nutrient absorption, antioxidant potential
22073.risks: Potential heavy metal contamination, limited scientific evidence on health benefits

22456.name: Black Carrot
22456.description: Black carrot (Daucus carota) is a root vegetable known for its deep purple to black color, which is due to high levels of anthocyanins and other polyphenols. It is used both as a natural food colorant and for its potential health benefits. The nutrient profile includes vitamins, fibers, and antioxidants, with studies indicating its antioxidant potential and contributions to reducing oxidative stress.
22456.benefits: Rich in anthocyanins, antioxidant properties, potential reduction in oxidative stress

22473.name: Cranberry Juice
22473.description: Cranberry juice is made by pressing cranberries to extract their juice. It is often consumed for its potential health benefits and tart flavor. Commercial versions may be sweetened or diluted. It is a source of vitamin C and several antioxidants. The FDA does not regulate it as a health supplement, but as a food product. Naturally, it contains no added sugars, preservatives, or artificial ingredients.
22473.benefits: May reduce the risk of urinary tract infections, contains antioxidants, supports cardiovascular health
22473.risks: Possible sugar content in commercial products, potential interactions with medications

22708.name: Organic Yogurt Flavor
22708.description: Generally, 'organic yogurt flavor' refers to a mixture of compounds that are used to impart a yogurt-like taste to food products. While being labeled as organic suggests adherence to certain agricultural standards, the specific composition of flavorings is often not disclosed, which limits transparency.
22708.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed

22765.name: Red Radish Juice Concentrate
22765.description: Red radish juice concentrate is a condensed form of the juice extracted from red radishes. It is often used for its natural color and flavor. Red radishes are a source of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants such as anthocyanins, which might contribute to health benefits. The concentration process reduces the water content, thus intensifying the natural components present in the radishes.
22765.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, source of vitamins and minerals, natural colorant

22817.name: Polyethylene
22817.description: A synthetic polymer commonly used as a plastic material in packaging and containers.
22817.benefits: Durable, chemically inert, widely used in packaging and containers
22817.risks: Persistence in environment, potential microplastic contamination

22855.name: Cannabis Extract
22855.description: Cannabis extract is a concentrated form of cannabis plant components, including cannabinoids like THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) and CBD (cannabidiol). It is used in various forms for medicinal, therapeutic, and recreational purposes. Legal status and formulation can vary widely. Health implications differ based on cannabinoid concentration and usage method.
22855.benefits: Pain relief, anti-inflammatory properties, anxiety reduction, potential epilepsy treatment
22855.risks: Addiction potential, cognitive impairment, legal issues, psychoactive effects (if THC present), altered heart rate

23125.name: Panakos Deep Seawater Hypertonic Ultra Pure Natural Marine Electrolytes
23125.description: A hypertonic seawater product sourced from the Gulf of California, which contains marine electrolytes. It is marketed for hydration and mineral replenishment purposes. The product is considered ultra-processed but not synthetic. It contains various minerals, typically found in seawater, which can support electrolyte balance in the body.
23125.benefits: May help maintain electrolyte balance if consumed in appropriate amounts
23125.risks: High sodium content, could lead to electrolyte imbalance if over-consumed, not advisable for individuals with kidney problems

23126.name: Seawater from Sea of Cortez
23126.description: Seawater from the Sea of Cortez is reported to be rich in essential minerals and trace elements. It is sometimes used in health and wellness products. However, the consumption of untreated seawater is not recommended due to the high salt concentration.
23126.benefits: Source of minerals and trace elements
23126.risks: High salt content, potential contamination, gastrointestinal discomfort

23128.name: Bicarbonate
23128.description: Bicarbonate commonly refers to sodium bicarbonate, used as a leavening agent in foods, an acid neutralizer, and pH buffer.
23128.benefits: Leavening agent in baking, acid neutralizer, pH buffer
23128.risks: Irritation if inhaled as dust, ingestion of large amounts may cause alkalosis, sodium intake contribution

23221.name: Natural Vegan Flavour
23221.description: This is a flavoring agent labeled as both natural and vegan, typically made from plant-based sources. Despite its natural origin, the specific components are often not disclosed, and it might include processed compounds or additives to achieve desired flavor profiles.
23221.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain hidden additives, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

23285.name: Electrolyte-Infused Water
23285.description: Electrolyte-infused water is purified water that has been enhanced with minerals such as potassium, sodium, and magnesium to help replenish electrolytes lost during physical activity. The water described is further purified through a multi-step filtration process and has an alkaline pH of 7.5 or higher, which is marketed to improve hydration and balance body pH, although scientific evidence supporting pH claims is limited.
23285.benefits: May aid in hydration, replenishes lost electrolytes

23354.name: Green Tea Essence
23354.description: Green tea essence is derived from green tea leaves and contains a concentrated form of green tea's active compounds, including catechins, caffeine, and antioxidants. It is often used for flavoring in foods and beverages and can provide health benefits similar to those of green tea.
23354.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, may improve brain function, may aid in fat burning, may lower the risk of some chronic diseases
23354.risks: Caffeine sensitivity, potential liver toxicity in high doses

23521.name: Acid
23521.description: The term 'acid' is very broad and unspecific. In the context of food, it could refer to various acids like citric acid, lactic acid, acetic acid, etc., which are commonly used as preservatives, flavor enhancers, or pH regulators. The specific properties, benefits, and risks of an 'acid' will vary widely depending on which acid is being referenced.

23772.name: Fermented Grape Juice Concentrate
23772.description: Fermented grape juice concentrate is a processed product made by fermenting grape juice and then concentrating the liquid. It is commonly used as a natural sweetener and flavoring in food products. The fermentation process primarily focuses on converting sugars present in the juice to alcohol and other compounds. However, during concentration, most of the alcohol is typically removed, leaving behind flavor and sweetness. Fermented grape juice and its concentrates share some of the antioxidant properties of grapes, attributed to their polyphenol content.
23772.risks: Possible high sugar content, potential allergic reactions, not suitable for individuals sensitive to alcohol traces

23792.name: Tart Cherry Juice
23792.description: Juice extracted from tart cherries, containing natural sugars, organic acids, and phytochemicals including anthocyanins and other antioxidants.
23792.benefits: Source of antioxidants, may support antioxidant status, provides vitamins and phytochemicals
23792.risks: High natural sugar content, potential gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals

23824.name: Natural Lemon and Lime Flavor
23824.description: Mixture of natural flavor compounds derived from lemon, lime, and other natural sources used to impart citrus aroma and taste.
23824.benefits: Provides citrus flavor and aroma to food products
23824.risks: Potential for allergic sensitization, variability in chemical composition, possible presence of naturally occurring irritants

23904.name: Peach Juice
23904.description: Peach juice is a natural fruit juice extracted from peaches, containing vitamins, antioxidants, and natural sugars. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA for consumption.
23904.benefits: Source of vitamins (such as vitamin C), antioxidants, hydration
23904.risks: Contains natural sugars which may impact blood sugar levels in excess

23934.name: White Tea
23934.description: White tea is a minimally processed Camellia sinensis leaf product containing polyphenols such as catechins and flavonoids.
23934.benefits: Antioxidant activity, potential cardiovascular support, contains bioactive polyphenols

24362.name: Carbonation
24362.description: Carbonation refers to the process of dissolving carbon dioxide gas in a liquid, which creates effervescence or bubbles in beverages. It is commonly used in soft drinks, sparkling water, and carbonated alcoholic beverages. Carbonation is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA.
24362.risks: Mild digestive discomfort, potential tooth enamel erosion, bloating

24394.name: Artificial Flavorings
24394.description: Synthetic chemical compounds used to imitate natural flavors in food products.
24394.benefits: Enhance flavor and palatability in processed foods
24394.risks: Potential allergen/sensitizer, ultra-processed, possible adverse reactions, lack of transparency in composition

24447.name: Certified Organic Vegetable Glycerin
24447.description: Certified organic vegetable glycerin is a colorless, odorless, sweet-tasting liquid derived from plant oils, typically palm, soybean, or coconut oil. It is used in food as a sweetener, preservative, or thickening agent. Being 'certified organic' indicates it is sourced from non-GMO plants and free from synthetic pesticides and fertilizers.
24447.benefits: Moisturizing properties in food and cosmetics, low glycemic index, might support hydration

24554.name: Organic Guava Juice
24554.description: Organic guava juice is derived from the guava fruit, which is organically grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. The juice contains vitamins, particularly vitamin C, as well as dietary fiber and antioxidants.
24554.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, contains antioxidants, provides dietary fiber, supports immune health

24590.name: Blood Orange Juice
24590.description: Blood orange juice is derived from the blood orange, a variety of citrus fruit known for its deep red flesh and distinct taste. It is rich in vitamin C, anthocyanins, and antioxidants. Blood oranges contribute to immune function, skin health, and may have anti-inflammatory properties. Generally regarded as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when consumed as part of a balanced diet.
24590.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, contains antioxidants, provides anthocyanins, potential anti-inflammatory effects
24590.risks: Possible allergic reactions in sensitive individuals

24691.name: Yeast
24691.description: Microorganisms used in food production for fermentation, leavening, and flavor development.
24691.benefits: Leavening agent in baking, fermentation for alcohol and flavor, source of B vitamins and proteins
24691.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, rare opportunistic infections in immunocompromised, potential contaminant byproducts if improperly processed

24728.name: Flavourings
24728.description: Substances used to impart taste or aroma to food products; can be natural or synthetic and often consist of complex mixtures.
24728.benefits: Enhance sensory appeal of foods, improve palatability
24728.risks: Potential for allergic reactions or sensitization, variability in chemical composition, possible presence of synthetic chemicals or contaminants

24745.name: Flavors
24745.description: Chemical compounds added to food to impart taste or aroma. Includes natural and artificial substances.
24745.benefits: Improves palatability and sensory appeal of food products
24745.risks: Lack of transparency, potential presence of synthetic chemicals, possible allergen or sensitizer, ultra-processed ingredient

24847.name: Organic Celtic Sea Salt
24847.description: Celtic Sea Salt is a type of sea salt that is less refined and often retains more trace minerals compared to common table salt. It is harvested from the coastal regions and involves minimal processing. It is generally used as a flavor enhancer and a source of sodium, essential for maintaining fluid balance and nerve function.
24847.benefits: Source of trace minerals, essential for fluid balance and nerve function

24871.name: Apple Juice from Concentrate
24871.description: Fruit juice reconstituted from concentrated apple juice, used as a sweetener and flavoring agent in beverages and foods.
24871.benefits: Source of natural sugars and some vitamins, provides flavor and palatability
24871.risks: High sugar content, potential contribution to caloric intake and dental caries, lack of dietary fiber compared to whole fruit

24903.name: Kohlensäure
24903.description: Carbonic acid (Kohlensäure) is the chemical formed when carbon dioxide dissolves in water, commonly used to carbonate beverages.
24903.benefits: Provides effervescence and tartness in carbonated drinks

24904.name: Citric Acid (Säuerungsmittel Citronensäure)
24904.description: Citric acid is a weak organic acid used primarily as an acidulant to regulate acidity in food products and beverages. It occurs naturally in citrus fruits.
24904.benefits: Acidity regulator, enhances flavor, preservative properties by chelating metals
24904.risks: Irritation potential at high concentrations, mild sensitization risk with repeated skin contact

24906.name: Antioxidationsmittel Ascorbinsäure (Ascorbic Acid)
24906.description: A water-soluble vitamin known as vitamin C, commonly used as an antioxidant to prevent oxidation and preserve food quality.
24906.benefits: Antioxidant, prevents oxidation, preserves color and flavor

24912.name: Caramel Color (E150d)
24912.description: A water-soluble food coloring produced by controlled heat treatment of carbohydrates with ammonia and sulfite compounds.
24912.benefits: Widely used colorant to provide brown coloration in foods and beverages
24912.risks: Potential presence of 4-methylimidazole (4-MEI), a possible carcinogen, regulatory limits in some jurisdictions, allergen cross-reactivity in sensitive individuals

24955.name: Red Tomato-Lycopene (Color)
24955.description: Lycopene is a natural pigment that gives tomatoes their red color and is used as a color additive in food products. It is generally considered safe and effective by the FDA and is also recognized for its antioxidant properties. Lycopene is naturally found in high amounts in tomatoes and other red fruits.
24955.benefits: Antioxidant properties, potential cardiovascular health benefits, potential reduction in prostate cancer risk

24971.name: Fruit Juices from Concentrate (Grape)
24971.description: Fruit juices from concentrate involve reconstituting concentrated juice with water. This process often reduces some vitamins and antioxidants found in fresh juice, but the product still retains a significant amount of natural sugars and calories. Grape juice from concentrate, specifically, is often used for its sweet flavor and color.
24971.benefits: Contains some vitamins and antioxidants, hydrating
24971.risks: High sugar content, potential loss of nutrients during processing, may contribute to weight gain if consumed in excess

24981.name: Glucose Syrup (Contains Sulphites)
24981.description: Glucose syrup is a liquid sweetener made from the hydrolysis of starch, commonly derived from corn, potatoes, wheat, or rice. It is primarily composed of glucose and used in foods to add sweetness and improve texture and shelf life. Sulphites are chemical compounds often added as preservatives to prolong shelf life and maintain the color of foods. While recognized as safe by the FDA, sulphites can cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.
24981.benefits: Adds sweetness, improves texture, prolongs shelf life
24981.risks: High glycemic index, potential allergic reactions to sulphites, contribution to overconsumption of sugars

25044.name: Fresh Pressed Lime Juice
25044.description: Juice from Citrus aurantifolia with citric acid and vitamin C content, used as acidulant and flavor ingredient.
25044.benefits: Provides vitamin C and natural flavor
25044.risks: Potential mucosal or skin irritation due to acidity if undiluted

25102.name: Coloring (Red 40 Lake)
25102.description: Synthetic azo dye used for coloring in food and cosmetics.
25102.risks: Irritation, potential hypersensitivity reactions, allergenic potential

25143.name: Sucre de canne roux
25143.description: Light brown cane sugar, a sucrose-rich sweetener derived from sugarcane with some residual molasses.
25143.benefits: Provides energy as a carbohydrate source
25143.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain, dental caries, contributors to metabolic disorders at high consumption levels

25216.name: Fruit and Plant Concentrates (Apple)
25216.description: Concentrated extracts from fruits and plants typically containing natural sugars, vitamins, and phytochemicals used for flavor and coloration.
25216.benefits: Natural flavoring, coloration, source of phytochemicals and antioxidants
25216.risks: Potential allergenicity, high sugar content if ingested in large amounts, possible pesticide residue if not purified, variable exposure depending on source

25346.name: Magnesium Ascorbate
25346.description: Compound combining magnesium and ascorbic acid (vitamin C) used as a mineral/antioxidant supplement and food additive.
25346.benefits: Provides bioavailable magnesium and vitamin C, supports antioxidant activity, immune function, and metabolic processes
25346.risks: High doses may cause gastrointestinal upset including diarrhea; possible minor irritation on skin or mucosa

25348.name: L-Theanine Powder
25348.description: L-Theanine is an amino acid commonly found in tea leaves and is often used as a dietary supplement. It is known for its calming effects and is generally considered safe. The FDA recognizes it as Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS) when used within certain limits.
25348.benefits: Promotes relaxation, reduces stress and anxiety, improves sleep quality, enhances cognitive performance

25349.name: Lemon Balm Powder
25349.description: Lemon balm powder is derived from the dried leaves of the lemon balm plant (Melissa officinalis). It is known for its mild lemon scent and has been used traditionally for its calming and soothing properties. Lemon balm is often used in natural remedies for anxiety and sleep disorders. It is recognized as safe (GRAS status) for use in food products.
25349.benefits: May reduce anxiety, improve sleep quality, enhance cognitive function, antioxidant properties
25349.risks: Possible allergic reactions, pregnancy and breastfeeding safety concerns

25360.name: Colour: Carotenes
25360.description: Carotenes are pigments naturally present in plants, commonly used as colorants in food products. They belong to the carotenoid family and are fat-soluble.
25360.benefits: Provides natural coloring, precursor to vitamin A contributing to nutritional value
25360.risks: None at typical use levels, possible skin discoloration at very high intake (carotenodermia)

25381.name: Monk Fruit Juice Concentrate
25381.description: Monk fruit (Siraitia grosvenorii) juice concentrate is derived from the fruit and is used as a natural sweetener. It doesn't contain calories or have an effect on blood sugar levels, making it a popular alternative to sugar for those managing weight or diabetes. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA.
25381.benefits: Low-calorie sweetener, does not affect blood sugar levels

25412.name: Other Natural Flavourings
25412.description: This term generally refers to a variety of naturally derived flavoring agents extracted from plants, herbs, spices, fruits, or other natural sources, but are processed to enhance or impart flavor to food products. The exact composition is often proprietary and not disclosed, leading to a lack of transparency in what these flavourings contain. They are often considered ultra-processed.
25412.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain processing residues, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

25458.name: Lychee Flavor
25458.description: Lychee flavoring is an artificial or natural additive used to impart the taste of lychee fruit in food products. It may be derived from natural sources or synthesized in laboratories, often under the umbrella term 'natural flavors.'
25458.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or preservatives, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

25582.name: Flavour
25582.description: General term for substances used to impart taste or aroma to foods; can include natural or synthetic compounds with possible chemical solvents or additives.
25582.benefits: Enhances taste and aroma of food products
25582.risks: Lack of transparency, potential presence of solvents, sensitization, ultra-processed

25684.name: Acidulante: Ácido Cítrico
25684.description: Citric acid is a weak organic acid used primarily as an antioxidant and acidulant in food products to preserve flavor and stability.
25684.benefits: Enhances shelf life by chelating metals and preventing oxidation, improves flavor by acidification
25684.risks: Mild skin and eye irritant at high concentrations, potential dental enamel erosion with excessive ingestion

25686.name: E414 (Acacia Gum)
25686.description: Natural gum obtained from the sap of Acacia trees, used as a stabilizer, emulsifier, and thickening agent in food products.
25686.risks: Rare allergic sensitization, potential contamination if improperly processed

25716.name: Gum Acacia
25716.description: Natural gum obtained from the sap of acacia trees, used as a stabilizer, emulsifier, and thickening agent in foods.
25716.risks: Possible mild allergen, may cause digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals

25838.name: Fragaria Vesca (Strawberry) Fruit Extract
25838.description: Fragaria Vesca, commonly known as wild strawberry, is a natural extract derived from the fruit of the strawberry plant. It is used for its antioxidant properties and pleasant aroma. The extract contains vitamins, polyphenols, and flavonoids, which contribute to its health benefits if consumed in significant amounts.
25838.benefits: Antioxidant properties, vitamin C content, polyphenols, potential anti-inflammatory effects

25881.name: Crystalline Fructose
25881.description: A monosaccharide sugar derived from corn, used as a sweetener in foods and beverages.
25881.benefits: Sweetening agent with high sweetness potency
25881.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain, metabolic disturbances, insulin resistance risk at high consumption

25975.name: FD&C Blue No. 1
25975.description: Synthetic blue dye used as a color additive in foods, drugs, and cosmetics.
25975.benefits: Provides blue color in food and cosmetic products, improves product appearance
25975.risks: Skin and eye irritation potential, hypersensitivity reactions in rare individuals, regulatory limits on use

26076.name: American Oak Extract
26076.description: American oak extract is derived from the wood of the American oak tree, often used in the food and beverage industry to impart flavors reminiscent of oak-aged products. It includes tannins and other phenolic compounds which contribute to its flavor profile. While generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA for use in food products, detailed scientific evaluation of its health effects is limited.

26140.name: Polystyrene
26140.description: Polystyrene is a synthetic aromatic polymer made from the monomer styrene, a liquid petrochemical. It is commonly used in packaging, disposable containers, and as an insulator in construction. It is not directly used as a food ingredient but can sometimes be in contact with food, such as in food packaging.
26140.risks: Potential styrene leaching, environmental pollution, not biodegradable

26143.name: Potassium Nitrate
26143.description: Potassium nitrate is an inorganic compound used primarily as a food preservative and curing agent, especially in processed meats.
26143.benefits: Preservative extending shelf life, inhibits growth of spoilage bacteria
26143.risks: Potential formation of carcinogenic nitrosamines under certain conditions, ingestion toxicity at high levels, regulatory restrictions on maximum allowable concentrations

26176.name: Peach Tea Powder
26176.description: Peach tea powder is a dehydrated form of peach-flavored tea, often consisting of black or green tea powder mixed with peach flavoring. While it might contain natural peach extract, the powder form typically involves additional ingredients for preservation and flavor enhancement.
26176.risks: May contain added sugars or artificial flavors, ultra-processed if additives are present

26178.name: Food Acid
26178.description: Food acids are substances added to food products to regulate their acidity or alkalinity. Common food acids include citric acid, acetic acid, and lactic acid. They play a role in flavor enhancement, preservation, and maintaining the food's structural integrity. The FDA generally recognizes many food acids as safe (GRAS) for consumption.
26178.benefits: Enhancement of flavor, preservation and shelf-life extension, pH stabilization
26178.risks: Potential tooth enamel erosion if consumed in excess, possible digestive discomfort

26187.name: Citric Acid (E330)
26187.description: Organic acid commonly used as a acidity regulator in food products to adjust pH and enhance flavor stability.
26187.benefits: pH control in foods, preservative effect by inhibiting microbial growth, flavor enhancement
26187.risks: Irritation to skin and eyes at high concentrations, potential dental enamel erosion with excessive ingestion

26344.name: Corn Starch-Modified
26344.description: A chemically modified starch derived from corn, used as a thickening agent and stabilizer in food products. The modification (acid treatment and heat) enhances its viscosity and stability under various processing conditions.
26344.benefits: Improves texture and stability in processed foods, heat and acid resistant thickener
26344.risks: Possible minor digestive intolerance in sensitive individuals, potential residual processing chemicals, ultra-processed ingredient

26350.name: Kaliumchlorid (Potassium Chloride)
26350.description: Potassium chloride is a chemical compound that is often used as a salt substitute in food products. It provides a salty flavor without the sodium, making it beneficial for individuals needing to manage their sodium intake for blood pressure concerns. It is recognized as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used in accordance with good manufacturing practices.
26350.benefits: Sodium reduction, provides essential potassium, can aid in maintaining electrolyte balance
26350.risks: Potential gastrointestinal irritation, hyperkalemia if consumed in excess

26455.name: D-Alpha-Tocopherol
26455.description: D-Alpha-Tocopherol is the natural, bioactive form of vitamin E, commonly used as an antioxidant in formulations to prevent oxidation and extend shelf life.
26455.benefits: Antioxidant properties, protects lipids from oxidation, extends product shelf life
26455.risks: Skin irritation and sensitization possible with topical use in some individuals, low oral toxicity at typical doses

26547.name: Broccoli Powder
26547.description: Powdered form of broccoli, providing concentrated nutrients and bioactive compounds including vitamins, minerals, and glucosinolates.
26547.benefits: Source of vitamins C, K, folate, antioxidants, and glucosinolates which may support detoxification processes
26547.risks: Possible mild digestive irritation in sensitive individuals, potential goitrogenic effects at very high intake due to glucosinolates

26698.name: Mango Juice from Concentrate
26698.description: Reconstituted mango juice made by adding water to concentrated mango juice, primarily used for flavor and sweetness.
26698.benefits: Provides natural flavor, source of vitamins (e.g., vitamin C) and antioxidants
26698.risks: High sugar content, possible processing residuals, potential allergen

26863.name: Schisandra Berry Powder
26863.description: Schisandra Berry, derived from the fruit of Schisandra chinensis plant, is traditionally used in Chinese medicine. It's utilized for its adaptogenic properties, which may help the body resist stressors. Schisandra Berry Powder is a concentrated form of the fruit, often used in supplements and herbal remedies.
26863.benefits: Antioxidant properties, may improve liver function, might reduce stress levels, potential cognitive benefits

26956.name: FD&C Red No. 40
26956.description: Synthetic azo dye used as a color additive in foods and cosmetics, often combined with flavoring agents to enhance product appeal.
26956.benefits: Provides vibrant red color for aesthetic purposes in food and cosmetic products
26956.risks: Potential allergenic/sensitization reactions in sensitive individuals, regulatory restrictions on use levels, contamination risk with aromatic amines during manufacturing

27002.name: Cyanocobalamin (Vitamin B12)
27002.description: Synthetic form of vitamin B12 used as a dietary supplement and fortificant to prevent or treat vitamin B12 deficiency.
27002.benefits: Prevents and treats vitamin B12 deficiency, supports red blood cell formation and nervous system function
27002.risks: None at typical supplemental doses, rare allergic reactions

27101.name: Pinene
27101.description: Pinene is a natural organic compound found in the oils of many coniferous trees, notably pine trees, and in other plant sources such as rosemary and basil. It is a monoterpene, responsible for the scent of pine forests, and is used as a fragrance and flavoring agent. In the body, pinene is known for its potential anti-inflammatory and bronchodilator effects.
27101.benefits: Anti-inflammatory properties, bronchodilator effects, antimicrobial effects
27101.risks: Possible allergic reactions, potential for irritation if used in high concentrations

27113.name: Citric Acid (preservative)
27113.description: A weak organic acid used as a preservative and pH adjuster in food and cosmetic products.
27113.benefits: Preservative properties, antioxidant effects, pH regulation
27113.risks: Irritation in sensitive individuals, potential erosive effects on dental enamel with frequent ingestion

27309.name: Other Natural Flavors
27309.description: Natural flavors are complex mixtures extracted from botanical sources using chemical solvents and processes that can alter the original compounds. While labeled as 'natural', they are highly processed and lack transparency regarding exact composition.
27309.risks: Lack of transparency, potential residual solvents, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

27398.name: Coconut Water Powder
27398.description: Dehydrated powder form of coconut water, containing electrolytes such as potassium, sodium, and magnesium. Used as a hydration aid and flavoring agent.
27398.benefits: Provides electrolytes for hydration, convenient shelf-stable source of coconut water nutrients
27398.risks: Potential for contamination if improperly processed, possible allergen for some individuals, sugar content depending on processing

27434.name: FD&C Red 40
27434.description: Synthetic azo dye used as a colorant in foods, drugs, and cosmetics.
27434.benefits: Colorant to improve visual appeal of products
27434.risks: Potential allergen, possible mild irritant, concerns about hyperactivity in children, regulatory restrictions in some countries

27520.name: Eau
27520.description: Water, used as a solvent or diluent in food products.

27529.name: Mint Extract
27529.description: An extract derived from mint leaves, commonly used for flavoring and fragrance.
27529.benefits: Flavoring agent, may have mild cooling sensation, contributes aroma
27529.risks: Irritation and sensitization in some individuals, especially with concentrated topical use

27593.name: Fructose Syrup
27593.description: A sweetener composed primarily of fructose used to enhance sweetness in foods and beverages.
27593.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain, insulin resistance, increased risk of metabolic disorders

27627.name: Magnesium Chloride Brine
27627.description: Magnesium chloride brine is a solution containing magnesium chloride in water. It is primarily used for de-icing roads and as a supplement to correct magnesium deficiency in the body. In terms of food use, it may act as a coagulant in the production of tofu and as a dietary supplement for magnesium, which is crucial for many bodily functions including muscle and nerve function, as well as bone health. Magnesium chloride is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used in accordance with good manufacturing practices.
27627.benefits: Corrects magnesium deficiency, supports muscle function, enhances bone health
27627.risks: Excessive intake can lead to hypermagnesemia, can cause digestive issues in high amounts

27948.name: Natural Colour
27948.description: Natural colour refers to color additives derived from natural sources like vegetables, fruits, minerals, or animals. They are used to enhance the appearance of food and beverages. The safety and composition of these colours depend on the specific source and processing methods.
27948.risks: Potential allergens, varying purity levels, possible contamination, ultra-processed

27992.name: Ginseng Root Extract
27992.description: Concentrated extract of ginseng root used for potential adaptogenic and antioxidant effects at low concentrations.
27992.benefits: Antioxidant potential, may support stress response, root bioactive compounds
27992.risks: Mild sensitization or irritant potential, possible interactions with medications at higher doses

28021.name: Allura Red
28021.description: Allura Red AC, also known as Red 40, is a synthetic red azo dye used in food and beverages to impart a red hue. It's commonly found in candies, beverages, and other processed foods. Allura Red is approved by the FDA and is considered generally recognized as safe (GRAS) when used according to approved guidelines. However, its safety has been the subject of debate due to studies showing potential adverse effects.
28021.risks: Allergic reactions, hyperactivity in children, potential carcinogenic effects

28347.name: FD&C Yellow No. 5
28347.description: Synthetic azo dye used as a colorant in foods and cosmetics to impart yellow color.
28347.benefits: Provides bright yellow color to products, stable in many formulations
28347.risks: Potential allergen and irritant, hypersensitivity reactions, possible hyperactivity in children, regulatory limits on use

28383.name: Grape Juice Concentrate
28383.description: Concentrated juice derived from grapes, often used as a sweetener or flavoring agent in food products.
28383.benefits: Provides natural sugars and flavor, source of phytochemicals including polyphenols
28383.risks: High sugar content may contribute to excessive caloric intake, dental caries risk

28890.name: Brilliant Blue FCF (E133)
28890.description: A synthetic blue dye used as a colorant in foods and beverages to impart bright blue color.
28890.benefits: Color additive to improve appearance and consumer acceptance of food and beverages
28890.risks: Possible mild allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential behavioral effects in children in combination with other food dyes

28915.name: Kiwi Juice Concentrate
28915.description: Concentrated juice derived from kiwi fruit, used primarily as a flavoring and natural sweetener in food products.
28915.benefits: Natural flavoring agent, source of vitamins and antioxidants
28915.risks: Potential allergen, minor irritation risk in sensitive individuals

29283.name: Indian Gooseberry Extract
29283.description: Indian Gooseberry, also known as Amla, is a fruit native to India and is used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine. The extract is rich in Vitamin C, polyphenols, and other antioxidants. It is believed to promote overall health, enhance antioxidant defense, and offer anti-inflammatory properties.
29283.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, high Vitamin C content, supports immune function, may reduce inflammation, potential blood sugar regulation, promotes heart health

29288.name: Colour (Lycopene)
29288.description: Lycopene is a natural pigment from the carotenoid family, responsible for the red color in tomatoes, watermelons, and other red fruits. It is commonly used as a natural colorant in foods and has antioxidant properties. Lycopene is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA and has been studied for its potential health benefits.
29288.benefits: Antioxidant properties, potential cardiovascular health benefits, possible cancer risk reduction

29377.name: Strawberry Juice
29377.description: Juice extracted from strawberries, containing water-soluble vitamins, natural sugars, and antioxidants.
29377.benefits: Source of vitamin C, antioxidants, and flavoring
29377.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, sugar content concerns in excessive intake

29529.name: Mango Juice Concentrate
29529.description: Concentrated juice derived from mango fruit, used as a flavoring and sweetening agent in food products.
29529.benefits: Provides natural flavor and sweetness, contains some vitamins and antioxidants
29529.risks: High sugar content, potential allergen in sensitive individuals

29578.name: Toluene
29578.description: Toluene is a clear, colorless liquid with a distinctive smell, derived from petroleum or coal tar sources. It is primarily used in industrial applications as a solvent for paints, coatings, and chemical reactions. In food packaging or other indirect food applications, trace amounts may come in contact with food. Toluene is not a food ingredient or additive, and its direct addition to food products is prohibited.
29578.risks: Neurological effects, respiratory problems, skin irritation, potential carcinogen, environmental pollutant

29617.name: Carbonated Pure Water
29617.description: Carbonated pure water is water that has been infused with carbon dioxide gas under pressure, creating effervescence commonly known as carbonation. This process makes the water fizzy, and it is used as the base for many soft drinks. Carbonated water itself has been deemed safe for consumption and is recognized as generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA.

29672.name: Preservative (E211)
29672.description: Sodium benzoate is a widely used food preservative that inhibits microbial growth by creating an acidic environment.
29672.benefits: Prevents microbial spoilage, extends shelf life of food products
29672.risks: Potential irritant at high concentrations, possible benzene formation with ascorbic acid, allergic reactions in sensitive individuals

29716.name: Dimethyl Dicarbonate
29716.description: A chemical compound used primarily as a solvent, reagent, or intermediate in organic synthesis and industrial applications.
29716.benefits: Effective solvent and reagent in chemical manufacturing processes
29716.risks: Irritant to eyes, skin, and respiratory tract upon exposure, potential inhalation toxicity, flammability hazard

29854.name: Citric Acid (Syre, Sitronsyre)
29854.description: Citric acid is a weak organic acid that occurs naturally in citrus fruits. It is widely used in the food industry as a preservative and flavoring agent. In the body, it plays a role in the citric acid cycle, which is important for energy production. Citric acid is Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used in recommended amounts.
29854.benefits: Enhances flavor, preservative properties, plays a role in energy production
29854.risks: Possible irritation in high concentrations, potential allergenic reactions, may cause enamel erosion in excess

30213.name: Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3)
30213.description: Cholecalciferol, or Vitamin D3, is a fat-soluble vitamin produced in the skin upon exposure to sunlight, specifically ultraviolet B radiation. It is important for maintaining healthy bones and teeth, supporting the immune system, brain, and nervous system, and regulating insulin levels. Vitamin D3 is often added to fortify foods and available as dietary supplements. It is recognized as GRAS (Generally Recognized as Safe) by the FDA for use as a food additive.
30213.benefits: Supports bone health, enhances immune function, regulates calcium and phosphorus absorption, supports muscle function
30213.risks: None at typical dietary levels, toxicity at very high doses, hypercalcemia

30225.name: Zinc Acetate
30225.description: Zinc acetate is a zinc salt used primarily as a nutritional supplement to provide zinc, an essential trace element involved in numerous biological functions including immune response and enzyme activity.
30225.benefits: Provides essential zinc, supports immune function and enzymatic processes
30225.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, potential for nausea or gastrointestinal upset if ingested in excess

30251.name: Vanadium (as Vanadyl Sulfate)
30251.description: Sulfate is an inorganic anion commonly found in water and various food sources. It is a normal component of the human diet and environment.
30251.benefits: Normal constituent of body fluids, involved in detoxification and protein synthesis
30251.risks: Laxative effect at high ingestion levels, gastrointestinal discomfort with excessive intake

30295.name: Guava Juice from Concentrate
30295.description: Concentrated juice from guava fruit, providing flavor and natural sugars.
30295.benefits: Source of natural vitamin C and dietary fiber remnants, flavoring agent
30295.risks: Natural sugar content, potential gastrointestinal upset if consumed in excess

30388.name: Organic Black Carrot Juice Concentrate Color
30388.description: A concentrated extract derived from black carrots, primarily used as a natural colorant due to its high anthocyanin content.
30388.benefits: Natural colorant, antioxidant properties from anthocyanins
30388.risks: Irritation potential in sensitive individuals, possible allergenicity

30397.name: Calci-K[R] Calcium Potassium Phosphate-Citrate
30397.description: Essential mineral electrolyte involved in nerve function, muscle contraction, and fluid balance. Typical dietary sources include fruits, vegetables, and supplements.
30397.benefits: Supports nerve transmission, muscle function, fluid and electrolyte balance
30397.risks: Hyperkalemia risk with excessive intake in kidney impairment, none at typical low doses

30595.name: Polyacrylic Acid
30595.description: Polyacrylic acid is a synthetic polymer commonly used in consumer products as a thickener and emulsifying agent. It is often found in cosmetics, personal care products, and some food contact materials. While it is generally considered safe for use in these contexts under normal conditions, it is not approved as a food additive.

30627.name: Woda
30627.description: Water, the universal solvent, commonly used as a solvent and diluent in cleaning products. It is chemically neutral and non-toxic.
30627.benefits: Solvent, diluent, non-toxic, non-irritating, environmentally safe

30643.name: Alphonso Mango Puree
30643.description: Alphonso mango puree is made by blending the flesh of the Alphonso mango, a type of mango renowned for its sweet taste and vibrant color. This puree retains most of the natural vitamins, fiber, and antioxidants found in the fresh fruit, contributing to its nutritional profile.
30643.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, contains dietary fiber, high in antioxidants, provides natural sweetness

30710.name: Ultra Purified pH-Balanced Water
30710.description: Ultra purified pH-balanced water is water that has undergone extensive filtration to remove impurities, and its pH level has been adjusted to be neutral or slightly alkaline. It is often marketed for its enhanced purity and purported health benefits, but there is limited scientific evidence supporting any additional health benefits over regular purified water.

30757.name: Live Probiotic (Bacillus Subtilis)
30757.description: A strain of Bacillus subtilis used as a live probiotic to support gut microbial balance by colonizing the intestinal tract transiently.
30757.benefits: Supports gut microbial balance, may aid digestion, potential immune modulation
30757.risks: Rare risk of infection in immunocompromised individuals, potential allergenicity, possible gastrointestinal discomfort

30841.name: Gardenia Jasminoides Fruit Extract
30841.description: Gardenia Jasminoides Fruit Extract is derived from the fruit of the Gardenia jasminoides plant. It is often used for its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and skin-lightening properties in cosmetics and health supplements. The extract contains compounds such as genipin and crocin, which are studied for their biological effects.
30841.benefits: Anti-inflammatory properties, antioxidant effects, potential skin-lightening agent, possible use in managing diabetes

31388.name: High-fructose corn syrup
31388.description: A sweetener derived from corn starch containing about 15% fructose; used to enhance sweetness and preserve food products.
31388.benefits: Increases sweetness and shelf life in processed foods
31388.risks: Insulin resistance, excessive caloric intake, metabolic disturbances, contribution to obesity

31401.name: Marine-Derived Calcium Citrate Malate
31401.description: Marine-Derived Calcium Citrate Malate is a form of calcium derived from marine sources and combined with citrate and malate salts to enhance absorption. It functions as a dietary calcium supplement and is recognized for its superior bioavailability compared to other calcium forms.
31401.benefits: High bioavailability, supports bone health, may prevent osteoporosis, promotes dental health

31791.name: Sodio Bicarbonato
31791.description: Sodio Bicarbonato, also known as sodium bicarbonate or baking soda, is a chemical compound frequently used as a leavening agent in baked goods. It reacts with acids to produce carbon dioxide gas, which helps dough rise. It's also used medically as an antacid to relieve heartburn and indigestion.
31791.benefits: Acts as an antacid, used in baking to improve texture, mild teeth whitening properties
31791.risks: High sodium intake for individuals with hypertension, potential excessive alkalinity impact if overconsumed

31873.name: Pfirsichsaft aus Pfirsichsaftkonzentrat (Peach Juice from Peach Juice Concentrate)
31873.description: Concentrated peach juice used primarily as a flavoring and sweetening ingredient in food and beverages.
31873.benefits: Natural flavoring, source of some vitamins and antioxidants
31873.risks: Allergic reaction in sensitive individuals, minimal ingestion toxicity at typical use levels

32338.name: Organic Caffeine from Organic Green Coffee Bean Extract
32338.description: Caffeine is a natural stimulant found in coffee beans, including green coffee bean extract which is less processed. Organic certification indicates cultivation without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. The FDA considers caffeine generally recognized as safe (GRAS) at moderate intakes.
32338.benefits: Increased alertness, improved cognitive performance, enhanced physical endurance, potential antioxidant properties
32338.risks: Insomnia, increased heart rate, anxiety, digestive upset, dependence, potential for increased blood pressure

32378.name: Sicilian Salt
32378.description: Sicilian salt is sea salt harvested from salt pans in Sicily, typically containing natural trace minerals. It is considered a whole salt but remains primarily sodium chloride.
32378.benefits: Provides essential electrolytes (sodium, chloride), naturally occurring trace minerals
32378.risks: High sodium intake may contribute to hypertension, cardiovascular issues

32446.name: Safflower
32446.description: Oil extracted from the seeds of the safflower plant, predominantly composed of polyunsaturated fatty acids, especially linoleic acid.
32446.benefits: Source of essential fatty acids, may support skin barrier function when used topically
32446.risks: High omega-6 fatty acid content leading to oxidative instability and potential pro-inflammatory effects with excessive dietary intake

32814.name: Oxygen
32814.description: A colorless, odorless gas essential for cellular respiration and energy production in aerobic organisms. It is not an ingested nutrient but is vital for survival.
32814.benefits: Supports aerobic metabolism, essential for energy production, vital for human survival
32814.risks: Oxygen toxicity at high concentrations, oxidative stress

33030.name: Apple Juice Concentrate
33030.description: Concentrated form of apple juice obtained by removing water, used as a sweetener or flavoring agent in food products.
33030.benefits: Provides natural sweetness, contains some vitamins and antioxidants present in apples
33030.risks: High sugar content, potential contribution to excessive caloric intake

33134.name: Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D)
33134.description: A fat-soluble vitamin essential for calcium absorption, bone health, and immune function. Recognized and regulated by the FDA as a dietary supplement and nutrient.
33134.benefits: Supports bone health, immune modulation, calcium absorption
33134.risks: Toxicity with excessive supplementation leading to hypercalcemia

33371.name: Lemon juice from lemon juice concentrate (1%)
33371.description: Reconstituted lemon juice made from concentrated lemon juice, used to provide flavor and acidity.
33371.benefits: Flavoring agent, source of citric acid and vitamin C
33371.risks: Potential acidity leading to dental enamel erosion, possible loss of some volatile nutrients during concentration

33636.name: Fuji Apples
33636.description: A variety of apple known for its sweetness and crisp texture. Apples are whole fruits rich in dietary fiber, vitamin C, and various antioxidants. Recognized as a nutritious food ingredient with no safety concerns when consumed as typical fruit servings.
33636.benefits: Rich in dietary fiber, source of vitamin C, contains antioxidants, supports digestive health, may reduce risk of chronic diseases

33914.name: Lavender Flower Extract
33914.description: An extract derived from lavender flowers (Lavandula angustifolia) commonly used in aromatherapy, cosmetics, and flavoring. Not a food ingredient primarily but used in fragrances and herbal supplements. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by FDA for use in food flavoring in small amounts. Contains bioactive compounds such as linalool and linalyl acetate.
33914.benefits: Anxiolytic effects, antimicrobial properties, anti-inflammatory, may improve sleep quality, antioxidant effects
33914.risks: Allergic reactions, skin irritation in sensitive individuals, may interact with sedatives

33931.name: Natural Mineral Spring Water
33931.description: Water sourced from natural springs containing trace minerals; generally safe and essential for hydration. Not regulated as a drug by FDA but considered a food/beverage ingredient.
33931.benefits: Hydration, source of trace minerals, supports bodily functions

34067.name: EDTA
34067.description: Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) is a chelating agent used to bind metal ions, preventing oxidative discoloration in formulations.
34067.benefits: Stabilizes color by chelating metal ions, improves product shelf-life
34067.risks: Potential skin irritation, limited bioaccumulation, environmental persistence

34101.name: Silica (Silicon Dioxide)
34101.description: Silica is a naturally occurring compound composed of silicon and oxygen. It is present in water and many foods and contributes to electrolyte balance. Generally recognized as safe by the FDA when used in food.
34101.benefits: Supports bone health, skin elasticity, connective tissue strength, involved in electrolyte balance

34149.name: Saborizantes naturales
34149.description: Term commonly used in Spanish for 'natural flavors,' referring to flavor compounds derived from natural sources but often chemically processed and added to foods and beverages.
34149.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or additives, ultra-processed, potential allergens, no significant nutritional value

34284.name: Bicarbonato de sodio
34284.description: Sodium bicarbonate is an alkaline compound used as an antacid and leavening agent; generally recognized as safe by the FDA.
34284.benefits: Relieves acid indigestion, helps regulate pH balance
