34284.risks: Excessive intake may cause alkalosis, electrolyte imbalance in sensitive individuals

34520.name: Organic Yuzu Flavor
34520.description: Flavoring derived from yuzu fruit, often used to impart citrus aroma and taste. 'Organic' denotes that the source fruit was grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. Flavorings are usually extracted compounds and may be processed; the precise composition can vary and may include natural or isolated ingredients.
34520.benefits: Natural source of citrus aroma, may contain trace antioxidants from yuzu, enhances flavor without calories
34520.risks: Possible allergenicity, lack of transparency on exact compounds, ultra-processed, potential mild irritants

34542.name: Organic Red Grapefruit Juice from Concentrate
34542.description: Red grapefruit juice made from concentrate, organic certified. Contains natural sugars, vitamins, and antioxidants. The concentrate process involves removing water for storage and later reconstitution, which may reduce some volatile compounds but generally maintains nutrients.
34542.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, antioxidants such as lycopene and flavonoids, may support immune function, antioxidant protection, cardiovascular benefits
34542.risks: High natural sugar content, potential interaction with certain medications (CYP3A4 inhibition), dental erosion risk if consumed excessively

34672.name: Organic Ginger Flavor
34672.description: Flavoring derived from organic ginger or its extracts, used to impart ginger taste. Typically considered a natural flavor but the exact composition may vary and include solvents or carriers.
34672.benefits: May contain ginger bioactive compounds with anti-inflammatory and digestive benefits if present in significant amounts
34672.risks: Potential allergens, lack of transparency on exact composition, ultra-processed

34775.name: Myrcene
34775.description: Myrcene is a naturally occurring monoterpene found in various plants such as hops, bay leaves, and cannabis. It is commonly used as a fragrance and flavoring agent. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA for use in food. Myrcene also exhibits potential pharmacological effects including anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and sedative properties according to preclinical studies.
34775.risks: Potential allergen, may cause mild irritation in sensitive individuals

34909.name: Gum Arabic
34909.description: Natural polysaccharide obtained from Acacia trees used as a stabilizer, emulsifier, and thickener in foods.
34909.benefits: Fiber source, stabilizes emulsions, texture improvement
34909.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, minor digestive discomfort at high intake

35522.name: Food Acid (citric & malic)
35522.description: Citric acid is a weak organic acid commonly used as a food additive to provide sour flavor and as a preservative by acidifying foods and beverages.
35522.benefits: Enhances flavor by providing sourness, acts as a preservative by lowering pH to inhibit microbial growth
35522.risks: Dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, minor irritation potential in high concentrations

35828.name: Wood Rosin Glycerides Esters
35828.description: A food additive used as an emulsifier and stabilizer, derived from wood rosin and esterified with glycerol. Commonly used in beverages and candies to help suspend flavor oils.
35828.benefits: Stabilizes emulsions, improves texture and appearance in food products
35828.risks: Potential allergenicity, limited toxicological data, possible irritation in sensitive individuals

36041.name: Bicarbonate (HCO3-)
36041.description: Bicarbonate is a naturally occurring alkaline compound that acts as a buffer to maintain pH balance in the body and water. It is commonly found in drinking water and plays a role in acid-base homeostasis.
36041.benefits: Helps maintain acid-base balance, aids digestion, may improve exercise performance by buffering lactic acid
36041.risks: Rarely causes alkalosis in normal amounts, potential gastrointestinal discomfort at high doses

36139.name: Roasted chicory root
36139.description: Roasted chicory root is derived from the chicory plant and is commonly used as a coffee substitute or additive. It contains inulin, a type of prebiotic fiber that supports gut health. It is generally recognized as safe by the FDA.
36139.benefits: Prebiotic fiber, supports gut microbiota, may improve digestion and bowel function, low-calorie coffee alternative
36139.risks: Possible digestive upset in sensitive individuals, potential allergy rare

36350.name: Pure rainwater
36350.description: Naturally occurring water collected from precipitation, free from contaminants when pure, used primarily as a diluent or rinse agent in cleaning formulations.
36350.benefits: Environmentally friendly, biodegradable, no chemical residues, non-toxic, non-irritating
36350.risks: None at typical use; potential microbial contamination if not properly stored or collected

36528.name: Fruit
36528.description: Fruits are natural food ingredients rich in vitamins, minerals, dietary fiber, antioxidants, and phytonutrients. They are recognized as healthy dietary components and are generally safe for consumption. The FDA regulates fruits as food and considers them safe when properly handled and consumed.
36528.benefits: Rich in vitamins, minerals, dietary fiber, antioxidants, supports immune function, reduces chronic disease risk

36622.name: Antioxidants (INS 307b - Alpha-Tocopherol, INS 320 - Butylated Hydroxyanisole (BHA))
36622.description: INS 320 refers to Butylated Hydroxyanisole (BHA), a synthetic antioxidant used to prevent rancidity in fats and oils in food products.
36622.benefits: Prevents oxidation and rancidity in foods, extends shelf life
36622.risks: Potential carcinogenicity in animal studies, endocrine disruption concern, ingestion toxicity at high doses

36674.name: Acidity Regulator
36674.description: A broad class of food additives used to control the pH and acidity of foods and beverages. Common examples include citric acid, lactic acid, and phosphoric acid. They help maintain product stability and shelf life. Typically recognized as safe by regulatory authorities when used within prescribed limits.
36674.benefits: Helps maintain food safety and stability, preserves texture and flavor, prevents microbial growth
36674.risks: Potential gastrointestinal irritation with excessive consumption, may affect mineral absorption (phosphoric acid), possible contribution to dental erosion if consumed in excess

37043.name: Lemon Juice from Concentrate
37043.description: Lemon juice concentrated by removing water content, used to provide acidity and flavor in food products. Typically reconstituted before use.
37043.benefits: Source of citric acid for flavor and preservation, contains vitamin C and antioxidants
37043.risks: Irritation risk in high concentrations due to citric acid, possible allergen for citrus-sensitive individuals

37068.name: Colour
37068.description: A generic term for substances added to food to impart or enhance color, including natural and synthetic dyes. Synthetic colors may be regulated by the FDA, but some have been linked to health concerns.
37068.benefits: Improves visual appeal and acceptance of food products
37068.risks: Potential allergic reactions, hyperactivity in children (certain synthetic dyes), some synthetic colors linked to carcinogenicity concerns

37175.name: Stabilisator Johannisbrotkernmehl
37175.description: Johannisbrotkernmehl, also known as locust bean gum, is a natural thickening and stabilizing agent derived from the seeds of the carob tree (Ceratonia siliqua). It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA and commonly used in food products to improve texture and stability.
37175.benefits: Natural thickener, stabilizes texture, dietary fiber source, low calorie
37175.risks: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals, rare allergic reactions

37595.name: Processed with Carbon Dioxide
37595.description: A colorless, odorless gas commonly used as a preservative and modified atmosphere agent to extend freshness of food products.
37595.benefits: Preserves freshness, inhibits microbial growth, extends shelf life
37595.risks: None at typical use levels in food preservation

37596.name: Reverse Osmosis Filtered Water
37596.description: Water purified using reverse osmosis to remove impurities, contaminants, and dissolved solids. Considered safe and potable by the FDA.
37596.benefits: High purity, free from contaminants and pathogens, improves taste and safety

37657.name: Artesian Well Water
37657.description: Groundwater sourced from a confined aquifer, naturally filtered and often used for drinking.
37657.benefits: Hydration, source of essential minerals depending on source

37875.name: Lime Essential Oil
37875.description: Concentrated oil extracted from the peel of lime fruits, containing bioactive compounds such as limonene and citral. Commonly used in flavoring, aromatherapy, and topical applications; recognized as generally safe by the FDA when used appropriately.
37875.benefits: Antimicrobial properties, antioxidant effects, potential mood enhancement, natural flavoring agent
37875.risks: Photosensitivity, skin irritation in sensitive individuals, allergic reactions

37936.name: Bicarbonates
37936.description: Inorganic salts primarily consisting of bicarbonate ions, commonly present in water and biological fluids, acting as pH buffers.
37936.benefits: Buffers pH, aids in maintaining acid-base balance in fluids
37936.risks: None at typical exposure levels in food and water

37939.name: Chlorides
37939.description: Inorganic chloride ions commonly present in water and food, essential for electrolyte balance and cellular function.
37939.benefits: Supports electrolyte balance, aids digestion via stomach acid production
37939.risks: None at typical concentrations, excessive intake associated with hypertension

38277.name: Sucralose (E955)
38277.description: Sucralose is an artificial sweetener used to provide sweetness without calories or carbohydrates.
38277.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, reduces sugar and carbohydrate intake
38277.risks: Potential gut microbiota alteration, possible mild digestive intolerance, synthetic processing

38369.name: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)
38369.description: Water-soluble vitamin essential for collagen synthesis, antioxidant protection, and immune function.
38369.benefits: Supports collagen production, antioxidant properties, supports immune function
38369.risks: Low toxicity at typical intake levels, possible gastrointestinal upset at very high doses

38822.name: Sodium Chloride
38822.description: Inorganic compound commonly known as table salt. Used as a filler and viscosity modifier in cleaning products. Chemically stable and non-reactive under typical use conditions.

38938.name: Organic Green Tea Extract (L-Theanine)
38938.description: Concentrated extract from green tea leaves, rich in antioxidants like catechins, combined with L-Theanine, an amino acid known for promoting relaxation without drowsiness. Green tea extract is Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS) by the FDA. L-Theanine is commonly used as a supplement to support cognitive function and stress reduction.
38938.benefits: Antioxidant activity, supports cognitive function, promotes relaxation and reduces stress, may improve focus and attention, cardiovascular benefits
38938.risks: Possible mild side effects like headaches or gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals, potential interaction with certain medications

38966.name: D-Alpha-Tocopherol Acetate (Vitamin E)
38966.description: A synthetic ester form of vitamin E used as a nutritional supplement and antioxidant in foods and cosmetics.
38966.benefits: Antioxidant activity, supports immune function, protects cell membranes from oxidative damage

39005.name: Stevia Leaf
39005.description: Natural sweetener derived from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant. Used as a sugar substitute with negligible calories. Recognized as safe by FDA when used as a sweetener, the leaf extract contains steviol glycosides responsible for its sweetness.
39005.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, may help regulate blood sugar, dental health friendly, natural origin
39005.risks: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort in large amounts, rare allergic reactions

39013.name: Stevia Leaf Extract (Reb M)
39013.description: Highly purified steviol glycoside extracted from Stevia rebaudiana leaves, used as a non-nutritive sweetener in food and beverages.
39013.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, does not raise blood glucose or insulin, suitable for diabetic and weight management diets
39013.risks: Possible mild gastrointestinal upset at high intake, rare allergy or sensitization

39017.name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
39017.description: Vitamin D3 is a fat-soluble vitamin produced in skin upon UV exposure or taken as a supplement to support calcium homeostasis and bone health.
39017.benefits: Supports calcium absorption, bone mineralization, immune function
39017.risks: Excessive intake may cause hypercalcemia, kidney stones, and toxicity; sensitivity in certain populations

39235.name: Organic Natural Flavour
39235.description: A term referring to flavoring substances derived from organic sources, processed to enhance taste and aroma. Despite being labeled organic, these are still processed flavor extracts with variable composition and transparency.
39235.risks: Lack of transparency, potential exposure to solvents or processing aids, ultra-processed, no direct nutritional value

39341.name: Pyridoxine
39341.description: Pyridoxine, also known as vitamin B6, is a water-soluble vitamin involved in amino acid metabolism, neurotransmitter synthesis, and hemoglobin production.
39341.benefits: Supports amino acid metabolism, neurotransmitter function, and hemoglobin synthesis
39341.risks: High doses can cause sensory neuropathy; low risk at typical dietary levels

39664.name: Zucker
39664.description: Common dietary sugar, primarily sucrose, used as a sweetener and energy source.
39664.benefits: Energy source, improves palatability of foods
39664.risks: Excessive intake associated with obesity, dental caries, and metabolic disorders

39698.name: Natrium
39698.description: Natrium is the Latin name for sodium, an essential mineral involved in fluid balance, nerve transmission, and muscle function.
39698.benefits: Essential electrolyte, supports nerve transmission, aids fluid balance
39698.risks: Hypertension and cardiovascular risk with excessive intake

39986.name: Vegetable and Fruit Juice Concentrates (For Color)
39986.description: Concentrated vegetable juices used primarily as natural colorants in food products.
39986.benefits: Natural colorant, source of some phytochemicals

40097.name: Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS)
40097.description: Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene is a thermoplastic polymer used for injection molded parts, known for toughness and impact resistance.
40097.benefits: High impact resistance and toughness, versatile and widely used in consumer goods and electronics housings
40097.risks: Potential skin irritation from monomer residues in manufacturing, emission of styrene during processing; low risk in cured product under normal use

40099.name: Polycarbonate
40099.description: A type of plastic commonly used in manufacturing containers, bottles, and various consumer goods. Not intended for direct human consumption and not recognized as a food ingredient by the FDA.
40099.risks: Potential release of bisphenol A (BPA) when heated or degraded, endocrine disruption, possible toxicity with chronic exposure

40226.name: Sucre
40226.description: Common sugar, primarily sucrose, used as a sweetening agent in foods and beverages.
40226.benefits: Provides energy as a carbohydrate source, enhances flavor
40226.risks: Excessive intake associated with dental caries, obesity risk, metabolic disturbances

40677.name: Natural Stevia Leaf Extract (Reb A)
40677.description: A natural non-nutritive sweetener derived from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant. Approved by the FDA as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) for use in foods and beverages.
40677.benefits: Zero-calorie sweetener, does not raise blood glucose levels, suitable for diabetics, natural origin
40677.risks: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort in some individuals

40707.name: Magnesium (as Aquamin MG)
40707.description: Essential mineral involved in numerous enzymatic reactions, muscle and nerve function, and bone health.
40707.benefits: Supports enzymatic reactions, muscle and nerve function, bone health
40707.risks: None at typical dietary intake levels

40894.name: Invert Sugar Syrup
40894.description: A mixture of glucose and fructose obtained by hydrolyzing sucrose, used as a sweetener and humectant in food products.
40894.benefits: Provides sweetness, humectant properties to retain moisture
40894.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain, dental caries

41366.name: Organic Prune Juice Concentrate
41366.description: A concentrated form of juice extracted from prunes (dried plums), organic certified. Used as a natural sweetener and source of nutrients such as potassium and dietary fiber components. Recognized by FDA as generally safe (GRAS) when used as intended.
41366.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, good source of potassium, natural laxative effect aiding bowel regularity, provides vitamins and minerals, supports digestive health
41366.risks: High sugar content, may cause gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals, potential laxative effect if consumed in excess

41451.name: Sulphates
41451.description: Sulphates are salts or esters of sulfuric acid, commonly occurring in water and used in various products.
41451.benefits: None at typical trace concentrations in water or products
41451.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, laxative effect if ingested in large amounts, potential to impact taste in water

41578.name: Vitamin E Acetate
41578.description: A synthetic ester of vitamin E used as an antioxidant and skin conditioning agent.
41578.benefits: Antioxidant properties, protects skin lipids from oxidation
41578.risks: Potential respiratory toxicity when inhaled, skin irritation in sensitive individuals

41832.name: Hard Paraffin
41832.description: A petroleum-derived hydrocarbon wax used primarily as a solidifying agent and barrier material in various applications including candles and cosmetics.
41832.benefits: Provides solid form and moisture barrier in topical formulations, used for shaping and stability in products
41832.risks: Potential skin irritation in sensitive individuals, inhalation exposure risk when burned producing particulates and volatile compounds, contamination with polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) possible depending on refinement quality

42563.name: Natural Grape Flavour
42563.description: A flavoring agent derived from natural sources intended to mimic the taste of grapes. Often contains complex mixtures of volatile compounds but typically lacks nutritional value.
42563.risks: Lack of transparency, potential trace solvents or allergens, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

42573.name: Fruit and Vegetable Juice Powder
42573.description: A concentrated powder made by dehydrating juices from various fruits and vegetables, often used as a source of phytonutrients and natural colorants in foods. Generally recognized as safe by the FDA when used in typical amounts.
42573.benefits: Source of vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, phytonutrients, convenient nutrient intake
42573.risks: Potential variability in nutrient content, possible added carriers or anti-caking agents, may contribute to sugar content depending on source

43055.name: Synthetic Polymers
43055.description: Man-made large molecules composed of repeating units, often used as thickeners, binders, or film-formers in food products. Not naturally occurring and may be considered ultra-processed.
43055.risks: Potential digestive irritation, lack of nutritional value, may cause allergenic or inflammatory responses, classified as ultra-processed

43170.name: Stevia leaf extract
43170.description: A natural sweetener derived from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant, used to provide sweetness without calories.
43170.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, does not raise blood glucose, suitable for diabetic use
43170.risks: Potential for mild gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals, possible bitter aftertaste, potential allergenicity in rare cases

43218.name: Sulfates
43218.description: Inorganic salts or esters of sulfuric acid, commonly found in various forms such as sodium lauryl sulfate used in cleaning and personal care products.
43218.risks: Irritation and sensitization risk especially to skin and eyes, potential contamination depending on source

43437.name: Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin)
43437.description: Vitamin B12 is a water-soluble vitamin essential for red blood cell formation, neurological function, and DNA synthesis. Cyanocobalamin is a synthetic form commonly used in supplements and fortified foods.
43437.benefits: Prevents vitamin B12 deficiency, supports hematologic and neurologic health
43437.risks: None at typical nutritional doses, rare hypersensitivity reactions possible

43542.name: Distilled Water
43542.description: Purified water obtained by distillation, removing impurities and minerals.
43542.benefits: Hydration, solvent for formulations, free from contaminants and minerals

43555.name: Steviol Glycosides from Stevia
43555.description: Natural sweet compounds extracted from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant, widely used as a non-nutritive sweetener.
43555.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, does not raise blood glucose, useful for reducing sugar intake
43555.risks: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort at high doses, potential mild laxative effects

43612.name: Rubber
43612.description: Natural rubber harvested from Hevea brasiliensis trees using organic farming methods. Primarily used for elasticity and flexibility in products like gloves, balloons, and elastic bands.
43612.benefits: Provides high elasticity, biodegradability, renewable material
43612.risks: Irritant/sensitizer (latex allergy), contamination with residual proteins causing allergic reactions

43767.name: Lychee Juice Concentrate
43767.description: Juice derived from lychee fruit, concentrated by removing water, typically used for flavoring or nutritional content.
43767.benefits: Provides natural flavor, contains antioxidants and vitamin C
43767.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, high sugar content in concentrated form, potential irritant in sensitive skin

43799.name: Fruit and Vegetable Juice (Carrot, Blueberry) for Color
43799.description: Natural colorants derived from carrot juice (rich in carotenoids) and blueberry juice (rich in anthocyanins). Used to impart orange to purple hues in foods.
43799.benefits: Natural coloring, contains antioxidants such as carotenoids and anthocyanins

43921.name: Organic Stevia Leaf Extract (Steviol Glycosides)
43921.description: Natural sweetener derived from Stevia rebaudiana leaves composed primarily of steviol glycosides. Used as a zero-calorie sugar substitute.
43921.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, does not raise blood glucose levels, tooth-friendly alternative to sugar
43921.risks: Potential mild gastrointestinal effects such as bloating or nausea in sensitive individuals

43975.name: Vitamin A Palmitate
43975.description: Vitamin A palmitate is a fat-soluble vitamin ester used as a dietary supplement and food additive to provide vitamin A, essential for vision, immune function, and cellular growth.
43975.benefits: Supports vision, immune function, cellular differentiation, and skin health
43975.risks: Potential toxicity at excessive intake (hypervitaminosis A), teratogenic effects in pregnancy at high doses

44167.name: Natriumhydrogencarbonat
44167.description: Also known as sodium bicarbonate or baking soda, used as a leavening agent in food to produce carbon dioxide and cause rising.
44167.benefits: Leavening agent in baking, neutralizes acidity
44167.risks: None at typical food use levels

44376.name: Titanium
44376.description: Titanium is a naturally occurring metal commonly used in its dioxide form (titanium dioxide) as a whitening and opacity agent in foods and cosmetics. The FDA permits titanium dioxide as a color additive in food within specified limits. Emerging research has raised concerns about its safety, particularly in nanoparticle form.
44376.risks: Potential inflammation, genotoxicity, cellular damage, possible carcinogenic effects from nanoparticles, accumulation in tissues

44795.name: Apo-Carotenal and beta-Carotene (colors)
44795.description: Apo-carotenal and beta-carotene are carotenoid pigments used as natural color additives in foods. Beta-carotene is a provitamin A carotenoid with antioxidant properties, while apo-carotenal is a carotenoid derivative used primarily for coloring. Both are approved by the FDA for use as color additives.
44795.benefits: Antioxidant properties, provitamin A activity (beta-carotene), natural colorant, supports immune function and vision (beta-carotene)
44795.risks: High doses may cause carotenodermia (skin discoloration), potential interactions with smokers increasing lung cancer risk for beta-carotene supplementation

45300.name: Fresh Steeped Elderflowers
45300.description: Elderflowers are the blossoms of the elderberry plant, traditionally used in herbal teas and remedies for respiratory and anti-inflammatory benefits. They are considered safe in typical culinary use and are not FDA-regulated as drugs.
45300.benefits: Anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, potential relief for cold and flu symptoms, immune support
45300.risks: Rare allergic reactions, potential toxicity if raw elderberry plant parts consumed

45362.name: Chlorophyll (copper chlorophyllin)
45362.description: Chlorophylls are green pigments found in plants essential for photosynthesis; chlorophyllins are water-soluble derivatives of chlorophyll used as colorants and supplements.
45362.benefits: Natural green colorant, antioxidant properties, potential detoxification support
45362.risks: Potential mild photosensitivity and irritation in topical use, ingestion generally safe at common levels

45676.name: Natural and Artificial Flavor
45676.description: Complex mixtures of chemical compounds used to impart taste and aroma to foods, derived from natural sources or synthesized.
45676.benefits: Enhancement of flavor and palatability in food products
45676.risks: Lack of transparency, potential for allergenic or irritant components, ultra-processing, no nutritional value

45683.name: Sweetener (INS 955)
45683.description: Sucralose is a zero-calorie artificial sweetener, approximately 600 times sweeter than sugar. Approved by FDA and widely used in food and beverages. Some research indicates potential negative effects on gut microbiota and glucose metabolism with regular consumption.
45683.benefits: Calorie-free sweetening, does not raise blood sugar, tooth-friendly
45683.risks: Gut microbiota disruption, potential glucose intolerance, debated safety with long-term use

45787.name: Carotte
45787.description: Edible root vegetable rich in beta-carotene, fiber, vitamins, and minerals.
45787.benefits: Source of beta-carotene (provitamin A), dietary fiber, antioxidants, supports vision and immune function
45787.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential pesticide residues if not organic

46327.name: Concentrated Lime Juice from Concentrate
46327.description: Lime juice concentrate is derived by removing water from fresh lime juice, concentrating its flavors, acids, and nutrients. It is used as a food ingredient to add acidity, flavor, and vitamin C. The 'from concentrate' form may have slightly reduced freshness compared to fresh juice but generally retains nutritional properties. It is recognized as safe for consumption by the FDA.
46327.benefits: Source of vitamin C, adds flavor and acidity, antioxidant properties, aids digestion
46327.risks: Acidity may cause dental erosion with excessive consumption, potential allergen for citrus-sensitive individuals

46467.name: Calamansi Juice
46467.description: Calamansi juice is extracted from the calamansi fruit, a citrus fruit rich in vitamin C and antioxidants. It is used in food and beverages for its tart, refreshing flavor. Recognized as food by the FDA, it is safe for general consumption and provides nutritional benefits typical of citrus juices.
46467.benefits: Rich source of vitamin C, antioxidant properties, supports immune health, aids digestion, adds natural flavor
46467.risks: Acidic nature may cause dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, possible citrus allergy in sensitive individuals

46519.name: Natural Sweetener (Steviol Glycosides)
46519.description: Steviol glycosides are natural sweet compounds extracted from the Stevia plant leaves, used as a non-nutritive sweetener. The FDA recognizes purified steviol glycosides as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) for use in food.
46519.benefits: Zero-calorie sweetener, suitable for diabetics, does not raise blood glucose, natural origin
46519.risks: Possible mild gastrointestinal symptoms in sensitive individuals, no evidence of toxicity at approved levels

46602.name: Clarified Mango Juice Concentrate
46602.description: A concentrated form of mango juice that has been clarified to remove pulp and solids, resulting in a clearer liquid. Used as a sweetener or flavoring ingredient in food products with nutritional contributions mainly from natural sugars and some vitamins.
46602.benefits: Source of natural sugars, contains vitamins (e.g., vitamin C, vitamin A precursors), provides natural fruit flavor
46602.risks: High sugar content, potential for blood sugar spikes in sensitive individuals

46639.name: Polyimide-1
46639.description: Synthetic polymer commonly used as a high-performance material in electronics, coatings, and adhesives due to thermal stability and mechanical strength.
46639.benefits: High thermal stability, excellent mechanical strength, chemical resistance, useful for durable industrial and electronic applications
46639.risks: Potential dermal irritation or sensitization upon prolonged skin contact, inhalation risk primarily in industrial processing (powder or aerosol forms), limited ingestion exposure typical, no significant endocrine or contamination concerns documented

47220.name: Konzentrierter Orangenextrakt
47220.description: Concentrated orange extract is derived from oranges and contains flavor compounds along with trace nutrients. It is used as a food ingredient primarily for flavor enhancement. The concentrate may contain natural citrus oils, vitamin C, and flavonoids but is usually processed. Recognized as safe for consumption by the FDA when used as a flavoring agent.
47220.benefits: Flavor enhancement, contains natural antioxidants like flavonoids and vitamin C, may contribute minor nutritional benefits
47220.risks: Possible allergenic reactions in citrus-sensitive individuals, potential contamination if not properly processed

47379.name: Fresh Pressed Blood Orange Juice
47379.description: Freshly extracted juice from blood oranges, rich in vitamin C, antioxidants, and flavonoids. Recognized as a natural food ingredient with no FDA concerns when consumed as part of a normal diet.
47379.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, antioxidants, supports immune health, anti-inflammatory properties, source of natural sugars and hydration
47379.risks: Potential for acid erosion on teeth if consumed excessively, possible allergic reactions in rare cases

47439.name: Blood Orange
47439.description: Citrus fruit variant rich in vitamin C, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, commonly used for flavor and antioxidant content.
47439.benefits: Source of vitamin C and antioxidants, flavor enhancer
47439.risks: Citrus allergy, photosensitivity in topical exposure

47571.name: Nitric acid
47571.description: Strong inorganic acid used as an acidity regulator in food processing to control pH levels.
47571.benefits: Effective pH regulator improving product stability and shelf-life
47571.risks: Irritant to skin, eyes, and mucous membranes, corrosive in concentrated form, potential contamination by nitrates/nitrites

47690.name: Citrato de sodio
47690.description: Sodium citrate dibasic is the disodium salt of citric acid, commonly used as a buffering agent, acidity regulator, and preservative in food and pharmaceutical products.
47690.benefits: pH buffering agent, preservative, food additive

47935.name: CO₂ Carbonation Agent
47935.description: Carbon dioxide gas used to carbonate beverages by dissolving under pressure to create effervescence.
47935.benefits: Provides effervescence and sensory properties in carbonated drinks
47935.risks: Gastrointestinal discomfort at high consumption, none at typical use

48053.name: Acidity Regulator (Sodium Citrates)
48053.description: The sodium salt of citric acid used to control pH in foods and pharmaceuticals.
48053.benefits: Effective pH buffering, generally recognized as safe, enhances flavor stability
48053.risks: Possible mild gastrointestinal upset in sensitive individuals at excessive oral intake

48154.name: Sílice Hidratada
48154.description: Hydrated silica is a form of silicon dioxide combined with water molecules. It is commonly used as a food additive (anti-caking agent) and in cosmetics and toothpaste. Recognized as generally safe by FDA as an additive in food. It is not a nutrient for consumption.
48154.benefits: Anti-caking agent preventing clumping in powdered foods, improves texture and product stability
48154.risks: None at typical exposure levels, inhalation of fine silica dust in occupational settings can cause respiratory issues but not applicable in food use

48304.name: Thickener (440) - Pectins
48304.description: Pectins are natural polysaccharides derived from plant cell walls, commonly used as gelling agents and thickeners in food products. They are recognized as safe by the FDA and widely used for their ability to modify texture and stabilize products.
48304.benefits: Dietary fiber source, can improve gut health, low-calorie thickening agent, stabilizes food texture
48304.risks: Rare allergic reactions, potential digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals

48534.name: Sodium Benzoate and Potassium Sorbate
48534.description: Sodium benzoate and potassium sorbate are antimicrobial preservatives used to inhibit microbial growth in food and cosmetic products, extending shelf life.
48534.benefits: Effective preservation against yeast, mold, and some bacteria, extends product shelf life, widely accepted as safe within regulatory limits
48534.risks: Potential skin and mucous membrane irritation, formation of benzene under certain conditions (with sodium benzoate), possible allergen, regulatory limits on concentrations

48784.name: Potassium Sorbate and Sodium Benzoate
48784.description: Potassium Sorbate and Sodium Benzoate are food preservatives used to inhibit microbial growth and extend shelf life.
48784.benefits: Prevents microbial spoilage, extends product shelf life, effective at low concentrations
48784.risks: Potential mild irritation, rare sensitization, possible formation of benzene under specific conditions with sodium benzoate, regulatory limits on maximum concentrations

48989.name: Silica (as silicon dioxide and Horsetail 7% Extract)(Equisetum arvense) (whole plant)
48989.description: Silica, primarily as silicon dioxide, is a mineral present in many foods and supplements, important for connective tissue and bone health. Horsetail extract (Equisetum arvense) is a herbal source of silica used traditionally for its potential benefits on skin, hair, nails, and bone. The whole plant extract contains flavonoids and antioxidants. Both are used in dietary supplements. Silica as silicon dioxide is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by FDA as a food additive. Horsetail contains some compounds that can be toxic in high amounts, but at 7% extract in controlled doses it is considered safe.
48989.benefits: Supports bone health, improves skin/hair/nail strength, antioxidant properties, connective tissue support
48989.risks: Potential for thiaminase activity leading to vitamin B1 depletion if consumed excessively, possible interaction with anticoagulant medications, risk of contamination with heavy metals if poorly sourced

49032.name: Organic Grapefruit Seed Extract
49032.description: Extract derived from the seeds, pulp, and white membranes of grapefruit, often used as a natural antimicrobial agent. Despite its popularity in alternative medicine, some commercial grapefruit seed extracts contain synthetic preservatives such as benzethonium chloride, raising safety concerns. The FDA does not recognize it as a food additive or dietary supplement with proven health benefits.
49032.benefits: Antimicrobial properties, possible natural preservative effects
49032.risks: Potential contamination with synthetic preservatives, allergic reactions, gastrointestinal upset

49498.name: Fruit and Vegetable Juice Concentrate
49498.description: Concentrated extracts of fruit and vegetable juices used primarily as natural colorants in food products.
49498.benefits: Natural coloring agent, contains some phytonutrients depending on source, replaces synthetic colorants
49498.risks: Rare allergen potential, minor contamination risk depending on raw source quality, possible source of sugars

49602.name: Lecithin (Soy)
49602.description: A phospholipid mixture extracted primarily from soybeans, used as an emulsifier to stabilize mixtures of oil and water.
49602.benefits: Emulsifying agent, supports texture and stability in food products
49602.risks: Potential endocrine effects related to phytoestrogens, hexane solvent residues from processing, allergenicity in soy-sensitive individuals

49750.name: Aquamin[TM] Mg (magnesium citrate)
49750.description: Magnesium is an essential mineral involved in numerous enzymatic reactions, muscle and nerve function, and bone health.
49750.benefits: Essential mineral for enzymatic activity, muscle and nerve function, bone health

49857.name: Thiamin
49857.description: Water-soluble vitamin B1 involved in carbohydrate metabolism and neural function.
49857.benefits: Essential vitamin, supports energy metabolism, nerve function
49857.risks: None at typical dietary or supplemental levels

50190.name: Natural Vegetable Flavours
50190.description: Concentrated extracts derived from various vegetables used to impart flavor in food products. Typically obtained through solvent extraction or distillation.
50190.benefits: Provides natural flavoring without adding macronutrients, enhances sensory properties of foods
50190.risks: Potential irritation or sensitization in sensitive individuals, possible presence of solvent residues, variability in composition, lack of transparency regarding exact chemical makeup

50211.name: Acesulfame K
50211.description: Artificial sweetener commonly used as a sugar substitute in food and beverages.
50211.risks: Potential gastrointestinal discomfort, possible carcinogenicity concerns in high doses

50219.name: Stevia Glycoside (Rebaudioside M)
50219.description: A natural sweetener derived from the Stevia plant, Rebaudioside M is a high-purity steviol glycoside known for its intense sweetening power with minimal bitterness and aftertaste. Recognized as safe by the FDA as a food additive suitable for consumption.
50219.benefits: Zero-calorie sweetener, natural origin, does not raise blood glucose, suitable for diabetics, tooth-friendly

50409.name: Sodium Bicarbonate (Natural Baking Soda)
50409.description: A chemical compound used primarily as a leavening agent in baking and for pH neutralization.
50409.benefits: Leavening agent in food, pH neutralizer, antacid properties in controlled use
50409.risks: Irritation to eyes and skin upon contact, risk of alkalosis if ingested in large amounts, ingestion toxicity at high doses

50525.name: Kolsyrat vatten
50525.description: Carbonated water is water into which carbon dioxide gas under pressure has been dissolved, creating a fizzy beverage.

51151.name: PCA-Na (Sodium PCA)
51151.description: Essential electrolyte mineral involved in nerve transmission, fluid balance, and cellular function.
51151.benefits: Essential electrolyte, supports nerve transmission, aids fluid balance
51151.risks: Hypertension and cardiovascular risk with excessive intake

51260.name: Caffeine aroma
51260.description: Caffeine used as a flavoring or stimulant additive, typically derived from natural or synthetic sources, providing bitter taste and central nervous system stimulation.
51260.benefits: Stimulates central nervous system, enhances alertness and reduces fatigue
51260.risks: Irritation in sensitive individuals, nervous system stimulation, potential for overdose at high ingestion levels

51520.name: Lait
51520.description: Milk, a nutrient-rich liquid produced by mammals, commonly consumed for its protein, calcium, and vitamins.
51520.benefits: Source of protein, calcium, vitamins, supports bone health

51525.name: Sirop de sucre inverti
51525.description: A mixture of glucose and fructose obtained by hydrolyzing sucrose, used as a sweetener and humectant in foods.
51525.benefits: Improves moisture retention and sweetness in food products
51525.risks: Excessive intake associated with increased caloric intake and potential weight gain

51995.name: Polyisoprene
51995.description: A synthetic or natural elastomer; synthetic polyisoprene is widely used in manufacturing products like gloves, condoms, and balloons. When used in materials such as latex products, it provides elasticity and durability. In non-food contexts it is generally safe with minimal risks unless there is sensitivity or exposure to additives/accelerants used in processing.
51995.benefits: Provides elasticity, durability, hypoallergenic alternative to natural rubber latex (synthetic type)
51995.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential exposure to processing chemicals

51998.name: Organic Holy Basil Leaf Extract
51998.description: Extract derived from Ocimum sanctum (holy basil), typically used for its aromatic and purported physiological effects.
51998.benefits: Traditional use as adaptogen and antioxidant, potential moderate antioxidant activity
51998.risks: Potential for allergic skin sensitization, limited data on endocrine effects, possible gastrointestinal upset with ingestion in high amounts

52129.name: Organic Cranberry Natural Flavor
52129.description: A flavoring ingredient derived from cranberry sources, often chemically processed to extract aromatic compounds to mimic natural cranberry taste. Classified as a natural flavor but typically processed with solvents or carriers. Used to enhance flavor in food products without significant nutritional contribution.
52129.benefits: Provides cranberry flavor without added sugar or calories, enhances palatability
52129.risks: Possible chemical residues from extraction, ultra-processed, lack of transparency in composition, potential allergens

52130.name: Organic Pomegranate Natural Flavor
52130.description: A natural flavor additive derived from pomegranate used to impart its taste and aroma in foods. Typically involves extraction and concentration of flavor compounds, often with added processing. Classified as a natural flavor by FDA but considered an ultra-processed ingredient.
52130.benefits: Provides pomegranate flavor, may contain trace phytochemicals depending on extraction
52130.risks: Ultra-processed, lack of transparency in extraction solvents and carriers, no nutritional contribution

52213.name: Natural Peach Flavor
52213.description: Complex mixture of volatile compounds extracted from peaches and/or other natural sources used to impart peach aroma and taste.
52213.benefits: Provides natural peach aroma and flavor, enhances palatability, used in flavoring foods and beverages
52213.risks: Potential allergenicity, possible trace solvents or contaminants from extraction, lack of compositional transparency

52270.name: Karottensaft aus Karottensaftkonzentrat
52270.description: Carrot juice is a beverage derived from carrots, containing vitamins, antioxidants, and natural sugars. It is consumed for nutritional value.
52270.benefits: Source of vitamin A precursors (beta-carotene), antioxidants, hydration

52371.name: Ananas
52371.description: Dehydrated pineapple, a dried fruit product with concentrated sugars and nutrients.
52371.benefits: Source of fiber, vitamins, and minerals in concentrated form
52371.risks: High sugar content, potential for added sulfites causing sensitivity reaction in some individuals

52509.name: White Chardonnay Grape Juice
52509.description: A fruit juice derived from Chardonnay grapes, containing natural sugars, vitamins, and antioxidants. Generally recognized as safe by the FDA for consumption.
52509.benefits: Source of antioxidants, vitamins (notably vitamin C), hydration
52509.risks: Natural sugar content, potential dental caries if consumed excessively

52562.name: Pinot Noir
52562.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermenting Pinot Noir grape juice, containing ethanol and various polyphenols.
52562.benefits: Contains polyphenols with antioxidant properties, social and culinary uses
52562.risks: Ethanol ingestion toxicity, potential carcinogenicity, liver disease risk, interaction with medications, addiction potential

52619.name: Stevia leaf extract powder
52619.description: A natural sweetener derived from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant. It contains steviol glycosides that provide sweetness without calories. Approved by the FDA as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) when purified and used in recommended amounts.
52619.benefits: Non-caloric natural sweetener, does not raise blood glucose levels, suitable for diabetics, may support weight management
52619.risks: Possible mild gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals, potential for allergic reactions (rare)

52626.name: Sucralosa (Sucralose)
52626.description: Artificial non-nutritive sweetener used to provide sweetness without calories.
52626.benefits: Low-calorie sweetener, aids in calorie reduction and glycemic control
52626.risks: Potential gut microbiome disruption, minor digestive irritation in sensitive individuals

52642.name: Benzoato de sodio
52642.description: Sodium benzoate is a widely used preservative that inhibits microbial growth in acidic foods and beverages.
52642.benefits: Effective preservative, extends shelf life, controls microbial growth
52642.risks: Potential irritant, formation of benzene under certain conditions, regulated use limits

52835.name: Organic L-Theanine
52835.description: L-Theanine is an amino acid commonly found in tea leaves that promotes relaxation and reduces stress without sedation. 'Organic' indicates cultivation without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers, but does not affect the compound's properties. It is Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS) by the FDA for use in foods and supplements.
52835.benefits: Promotes relaxation, reduces stress and anxiety, may improve sleep quality, supports cognitive function
52835.risks: Mild headache, dizziness at very high doses (rare), interactions with sedatives

52961.name: Voda
52961.description: Water, a polar solvent essential for life, commonly used as a base or solvent in various formulations.

53162.name: Pectins
53162.description: Natural polysaccharides derived from plant cell walls, commonly used as gelling agents and stabilizers in food products.
53162.benefits: Dietary fiber source, stabilizes texture in food

53412.name: Grapefruit Extract
53412.description: Concentrated extract derived from grapefruit fruit containing bioactive compounds such as flavonoids and limonoids. Used in foods, supplements, and cosmetics. Generally recognized as safe for consumption; however, can interact with certain medications by inhibiting cytochrome P450 enzymes.
53412.benefits: Contains antioxidants, potential antimicrobial properties, may support cardiovascular health, source of bioactive flavonoids
53412.risks: Potential drug interactions (CYP450 inhibition), photosensitivity risk in topical use, allergic reactions in sensitive individuals

53728.name: Ionic Calcium
53728.description: Ionic calcium refers to calcium ions in a dissolved form, typically found in supplements or fortified foods. Calcium is an essential mineral important for bone health, muscle function, and nerve signaling. The term 'ionic calcium' often implies high bioavailability compared to other forms.
53728.benefits: Supports bone density, muscle contraction, nerve function, cardiovascular health
53728.risks: Hypercalcemia with excessive intake, kidney stone risk in predisposed individuals

54506.name: Natural Sweetener (960)
54506.description: Erythritol, labeled as Food Additive 960, is a sugar alcohol used as a natural low-calorie sweetener. It is well absorbed and mostly excreted unchanged, causing minimal blood sugar impact.
54506.benefits: Low-calorie sweetener, does not raise blood glucose or insulin, tooth friendly
54506.risks: Gastrointestinal discomfort if consumed in large amounts (bloating, laxative effect)

54789.name: Hibiscus Flower Powder
54789.description: Powder made from dried hibiscus flowers commonly used as a food ingredient and herbal supplement. Recognized for antioxidant properties and traditionally used to support cardiovascular health. Generally regarded as safe for consumption by FDA.
54789.benefits: Antioxidant activity, supports cardiovascular health, may aid in blood pressure reduction, contains vitamin C and polyphenols
54789.risks: May cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential hypotensive effects with excessive intake

55042.name: Citric Acid (Syra, Citronsyra)
55042.description: Organic acid commonly used as a preservative, acidulant, and flavoring agent in foods and beverages. Also used for pH adjustment and chelation in various products.
55042.benefits: Effective preservative, pH control, enhances flavor
55042.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, potential dental enamel erosion with excessive ingestion, minor sensitization risk in dermal exposure

55276.name: Sal refinada yodada
55276.description: Refined iodized salt is sodium chloride that has been purified and fortified with iodine to prevent iodine deficiency disorders. It is widely used as a table salt and in food processing.
55276.benefits: Essential electrolyte for nerve and muscle function, supports fluid balance, provides iodine essential for thyroid hormone synthesis
55276.risks: Hypertension and cardiovascular risk with excessive intake, potential thyroid dysfunction if consumed in extremely high quantities

55323.name: Organic Maple Tree Water
55323.description: Sap collected from maple trees, often marketed as a natural hydrating beverage. It contains small amounts of minerals and antioxidants. Regarded as safe for consumption and considered a natural alternative to processed drinks. No FDA adverse status reported.
55323.benefits: Hydrating, contains trace minerals, antioxidants, natural and organic

55447.name: Strawberry purée
55447.description: Pureed form of strawberries, primarily composed of fruit juice and pulp. Used for flavor and nutritional content.
55447.benefits: Source of dietary fiber, vitamins (notably vitamin C), antioxidants

55748.name: Alkaline Ionized Water
55748.description: Water that has been treated to increase its pH above 7, often by electrolysis or adding minerals. Marketed for potential health benefits but lacks strong scientific evidence supporting health claims. Generally recognized as safe for consumption.
55748.benefits: Hydration, may neutralize acid in stomach temporarily, marketed benefits include improved hydration and antioxidant properties though not well supported
55748.risks: Potential minor alkalosis with excessive intake, limited evidence for health benefits

57100.name: Polycaprolactone
57100.description: A synthetic biodegradable polyester used in various applications including biomedical devices and as a component in some fragrance materials. Not a food ingredient and generally considered safe for use in controlled-release and medical contexts. When used in candles or fragrances as micro-encapsulation or similar, potential inhalation safety depends on formulation and burning conditions.
57100.benefits: Biodegradable, used in controlled release and biomedical applications, stable polymer matrix
57100.risks: Potential inhalation of combustion products if burnt, limited data on inhalation toxicity during candle burning, synthetic polymer concerns

58874.name: Sitronjuice
58874.description: Sitronjuice is the Norwegian term for lemon juice, a natural food ingredient derived from fresh lemons. It is rich in vitamin C and citric acid, commonly used for flavoring and preservation. Recognized by the FDA as generally safe for consumption.
58874.benefits: Rich source of vitamin C, antioxidant properties, aids digestion, supports immune function
58874.risks: Dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, potential acid reflux irritation

59106.name: Magnesium Acetate
59106.description: Magnesium acetate is a magnesium salt of acetic acid used industrially for de-icing and as a catalyst. It is not a common food ingredient and primarily considered a material chemical. Limited data exist on its safety in fragrance products or inhalation exposure.
59106.benefits: None in food or fragrance context
59106.risks: Potential respiratory irritation if inhaled as dust or fumes, limited inhalation toxicity data

59211.name: Dwutlenek węgla
59211.description: Dwutlenek węgla is the Polish term for carbon dioxide (CO2), a colorless, odorless gas. In food and beverage contexts, it is commonly used as a carbonation agent. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used appropriately in food and drinks.
59211.benefits: Provides carbonation in beverages, enhances sensory experience, natural preservative effect in some applications
59211.risks: None at typical food use levels

59222.name: Apple Juice from Concentrate (20%)
59222.description: Apple juice reconstituted from concentrate, containing about 20% apple juice solids. Commonly used in beverages and food products as a natural flavor and sweetener. Generally recognized as safe by the FDA when consumed in normal amounts.
59222.benefits: Provides vitamins and minerals found in apples such as vitamin C, antioxidants, natural flavor, hydration
59222.risks: Natural sugars contributing to calorie intake, potential dental caries with excessive consumption

59437.name: Fresh Lemon Juice
59437.description: Juice extracted from fresh lemons, rich in vitamin C and citric acid. Recognized as a natural food ingredient with Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS) status by the FDA.
59437.benefits: High in vitamin C, antioxidant properties, supports immune function, aids digestion, natural flavoring
59437.risks: Dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, potential acid reflux irritation

60557.name: Paprika Extract [Color]
60557.description: Paprika extract is a natural colorant derived from Capsicum annuum peppers, commonly used to impart red-orange color in foods.
60557.benefits: Natural colorant, provides vibrant red-orange hue, may contain antioxidant carotenoids
60557.risks: Irritant potential in sensitive individuals, possible allergenicity, contamination risk if improperly processed

60642.name: Artificial Lemon Flavor
60642.description: Synthetic flavor compounds designed to mimic natural lemon flavor, often containing esters, aldehydes, and other chemicals. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by FDA but considered ultra-processed.
60642.benefits: Provides lemon-like flavor without use of natural lemon, cost-effective
60642.risks: Lack of transparency, possible allergenic reactions, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

61263.name: Hemp-Derived Delta-9 THC
61263.description: Delta-9 tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) derived from hemp plants, psychoactive cannabinoid responsible for the 'high' in cannabis. Legally distinct from marijuana-derived THC if concentration is below 0.3% by dry weight. Used for recreational and medicinal purposes.
61263.benefits: Pain relief, anti-nausea, appetite stimulation, potential therapeutic for certain neurological and psychological conditions
61263.risks: Psychoactive effects, cognitive impairment, dependency risk, anxiety, altered judgment, potential legal issues depending on jurisdiction

61456.name: Sorbato de potasio
61456.description: Potassium sorbate is a preservative inhibiting microbial growth; lactase enzyme catalyzes lactose hydrolysis to aid lactose digestion.
61456.benefits: Potassium sorbate extends shelf life by preventing microbial spoilage; lactase improves lactose digestion in lactose intolerant individuals
61456.risks: Potential for mild irritation or sensitization in sensitive individuals (potassium sorbate), rare allergenicity; lactase enzyme generally safe

62754.name: Natural Sweetener (Stevia: Steviol Glycosides)
62754.description: Steviol glycosides are natural sweet compounds extracted from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant. Recognized as safe by the FDA as a non-nutritive sweetener, stevia is used as a sugar substitute with no calories and minimal impact on blood glucose.
62754.benefits: Calorie-free sweetener, does not raise blood glucose, suitable for diabetics, natural origin
62754.risks: Rare allergic reactions, potential gastrointestinal discomfort in high doses

62783.name: Enzyme Modified Stevia Extract
62783.description: A processed form of stevia leaf extract that has been enzymatically treated to modify sweetness profile and reduce bitterness. Used as a natural zero-calorie sweetener substitute in foods and beverages. Recognized as Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS) by FDA for use as a sweetener.
62783.benefits: Zero-calorie sweetener, natural origin, suitable for diabetics, reduces sugar intake
62783.risks: Possible digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals, potential allergenicity rare, ultra-processed ingredient

62865.name: Glucósidos de esteviol (Steviol Glycosides)
62865.description: Natural sweeteners extracted from Stevia rebaudiana leaves, used as non-nutritive sugar substitutes.
62865.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, does not raise blood glucose, suitable for diabetics
62865.risks: Potential for minor gastrointestinal intolerance in high doses, rare allergic reactions

62882.name: Orange Flavor
62882.description: Typically a combination of natural and synthetic compounds designed to mimic the taste and aroma of oranges. Often used in food and beverages as a flavoring agent. It is considered safe by the FDA when used in accordance with good manufacturing practices.
62882.benefits: Provides citrus flavor without calories, enhances palatability
62882.risks: May contain synthetic additives, allergy risk in sensitive individuals, ultra-processed

63222.name: Saborizantes naturales e idénticos al natural
63222.description: Term used to describe flavoring agents that are either derived from natural sources or chemically synthesized to be identical to natural flavors. These ingredients are often ultra-processed and may lack transparency in terms of exact chemical composition and potential additives.
63222.benefits: Provides flavor enhancement, often lower cost than natural extracts
63222.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain solvents or additives, ultra-processed, potential allergenicity, no nutritional value

63248.name: Concentrated lemon juice
63248.description: Fruit juice concentrate derived from lemons, used for flavoring and acidity adjustment in foods and beverages.
63248.benefits: Provides natural flavoring, source of citric acid useful for pH control
63248.risks: Potential oral mucosa irritation at high concentrations, acidity-related dental enamel erosion with excessive intake

63735.name: Jus concentré de carotte noire
63735.description: Concentrated juice of black carrot, a natural food ingredient rich in anthocyanins and carotenoids. Generally recognized as safe for consumption, it is used as a natural colorant and nutrient source.
63735.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, natural colorant, source of vitamins A and C, potential anti-inflammatory properties

63818.name: Blue #1
63818.description: Synthetic food dye also known as Brilliant Blue FCF, used for coloring foods, drugs, and cosmetics.
63818.benefits: Colorant approved for use in foods and pharmaceuticals, provides visual appeal
63818.risks: Possible hypersensitivity reactions, potential contamination with heavy metals, regulatory limits on use

64247.name: Agua San Mateo Natural Mineral Water
64247.description: Natural mineral water sourced from San Mateo, containing dissolved minerals. Generally safe for consumption and contributes to hydration without added calories or substances. Mineral content can vary influencing taste and potential minor nutritional benefits.

64370.name: Fructosa
64370.description: Highly purified crystalline form of fructose, a simple sugar used as a sweetener in foods and beverages.
64370.benefits: Provides sweetening with higher sweetness intensity than sucrose
64370.risks: Excessive intake associated with insulin resistance, obesity, increased triglycerides

64407.name: Natural Ginger Extract
64407.description: Concentrated extract derived from ginger root (Zingiber officinale), widely used for flavoring and medicinal purposes. Recognized as safe by FDA when consumed in typical food amounts. Contains bioactive compounds like gingerols with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
64407.benefits: Anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, may reduce nausea, supports digestion, may reduce muscle pain
64407.risks: Mild gastrointestinal upset in sensitive individuals, possible interaction with blood-thinning medications

64566.name: Kaliumsorbat
64566.description: Potassium sorbate is a widely used food preservative that inhibits mold, yeast, and some bacteria growth.
64566.benefits: Prevents microbial growth, extends shelf life of food and cosmetic products
64566.risks: Irritation to skin and eyes in high concentration, potential mild sensitizer in rare cases

64795.name: Acide Citrique (Citric Acid)
64795.description: Organic acid used primarily as an acidulant to adjust pH and enhance flavor in foods and beverages.
64795.benefits: Enhances flavor, acts as a preservative by lowering pH to inhibit microbial growth
64795.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, potential for dental enamel erosion with excessive ingestion

66053.name: Organic Prickly Pear Juice From Concentrate
66053.description: Juice derived from prickly pear cactus fruit, processed via concentration. Contains vitamins, antioxidants, and betalains, with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) when consumed as food. Concentration may reduce some nutrient content compared to fresh juice but maintains beneficial compounds.
66053.benefits: Antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, source of vitamins and phytonutrients, potential blood sugar regulation

66425.name: Watermelon Extract
66425.description: Concentrated extract derived from watermelon, containing natural flavor compounds and some nutrients inherent to watermelon. Commonly used as a flavoring agent in foods and beverages. The term 'Other Natural Flavors' refers to additional flavor compounds derived from natural sources, but their specific identity and safety profile are often undisclosed and variable.
66425.benefits: Natural flavoring, may contain antioxidants and micronutrients from watermelon, improves palatability
66425.risks: Potential presence of undisclosed additives in natural flavors, allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, ultra-processed flavor compounds

67027.name: Acesulfame-K
67027.description: Acesulfame potassium is a non-nutritive artificial sweetener used to provide sweetness without calories.
67027.benefits: Zero-calorie sweetening agent, useful for sugar reduction in foods and beverages
67027.risks: Potential carcinogenicity debated, possible gut microbiota effects, rare hypersensitivity

67065.name: Agua
67065.description: Purified water commonly used as a solvent or carrier in food and cosmetic formulations.

67217.name: Acesulfame-Potassium
67217.description: Acesulfame-Potassium (Ace-K) is a calorie-free artificial sweetener commonly used in beverages and processed foods. It is approved by the FDA and considered safe for general consumption at approved levels.
67217.benefits: Calorie-free sweetener, helps reduce sugar and calorie intake, suitable for diabetics
67217.risks: Possible mild gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals, potential metabolic effects suggested in some animal studies but inconclusive in humans

67345.name: Acqua
67345.description: Water, a universal solvent and essential for hydration and biochemical processes in the body.

67656.name: Antioxidant Ascorbic Acid
67656.description: Ascorbic acid, also known as vitamin C, is a water-soluble antioxidant used to prevent oxidation in foods and cosmetics.
67656.benefits: Antioxidant preventing oxidation, supports stability of products, essential nutrient in diet
67656.risks: Minor irritation possible in high concentrations, rare hypersensitivity

68156.name: Purified Hawaiian Water
68156.description: Water sourced from Hawaii that has undergone purification to remove impurities. Water is essential for hydration and bodily functions. Purification ensures removal of contaminants.
68156.benefits: Hydration, essential for life, free of contaminants after purification

68235.name: Natural Flavouring Substances
68235.description: Complex mixtures derived from natural sources used to impart flavor to food products. Exact composition often undisclosed.
68235.benefits: Improves palatability, enhances food flavor profiles
68235.risks: Potential for allergic reactions or sensitivities, may contain processing solvents or impurities, ultra-processed

68325.name: Sodium Bicarbonate (Natriumhydrogencarbonat)
68325.description: Sodium bicarbonate is a chemical compound used primarily as a pH regulator and buffering agent in food and industrial applications.
68325.benefits: Effective pH regulator, used to control acidity in foods and products, generally safe at typical use levels
68325.risks: Ingestion in large amounts may cause alkalosis or gastrointestinal discomfort, irritation in high concentrations

68428.name: Organic KSM-66 Ashwagandha
68428.description: A branded, standardized extract of Ashwagandha root (Withania somnifera) containing high levels of withanolides, used primarily for adaptogenic and stress-relief purposes.
68428.benefits: Adaptogenic properties, supports stress reduction, potential improvement in cognitive function and physical performance
68428.risks: Potential minor gastrointestinal irritation, possible interaction with thyroid or sedative medications, allergen risk for sensitive individuals

68429.name: Organic Rebaudioside M (Stevia Leaf Extract)
68429.description: Rebaudioside M is a highly purified steviol glycoside extracted from stevia leaves, used as a natural, non-caloric sweetener. Recognized as safe by the FDA as a food additive, it is less bitter and more sugar-like in taste compared to other steviol glycosides.
68429.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, does not raise blood glucose, natural origin, suitable for diabetics

68508.name: Vitamina A (beta-caroteno)
68508.description: Beta-carotene is a provitamin A carotenoid found in many fruits and vegetables. It is converted in the body to retinol (active vitamin A), essential for vision, immune function, and skin health. Recognized as safe by the FDA when consumed in typical dietary amounts.
68508.benefits: Antioxidant, supports eye health, boosts immune function, skin maintenance
68508.risks: High-dose supplementation may cause carotenemia (benign discoloration), potential risk of lung cancer in smokers with high-dose supplements

68756.name: Silicato de calcio
68756.description: Calcium silicate is an inorganic compound commonly used as an anti-caking agent and food additive to prevent clumping. It is recognized as safe by regulatory agencies such as the FDA when used in accordance with good manufacturing practices.
68756.benefits: Prevents caking, maintains food quality and texture

68767.name: Aspartame
68767.description: Artificial sweetener composed of two amino acids, used as a low-calorie sugar substitute.
68767.risks: Phenylketonuria risk due to phenylalanine content, potential headaches or allergic reactions in sensitive individuals

68814.name: Strawberry 20%
68814.description: Strawberry used as a food ingredient, likely in a processed or concentrated form at 20% content. Strawberries are a fruit rich in vitamins, antioxidants, and dietary fiber. When used in food products, they provide nutritional benefits related to vitamin C and polyphenols. The '20%' indicates partial strawberry content, suggesting dilution with other ingredients, which may affect overall nutritional value.

68867.name: Dióxido de carbono
68867.description: Carbon dioxide (CO2) is a colorless, odorless gas naturally present in the atmosphere. It is not a food ingredient but is commonly used in food processing, such as carbonation of beverages and modified atmosphere packaging to preserve freshness. As a material, exposure to high concentrations can cause respiratory issues, but its use in food contexts is generally safe.
68867.benefits: Used to carbonate beverages, preserve food freshness, inert and non-toxic at typical food use levels
68867.risks: Respiratory irritation at high concentrations, suffocation risk in confined spaces

68877.name: Água
68877.description: Chemical substance composed of hydrogen and oxygen; essential for all known forms of life, used primarily as a solvent and hydration agent.
68877.benefits: Essential for hydration, solvent in numerous biological and chemical processes

68915.name: Agua mineral
68915.description: Mineral water is water from a mineral spring containing various minerals, such as salts and sulfur compounds. It is generally safe to consume and often used for hydration and sometimes therapeutic benefits due to mineral content. Approved as safe by food authorities when sourced and processed properly.
68915.benefits: Hydration, source of essential minerals like calcium, magnesium

68987.name: Zitronensaft aus Zitronensaftkonzentrat
68987.description: Concentrated lemon juice derived from citrus fruits, primarily used as a flavoring or acidulant in food and beverages.
68987.benefits: Natural flavor enhancer, source of citric acid and vitamin C, preservative effect in foods
68987.risks: Irritation potential in high concentrations, acidity may contribute to dental enamel erosion

69400.name: Beta carotene [color]
69400.description: Beta carotene is a carotenoid pigment used as a natural colorant and a precursor to vitamin A in the human diet.
69400.benefits: Antioxidant properties, vitamin A precursor, used as natural colorant
69400.risks: Excessive intake can lead to carotenodermia (skin discoloration), possible increased risk in smokers for lung cancer at very high supplemental doses

69421.name: Natural Rosemary Flavouring
69421.description: Extracted aromatic compounds from rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis) used as flavoring agents in food and cosmetics.
69421.benefits: Provides natural flavor, contains antioxidant compounds
69421.risks: Potential allergen, skin and respiratory sensitization, may cause irritation in sensitive individuals

69773.name: Antioxidant (E385) - Calcium Disodium EDTA
69773.description: E385 is calcium disodium EDTA, a chelating agent used as an antioxidant to bind metal ions and prevent oxidation in foods.
69773.benefits: Prevents oxidation of fats and color loss in food, extends shelf life
69773.risks: Low risk at permitted levels, potential for mild gastrointestinal irritation in sensitive individuals

69875.name: Acrylates
69875.description: Acrylates are a group of synthetic polymers derived from acrylic acid, commonly used in adhesives, coatings, cosmetics, and some consumer products. They are not food ingredients and primarily classified as materials. Some acrylate compounds can cause skin irritation and allergic reactions upon contact; inhalation or ingestion can be harmful depending on the specific acrylate compound and exposure level. Safe use depends on formulation and exposure controls.
69875.benefits: Useful in adhesives, coatings, cosmetics for flexibility and durability
69875.risks: Skin irritation, allergic contact dermatitis, respiratory irritation with inhalation exposure, potential toxicity if ingested

70261.name: Extrait de fruit de framboise
70261.description: Raspberry fruit extract derived from Rubus idaeus, used as a flavoring and antioxidant source in food products. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used appropriately.
70261.benefits: Contains antioxidants, vitamins, supports potential anti-inflammatory effects, natural flavoring

70321.name: Organic Beta Carotene
70321.description: Beta carotene is a provitamin A carotenoid found naturally in fruits and vegetables. It is an antioxidant and is converted by the body into vitamin A, essential for vision, immune function, and skin health. The 'organic' designation refers to its cultivation without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. The FDA considers beta carotene safe as a food ingredient and dietary supplement.
70321.benefits: Antioxidant, vitamin A precursor, supports vision, immune health, skin health
70321.risks: Overconsumption may cause carotenodermia (skin discoloration), potential risk in smokers for increased lung cancer at high supplemental doses

70493.name: Natural raspberry aroma
70493.description: Natural raspberry aroma refers to flavoring compounds derived from raspberry fruits or their natural extracts, used to impart raspberry scent and taste. Despite the 'natural' label, these aromas can be highly processed and may contain multiple chemical constituents. The FDA classifies natural flavors as generally recognized as safe (GRAS) but does not require disclosure of specific components.
70493.benefits: Provides raspberry flavor without added sugars or calories
70493.risks: Lack of transparency, potential allergens, ultra-processed, possible solvents or preservatives

70779.name: Agua carbonatada
70779.description: Water infused with carbon dioxide gas under pressure, creating carbonated or sparkling water.
70779.benefits: Hydration, can improve palatability of water for increased intake
70779.risks: Mild dental enamel erosion risk with excessive consumption, minor gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals

71035.name: Yellow 5
71035.description: Synthetic azo dye used as a color additive in food, drugs, and cosmetics.
71035.benefits: Provides bright yellow color, improves product appearance and consumer appeal
71035.risks: Irritant/sensitizer potential, allergy and hypersensitivity reactions including urticaria and asthma, possible behavioral effects in sensitive children, regulatory limits on use concentration

71069.name: Zucchero
71069.description: Sucrose, a common sugar used as a sweetener and energy source in foods.
71069.benefits: Provides energy as a carbohydrate source
71069.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain and dental caries

71108.name: Dye beta-carotene
71108.description: A red-orange pigment found in plants and fruits, beta carotene is a precursor to vitamin A and functions as an antioxidant.
71108.benefits: Precursor to vitamin A, antioxidant properties supporting eye and immune health
71108.risks: High-dose supplementation linked to increased lung cancer risk in smokers, potential skin discoloration (carotenodermia) at high intake

71316.name: Açúcar
71316.description: Sucrose, a disaccharide sugar commonly used as a sweetener in foods and beverages.
71316.benefits: Provides caloric energy, enhances flavor and palatability
71316.risks: Excessive intake associated with increased risk of obesity, dental caries, and metabolic disorders

71810.name: Pink Grapefruit
71810.description: Natural juice concentrate from pink grapefruit, used for flavor and aroma and contains natural sugars and bioactive compounds.
71810.benefits: Contains vitamin C, antioxidants, natural flavoring
71810.risks: Photosensitization risk in sensitive skin, potential drug interaction risks when ingested in large amounts, allergic reactions

71824.name: Fat
71824.description: Macronutrient composed of triglycerides; provides energy, supports cell structure, and aids absorption of fat-soluble vitamins.
71824.benefits: Energy source, supports cell membrane integrity, aids absorption of fat-soluble vitamins
71824.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain and cardiovascular risk depending on fat type

71927.name: Artificial Sweetener (Sucralose)
71927.description: Sucralose is a non-nutritive artificial sweetener commonly used as a sugar substitute. It is FDA-approved and considered safe for general consumption, but emerging evidence raises concerns about possible negative effects on gut microbiota and glucose metabolism.
71927.benefits: Zero-calorie sugar substitute, helps reduce caloric intake, does not raise blood glucose levels
71927.risks: Potential disruption of gut microbiota, possible effects on glucose metabolism, may contribute to metabolic syndrome in some individuals

72402.name: Volvic Natural Mineral Water
72402.description: Volvic natural mineral water is sourced from volcanic regions in France, containing minerals such as calcium, magnesium, and potassium. It is purified and safe for regular consumption, meeting FDA and EU standards for mineral water.
72402.benefits: Hydration, provides essential minerals like calcium and magnesium, supports electrolyte balance

72633.name: Calcium D-Pantothenate [Vitamin B5]
72633.description: Calcium D-Pantothenate is the calcium salt of pantothenic acid (vitamin B5), essential for Coenzyme A synthesis and energy metabolism.
72633.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, skin health, and synthesis of coenzyme A
72633.risks: None at typical use levels, rare allergic reaction possible

72722.name: Sicilian Lemon Juice from Concentrate
72722.description: Lemon juice obtained by reconstituting concentrated lemon juice derived from Sicilian lemons. Contains natural organic acids, primarily citric acid, with vitamin C and flavonoids. The concentrate process involves removal of water and later rehydration, which may slightly reduce some volatile compounds but maintains nutritional and flavor properties. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by FDA as a food ingredient.
72722.benefits: Source of vitamin C, antioxidant properties, enhances flavor, supports immune function
72722.risks: Potential acidity-related dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption

73328.name: Glyceryl Abietate
73328.description: Ester of glycerol and abietic acid derived from rosin, used as a film-former, stabilizer, or thickener in cosmetics and topical products.
73328.benefits: Film forming, stabilizing, thickening agent in topical formulations
73328.risks: Irritation, sensitization potential especially in sensitive skin, possible impurities from rosin derivatives

73376.name: Limettensaft aus Limettensaftkonzentrat
73376.description: Concentrated lime juice used primarily for flavoring and acidity adjustment in foods.
