73376.benefits: Provides flavor and acidity, source of vitamin C and antioxidants
73376.risks: Mild oral irritation possible in sensitive individuals, acidity may contribute to dental erosion with frequent consumption

73686.name: Organic Natural Lime Flavor
73686.description: Flavoring derived from organic lime, used to impart lime taste in foods and beverages. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) when used in typical food amounts. The term 'natural flavor' can be vague, indicating a mixture of flavor compounds extracted from natural sources, sometimes chemically processed.
73686.benefits: Provides natural lime aroma and taste, enhances food palatability
73686.risks: Possible presence of trace solvents or processing chemicals, lack of transparency about specific compounds, potential allergenicity in sensitive individuals

74283.name: Pure Water
74283.description: Essential for life, pure water contains no contaminants or additives. It is critical for hydration, metabolic processes, and maintaining physiological homeostasis. Recognized as safe and necessary by all health authorities.
74283.benefits: Hydration, supports metabolic processes, detoxification, essential nutrient carrier

74378.name: Sodium (from Sodium Chloride and Sodium Bicarbonate)
74378.description: Sodium is an essential electrolyte involved in fluid balance, nerve transmission, and muscle function. Sodium chloride (table salt) is the primary dietary source, while sodium bicarbonate is used as an antacid and leavening agent. Normal intake supports physiological functions; excessive intake may increase risk of hypertension and cardiovascular disease.
74378.benefits: Essential electrolyte, supports nerve transmission, aids fluid balance, muscle contraction
74378.risks: Hypertension and cardiovascular risk with excessive intake

74396.name: 100% Natural Spring Water
74396.description: Water sourced from natural springs, typically containing minerals in trace amounts. Recognized as safe and essential for hydration and bodily functions. FDA classifies water as a food ingredient when consumed.
74396.benefits: Hydration, essential for life, contains trace minerals

74498.name: Mandarin Juice
74498.description: Juice extracted from mandarins, commonly used as a flavoring agent and source of natural sugars and vitamin C.
74498.benefits: Provides natural flavor, source of vitamin C and antioxidants
74498.risks: Potential for allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, sugar content contributing to caloric intake

74710.name: Fresh golden yuzu juice
74710.description: Fresh juice extracted from the golden yuzu fruit, a citrus fruit native to East Asia. It is rich in vitamin C and antioxidants. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) when consumed as a food ingredient.
74710.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, antioxidants, supports immune function, adds natural flavor
74710.risks: Potential citrus allergy in sensitive individuals, may cause photosensitivity in rare cases

75005.name: Ácido cítrico
75005.description: Organic acid used primarily as an antioxidant and pH adjuster in food and cosmetic products.
75005.benefits: Prevents oxidation, preserves freshness, enhances flavor stability
75005.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, potential dentin erosion with excessive consumption

75247.name: Cukor
75247.description: "Cukor" is the Hungarian word for sugar, a carbohydrate used as a sweetener and energy source. Commonly refers to sucrose derived from sugar cane or sugar beets. Recognized by the FDA as safe for consumption but offers no essential nutrients beyond calories.
75247.benefits: Provides quick energy, enhances flavor of foods and beverages
75247.risks: Metabolic syndrome, obesity, dental caries, insulin resistance, increased cardiovascular risk with excessive consumption

75479.name: Aromatizante
75479.description: Spanish term for 'flavorings' or 'flavor additives,' typically referring to added substances to impart flavor in foods or fragrances. Often vague, may include natural or artificial chemical compounds.
75479.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain synthetic chemicals, potential allergens, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

75680.name: Sanguinello Blood Orange Juice
75680.description: Juice extracted from Sanguinello blood oranges, a variety known for its deep red flesh and high content of vitamin C, antioxidants, and flavonoids. Recognized as a natural food ingredient with no safety concerns when consumed in typical dietary amounts.
75680.benefits: Rich source of vitamin C, antioxidants (anthocyanins, flavonoids), supports immune health, anti-inflammatory properties, may aid cardiovascular health
75680.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential acidity-related dental erosion if consumed excessively

75890.name: Natural Mint Aroma
75890.description: A flavoring ingredient derived from natural mint sources, typically used to impart mint flavor in foods and beverages. The exact composition is often proprietary and may include distilled mint oils and natural extracts. Considered generally safe by the FDA when used as intended in food products.
75890.benefits: Provides mint flavor, derived from natural sources, enhances palatability
75890.risks: Potential allergen, flavor sensitivity, ultra-processed, lack of full transparency

75906.name: Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C)
75906.description: Water-soluble vitamin involved in collagen synthesis, antioxidant activity, and immune function support.
75906.benefits: Antioxidant, supports collagen production, aids immune defense, enhances iron absorption
75906.risks: High doses may cause gastrointestinal discomfort, potential pro-oxidant effects in presence of metal ions at excessive levels

76016.name: Food Preservatives E202 (Potassium Sorbate)
76016.description: Potassium sorbate (E202) is a widely used food preservative effective in inhibiting molds, yeasts, and some bacteria. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used within recommended levels in foods and beverages.
76016.benefits: Prevents microbial spoilage, extends shelf life, reduces foodborne illness risk
76016.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, mild gastrointestinal discomfort in large amounts, possible skin irritation on direct contact

76300.name: Şeker (Sugar)
76300.description: Sucrose, commonly used as a sweetener in foods and beverages.
76300.benefits: Provides energy as carbohydrate source, enhances flavor
76300.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain, dental caries, increased risk of metabolic disorders

76473.name: Beta-Carotene Color
76473.description: Beta-carotene is a carotenoid pigment used primarily as a natural colorant in foods and cosmetics. It is a precursor to vitamin A.
76473.benefits: Colorant properties, provitamin A activity, antioxidant potential
76473.risks: Rare irritation or sensitization on skin contact, excessive intake may cause carotenodermia, no major toxicity at typical use levels

77313.name: Yuzu extract
77313.description: Yuzu extract is derived from the citrus fruit Yuzu (Citrus junos), commonly used as a flavoring agent in food and beverages. It contains vitamin C, antioxidants, and aromatic compounds. Generally recognized as safe for consumption, Yuzu extract offers flavor enhancement and potential health benefits associated with citrus bioactives.
77313.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, antioxidant properties, flavor enhancement, potential anti-inflammatory effects
77313.risks: Possible allergic reactions in citrus-sensitive individuals, photosensitivity in rare cases

78536.name: Eau gazéifiée
78536.description: Carbonated water, typically water infused with carbon dioxide gas under pressure. Generally recognized as safe for consumption without nutritional value.
78536.benefits: Hydration, alternative to still water, may aid digestion for some individuals
78536.risks: Dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption due to acidity

78975.name: Acidity regulator (E331)
78975.description: E331 refers to sodium citrates, commonly used as acidity regulators and preservatives in food products to control pH and enhance stability. It is considered safe for consumption by the FDA and EFSA.
78975.benefits: Controls acidity, preserves food stability, may enhance mineral absorption
78975.risks: Rare allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, possible laxative effect in very high amounts

79201.name: Organic Lemon Pulp
79201.description: Organic lemon pulp consists of the fibrous, fleshy part of the lemon fruit, rich in dietary fiber, vitamins, and bioactive compounds. Generally recognized as safe and consumed as a whole food ingredient.
79201.benefits: Rich source of dietary fiber, vitamin C, antioxidants, supports digestion, immune health

79306.name: Ginger Powder
79306.description: Dried and ground form of ginger root used as a spice and flavoring agent.
79306.benefits: Flavoring agent, contains bioactive compounds with antioxidant properties
79306.risks: Mild irritation possible in sensitive individuals, potential allergen

79383.name: CBD from Broad-Spectrum Hemp Extract
79383.description: Cannabidiol (CBD) is a non-intoxicating cannabinoid derived from hemp. Broad-spectrum hemp extract contains multiple cannabinoids and terpenes except THC, which is removed or undetectable. Used widely for potential therapeutic effects including anxiety relief, anti-inflammatory, and pain management. Not FDA-approved as a food additive or dietary supplement ingredient, with regulatory status evolving.
79383.benefits: Anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, analgesic, neuroprotective, seizure reduction in certain conditions
79383.risks: Potential drug interactions, liver enzyme alterations, drowsiness, gastrointestinal discomfort, variability in product purity and labeling accuracy

79477.name: Glukózo-fruktózový sirup
79477.description: Glukózo-fruktózový sirup is the Czech term for glucose-fructose syrup, a sweetener derived from starch hydrolysis, similar to high fructose corn syrup (HFCS). It contains varying ratios of glucose and fructose. Commonly used as a sweetener in processed foods and beverages. Not recognized as essential in diet and associated with metabolic health concerns.
79477.risks: Metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, obesity, type 2 diabetes, dental caries, increased inflammation

79568.name: Édulcorant (glycoside de stéviol)
79568.description: Steviol glycosides are natural sweeteners extracted from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant. Recognized as safe by the FDA and EFSA for use as non-nutritive sweeteners, they provide sweet taste without calories or impact on blood sugar.
79568.benefits: Calorie-free sweetener, does not raise blood glucose, tooth-friendly, natural origin
79568.risks: Possible mild digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals, rare allergenic reactions

79997.name: Caffeine
79997.description: A central nervous system stimulant commonly found in coffee, tea, and various beverages. It is used primarily to increase alertness and reduce fatigue.
79997.risks: Stimulant effects including increased heart rate, potential for insomnia, anxiety, dependence with chronic high intake

80526.name: Dioxyde de carbone
80526.description: Carbon dioxide (CO2) is a colorless gas naturally present in the atmosphere. In food industry, it is commonly used as a carbonation agent and preservative. It is safe for consumption at regulated levels and is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA.
80526.benefits: Used in carbonation, preservative properties, inert and non-toxic at regulated amounts

80838.name: Mineraalwater
80838.description: Mineraalwater (mineral water) is water from a natural mineral spring containing various minerals such as calcium, magnesium, and bicarbonates. It is generally safe for consumption and can contribute to hydration and intake of essential minerals. The FDA considers natural mineral water to be safe if it meets regulatory standards.
80838.benefits: Hydration, source of essential minerals like calcium and magnesium

81056.name: Hibiscus Sabdariffa (Hibiscus)
81056.description: Hibiscus Sabdariffa is a plant whose calyces are commonly used to make herbal teas and food products. It is rich in antioxidants, particularly anthocyanins, and has been studied for cardiovascular and metabolic benefits. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) for consumption.
81056.benefits: Antioxidant-rich, may reduce blood pressure, supports cardiovascular health, anti-inflammatory effects, source of vitamin C
81056.risks: May lower blood pressure excessively in hypertensive individuals, potential allergic reactions (rare)

81125.name: Orange 2
81125.description: Orange 2 is a synthetic azo dye formerly used as a food colorant and in cosmetics. It is not approved for use in foods by the FDA due to concerns over its safety and carcinogenic potential. The compound has been associated with mutagenic effects in animal studies and is considered a potential human carcinogen.
81125.risks: Carcinogenic potential, mutagenicity, allergenic reactions, regulatory disapproval for food use

81128.name: Colorants (caroténoïdes)
81128.description: Carotenoids are pigmented compounds with antioxidant properties commonly extracted from natural sources; vanilla extract contains vanillin compounds used as a flavoring.
81128.benefits: Provides antioxidant activity, natural colorant effects (carotenoids), and flavoring (vanilla extract)
81128.risks: None at typical use levels; rare sensitization possible from vanilla in topical exposures

81424.name: Bubble Gum Flavor
81424.description: Artificial flavoring compound created to mimic the sweet, fruity taste of bubble gum. Typically a mixture of various synthetic chemicals and natural extracts classified as food additives by the FDA.
81424.benefits: Enhances palatability and flavor appeal in food products
81424.risks: Artificial flavor-related hypersensitivity, potential allergenicity, ultra-processed additive, lack of transparency in components

81598.name: Naturliga aromer
81598.description: The term 'Naturliga aromämnen' translates to 'natural flavorings' in English and refers to flavor compounds derived from natural sources. However, these are often processed extracts that may contain solvents or preservatives, and the exact composition is usually undisclosed.
81598.risks: Lack of transparency, may contain residual solvents, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

82218.name: Peach Extract
82218.description: Peach extract is a concentrated substance derived from peaches, commonly used for flavoring in foods and beverages. It contains natural compounds such as antioxidants, vitamins, and phenolics, though typically in small amounts depending on processing. The FDA generally recognizes peach extract as safe when used as a flavoring agent.
82218.benefits: Contains antioxidants, may provide natural flavoring, source of vitamins A and C
82218.risks: Possible allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential pesticide residue depending on source

82758.name: Jus de citron vert concentré
82758.description: Lime juice, natural source of acidity and vitamin C used for flavor enhancement.
82758.risks: Oral mucosal irritation due to acidity, potential citrus allergy reactions

82810.name: Ácido tartárico
82810.description: Organic acid commonly used as an antioxidant and acidulant to stabilize pH and prevent oxidation in foods.
82810.benefits: Antioxidant properties help preserve food quality, pH regulator
82810.risks: Irritation risk if ingested in large amounts, potential mild gastrointestinal upset

82888.name: Potassium Tallate
82888.description: A potassium salt of tall oil fatty acids used primarily in soap and cosmetic formulations as a surfactant and emulsifier. Not typically a food ingredient and mainly considered a material.
82888.benefits: Effective emulsifier and cleansing agent, biodegradable, derived from natural tall oil
82888.risks: Irritation to skin or eyes upon contact, potential for sensitization in some individuals

83059.name: Ferments lactiques naturels
83059.description: Natural lactic acid bacteria used as ferments in food products like yogurt and fermented vegetables. Recognized as probiotics that can improve gut health and aid digestion. Generally considered safe and beneficial for consumption.
83059.benefits: Supports gut microbiota, aids digestion, may improve immune function, natural preservation
83059.risks: Rare allergic reactions, potential for contamination if improperly processed

83743.name: Preservative [INS 200]
83743.description: INS 200 refers to Sorbic Acid, a widely used food preservative approved by regulatory bodies like the FDA and EFSA. It inhibits the growth of molds, yeasts, and fungi, extending shelf life in various food products.
83743.benefits: Effective mold and yeast inhibitor, extends food shelf life, prevents food spoilage
83743.risks: Possible mild allergic reactions or skin irritation in sensitive individuals, potential gastrointestinal discomfort in high amounts

83760.name: Ácido málico
83760.description: Organic acid used primarily as an acidity regulator and flavor enhancer in food products.
83760.benefits: Regulates acidity, enhances flavor, participates in natural metabolic pathways
83760.risks: Irritation at high concentrations if ingested or in contact with skin, minimal systemic toxicity at typical food levels

84201.name: Chardonnay
84201.description: Fermented alcoholic beverage made from Chardonnay grapes, used in cooking to enhance flavor.
84201.benefits: Adds flavor to dishes, contains some antioxidants from grapes but minimal in cooked form
84201.risks: Alcohol content may cause intoxication if consumed in large amounts, potential sulfite sensitivity

84508.name: Malic Acid (Acide malique)
84508.description: Malic acid is a naturally occurring dicarboxylic acid used primarily as an acidulant in foods and beverages.
84508.benefits: Improves flavor by providing sour taste, acts as acidulant to control pH
84508.risks: Mild irritation at high concentrations, negligible ingestion toxicity at typical use levels

84649.name: Šećer
84649.description: Common sugar (sucrose) used as a sweetener in food products.
84649.benefits: Provides energy as a carbohydrate source
84649.risks: Excessive intake associated with dental caries, weight gain, increased risk of metabolic disorders

84655.name: Kieselsäure (Silicic Acid)
84655.description: Kieselsäure, or silicic acid, is a form of silicon oxide commonly used as an anti-caking agent in food products and dietary supplements. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by FDA for use as a food additive. Silicic acid is also naturally present in various plant foods and contributes to dietary silicon intake, which may support bone and connective tissue health. In non-food contexts, it is used in industrial and cosmetic applications.
84655.benefits: Anti-caking agent, source of dietary silicon, supports bone and connective tissue health

84667.name: Oxid uhličitý
84667.description: Carbon dioxide (CO2), a colorless, odorless gas naturally present in the atmosphere. Used in food and beverage industry primarily as a carbonation agent and preservative. Recognized as safe by FDA when used appropriately.
84667.benefits: Used for carbonation in beverages, inert atmosphere in food packaging to extend shelf life, non-toxic at typical exposure levels

84668.name: Minerální voda
84668.description: Mineral water is water containing dissolved minerals and trace elements, sourced from natural springs. It is generally safe for consumption and can contribute to hydration and mineral intake. The FDA considers mineral water a type of bottled water with specific mineral content standards.
84668.benefits: Hydration, source of essential minerals such as calcium, magnesium, and potassium

84899.name: Preservatives (E202 & E211)
84899.description: E202 (Potassium sorbate) is a common food preservative that inhibits mold and yeast growth. E211 (Sodium benzoate) is used to prevent microbial growth, particularly in acidic foods and beverages. Both are approved by FDA but have some concerns regarding potential adverse effects.
84899.benefits: Effective microbial growth inhibition, extends shelf life, prevents food spoilage
84899.risks: Potential allergenicity, hyperactivity in children (especially E211), formation of benzene (carcinogen) under certain conditions with E211, mild gastrointestinal irritation

85288.name: L-Phenylalanine Compound
85288.description: Essential amino acid used in protein synthesis and as a dietary supplement. Present naturally in many protein-containing foods.
85288.benefits: Supports protein synthesis, precursor to neurotransmitters such as dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine
85288.risks: Not safe for individuals with phenylketonuria (PKU) due to risk of neurotoxicity

85945.name: Nitrates
85945.description: Inorganic compounds commonly found in water and foods, mainly used as preservatives and fertilizers.
85945.benefits: Preservative properties in processed meats, natural occurrence in vegetables
85945.risks: Potential formation of nitrosamines (carcinogenic), methemoglobinemia risk in infants, contamination risk from agricultural runoff

86008.name: Tamarind Juice Concentrate
86008.description: A concentrated extract from tamarind fruit pulp, used as a food ingredient for flavor and acidity. Tamarind is a source of vitamins, antioxidants, and dietary fiber. The concentrate delivers the characteristic tangy flavor and nutritional components in a concentrated form.
86008.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, contains vitamin C and B vitamins, supports digestion, natural flavoring agent
86008.risks: May cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, high acidity may affect dental enamel with excessive consumption

86146.name: Citric Acid (Antioxidante ácido cítrico)
86146.description: Organic acid commonly used as a pH adjuster and preservative in food and cosmetic products.
86146.risks: Mild irritant to skin and eyes at high concentrations

86281.name: Colorantes E102 (Tartrazine)
86281.description: Synthetic lemon yellow azo dye used as a colorant in foods, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals.
86281.benefits: Colorant for visual appeal in products
86281.risks: Irritation/sensitization potential, allergic reactions, hyperactivity in children, regulatory restrictions in some countries

86710.name: Agua purificada
86710.description: Purified water diluted with an acidic substance to achieve 5% acidity; commonly used as a solvent or vehicle in formulations.
86710.benefits: Solvent and diluent, facilitates formulation stability and delivery
86710.risks: Low risk at typical exposure; potential mild irritation if strong acid used for acidification

86784.name: Pectin (Stabilisator)
86784.description: Pectins are polysaccharides primarily used as gelling agents, stabilizers, and thickening agents in food products.
86784.benefits: Dietary fiber, supports digestive health, stabilizing and gelling functionality

87351.name: Natural Lemon Aroma
87351.description: A fragrance ingredient derived from lemon essential oils or citrus extracts used for flavoring or scent. Despite the term 'natural,' it often involves chemical extraction and can contain multiple volatile compounds. Not regulated as food additive but commonly used in food products and fragrances.
87351.benefits: Provides natural lemon flavor or scent, generally recognized as safe in food when used in typical amounts
87351.risks: Allergic reactions, skin irritation (in direct topical use), potential respiratory sensitization, possible trace solvent residues, lack of transparency in composition

87643.name: Blueberry or Lemon-Lime Natural Aroma
87643.description: A flavoring ingredient derived from natural sources to impart blueberry or lemon-lime taste in foods and beverages. These natural aromas are typically extracted using solvents or steam distillation methods, but the exact chemical composition may vary and sometimes include minor processing aids. The FDA considers natural flavors generally safe, but lack of transparency and potential allergens may be concerns.
87643.benefits: Provides natural fruit flavor, enhances palatability and consumer appeal
87643.risks: Possible allergenic compounds, lack of transparency in composition, may contain trace solvents or processing aids

87785.name: Vitamins
87785.description: Organic compounds essential in small amounts for normal metabolism and health. They must be obtained from diet or supplements. Different vitamins have varied functions including antioxidant roles, energy metabolism, and immune support.
87785.benefits: Supports normal metabolic functions, antioxidant protection, immune support, prevents deficiency diseases
87785.risks: Hypervitaminosis with excessive intake of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K), possible interactions with medications

87878.name: Citronensäuremonohydrat (Citric Acid Monohydrate)
87878.description: Citric acid monohydrate is a natural organic acid commonly used as a food additive and preservative to enhance flavor and shelf life. It is recognized as safe by the FDA and commonly derived from citrus fruits or microbial fermentation. It is water-soluble and widely used in beverages, candies, and processed foods.
87878.benefits: Enhances flavor, acts as a natural preservative, improves mineral absorption, antioxidant properties
87878.risks: May cause mild irritation in sensitive individuals when consumed in large amounts, potential dental erosion with excessive intake

87894.name: Sugar (apple juice concentrate)
87894.description: Sugar derived from concentrated apple juice, used as a sweetener in foods and beverages. Provides calories without significant nutrients. Considered a form of added sugar by FDA standards.
87894.benefits: Energy source, naturally derived sweetener alternative to refined sucrose
87894.risks: Metabolic syndrome, obesity, insulin resistance, dental caries, increased cardiovascular risk with excessive intake

88142.name: Apples
88142.description: Fruit from Malus domestica providing dietary fiber, vitamins, and phytochemicals.
88142.benefits: Source of dietary fiber, vitamin C, antioxidants, and flavonoids
88142.risks: Possible pesticide residues if not organic, allergen risk in sensitive individuals

88175.name: Natural Blackberry Flavouring
88175.description: A flavoring derived from blackberry extracts or compounds intended to mimic blackberry taste. Classified as a natural flavor but often involves chemical isolation and processing. Used primarily to impart fruit aroma and taste in foods.
88175.benefits: Provides natural fruit flavor, enhances palatability of food products
88175.risks: May contain chemical solvents or preservatives, lack of transparency in composition, potential allergenicity

88219.name: Stabiliser E415
88219.description: A polysaccharide used as a stabilizer and thickening agent in food products.
88219.benefits: Improves texture and stability in food formulations
88219.risks: Minor digestive discomfort at high intake, potential for rare allergic reactions

88226.name: Organic Natural Pumpkin Spice Flavor
88226.description: A flavoring blend typically derived from natural extracts of spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, and ginger, used to impart pumpkin pie-like aroma and taste; 'organic' implies sourcing from organically grown ingredients. The composition is generally safe for consumption and recognized as GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe) though exact formulations vary and may include minor processing aids or solvents.
88226.benefits: Provides natural spice flavoring, may contain bioactive compounds with antioxidant properties
88226.risks: Possible allergic reactions to spice components, potential trace solvents from extraction, ultra-processed additive with little nutritional value

88461.name: Water
88461.description: Purified water, commonly used as a solvent and diluent in cleaning products. Chemically stable and non-toxic.
88461.benefits: Universal solvent, non-toxic, non-irritating, environmentally safe

88662.name: Regulador de acidez (E-331iii)
88662.description: Known as Trisodium citrate, E-331iii is a food additive used as an acidity regulator and emulsifier. It is generally recognized as safe by the FDA and commonly used in beverages and processed foods to control pH levels.
88662.benefits: Controls acidity, stabilizes food products, acts as an emulsifier, improves flavor

89361.name: Salt
89361.description: Sodium chloride used as a flavor enhancer and preservative in foods.
89361.benefits: Essential electrolyte, supports nerve transmission, aids fluid balance
89361.risks: Hypertension and cardiovascular risk with excessive intake

89380.name: Vegetable Fibers (Oligofructose)
89380.description: Oligofructose is a type of short-chain fructooligosaccharide derived from vegetable fibers, functioning primarily as a prebiotic dietary fiber to promote beneficial gut bacteria.
89380.benefits: Prebiotic fiber supporting gut microbiota, may improve digestive health, assists in mineral absorption
89380.risks: Gastrointestinal discomfort at high doses, such as bloating, gas, and diarrhea

89587.name: Ácido Ascórbico (Vitamin C)
89587.description: Vitamin C compound used as a flour treatment agent to strengthen dough and improve baking performance.
89587.benefits: Dough strengthening, antioxidant properties, essential nutrient for humans
89587.risks: Irritation at very high doses, potential for interaction with certain medications at pharmacological levels

89784.name: DLPA (DL-Phenylalanine)
89784.description: A synthetic mixture of D-phenylalanine and L-phenylalanine amino acids. Used as a dietary supplement for mood enhancement and pain relief. Recognized as safe for consumption in typical supplemental doses but not an essential nutrient.
89784.benefits: May improve mood, reduce chronic pain, support neurotransmitter synthesis
89784.risks: Possible interactions with MAO inhibitors, risk for individuals with phenylketonuria (PKU), mild side effects like headache or nausea

89915.name: Ağaç reçinesinin gliserol esterleri
89915.description: Glycerol esters of wood resin are compounds derived from glycerol and natural tree resins, commonly used as emulsifiers or stabilizers in food and cosmetic products. Considered generally safe for consumption and topical use when properly refined.
89915.benefits: Emulsifying properties, stabilizes food and cosmetic formulations, derived from natural sources
89915.risks: Potential allergenicity in sensitive individuals, rare hypersensitivity reactions

89989.name: Organic Stevia Extract
89989.description: A natural, zero-calorie sweetener derived from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant. Recognized as safe by the FDA when used as a sweetener. Used as a sugar substitute with minimal impact on blood glucose levels.
89989.benefits: Natural zero-calorie sweetener, does not raise blood sugar, beneficial for weight management and diabetes control
89989.risks: Potential for mild digestive upset in sensitive individuals, possible interaction with blood pressure or blood sugar medications

90026.name: Essence of Lemon
90026.description: A concentrated flavoring derived from lemon, commonly used as a food flavoring. It may be natural (extracted from lemon peel/oil) or synthetic. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used in food. Contains aromatic compounds like limonene. Typically used in small amounts, providing lemon flavor without significant nutritional contribution.
90026.benefits: Provides natural lemon flavor, contains antioxidant compounds like limonene, enhances palatability
90026.risks: Potential allergen, may cause sensitivity or irritation in some individuals, trace synthetic additives possible if not pure natural extract

90304.name: Allura Red Color [E129]
90304.description: Synthetic azo dye commonly used as a red food colorant. Approved by FDA for use in food, cosmetics, and drugs with specified limits. Linked to hyperactivity in some children and potential allergic reactions.
90304.benefits: Provides vibrant red color, approved for safe use in regulated amounts
90304.risks: Hyperactivity in children, allergic reactions, potential behavioral effects, synthetic azo dye concerns

90307.name: Sirop de fructose-glucose
90307.description: A syrup made from hydrolyzed starch mainly consisting of glucose; used as a sweetener and a humectant in food products.
90307.benefits: Provides sweetness, improves texture and moisture retention in foods
90307.risks: High glycemic index, excessive consumption linked to weight gain and dental caries

90464.name: Organic Fruit and Vegetable Juice (Carrot, Blackcurrant) for Color
90464.description: Juice extracted from blackcurrant fruits, commonly used as a natural colorant in foods and beverages.
90464.benefits: Natural coloring agent, contains antioxidants such as anthocyanins, contributes minor nutritional value
90464.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, potential for contamination if not properly processed, minimal ingestion toxicity

90589.name: Água Gaseificada
90589.description: Carbonated water, water into which carbon dioxide gas under pressure has been dissolved. Generally recognized as safe for consumption. Provides hydration similar to still water but can cause belching or mild bloating in some individuals.
90589.benefits: Hydration, calorie-free alternative to sugary beverages, may aid digestion
90589.risks: Mild bloating, belching, possible dental enamel erosion with frequent consumption

91429.name: 100% recycled plastic
91429.description: Material derived from previously used plastics used in packaging or components of cleaning products. Not an active ingredient in cleaning formulations.
91429.benefits: Supports sustainability and waste reduction by reusing plastic materials
91429.risks: Potential contamination from residual chemicals if not properly processed, microplastic environmental impact if released

91790.name: Organic Cane Sugar Molasses
91790.description: A viscous byproduct of sugar extraction from sugar cane containing sugars, minerals, and small amounts of vitamins.
91790.benefits: Provides small amounts of minerals like iron and calcium, used as a sweetener and flavoring agent
91790.risks: High sugar content, excessive intake associated with dental caries and weight gain

91966.name: De-Sugared Lemon Juice from Concentrate
91966.description: Lemon juice concentrate with reduced sugar content, used as a flavoring or acidulant in food products. Retains citric acid and flavor compounds but has lower natural sugar levels compared to regular lemon juice concentrate. Generally recognized as safe by FDA.
91966.benefits: Source of citric acid, natural flavor, low sugar content helpful for reducing caloric intake
91966.risks: Possible reduction in natural carbohydrate content (minimal risk), potential for processing contaminants (low)

92159.name: Grapefruit Juice from Concentrate (16%)
92159.description: Reconstituted juice derived from concentrated grapefruit juice; contains natural sugars, acids, and phytochemicals.
92159.benefits: Source of vitamin C and antioxidants
92159.risks: Photosensitivity, interaction with certain medications due to furanocoumarins, ingestion toxicity in excess

92206.name: Carbonated Natural Artesian Spring Water
92206.description: Water that has been carbonated by dissolving carbon dioxide gas under pressure, typically without added ingredients.
92206.benefits: Hydration, calorie-free beverage with carbonic acid providing effervescence
92206.risks: Dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption due to acidity from carbonation

92420.name: FD&C Yellow #6 [E110]
92420.description: Synthetic azo dye used as a colorant in foods and cosmetics.
92420.risks: Irritation, potential allergenicity, hyperactivity concerns in children, regulatory limits on use

92786.name: Natürliches Apfelaroma
92786.description: German for 'Natural Apple Flavor', typically a flavoring derived from apple components using physical, enzymatic, or fermentation processes without chemical synthesis. Used to impart apple flavor in foods. Despite being labeled natural, it is a processed ingredient with unclear composition and potential additives.
92786.benefits: Provides apple flavor, generally recognized as safe for consumption
92786.risks: Lack of transparency, possible additives or solvents, ultra-processed, no nutritional value

92791.name: Vesi
92791.description: No relevant safety or toxicology data found for 'Vesi', possibly a brand name, misspelling, or proprietary ingredient.

93013.name: Ginseng powder
93013.description: Powdered form of ginseng root, commonly used as an herbal supplement. Recognized for its adaptogenic properties and traditional use in improving energy, cognitive function, and immune support. Generally considered safe for consumption with few side effects when used appropriately.
93013.benefits: Adaptogenic effects, enhances energy and cognitive function, supports immune system, may reduce fatigue, antioxidant properties
93013.risks: Potential interactions with blood thinners and diabetes medications, insomnia, headaches, gastrointestinal upset in sensitive individuals

93031.name: Grains
93031.description: Edible seeds of grasses such as wheat, rice, oats, barley, and corn. Grains provide carbohydrates, fiber, protein, vitamins, and minerals. Whole grains retain bran and germ, offering more nutrients and health benefits compared to refined grains, which are stripped of fiber and micronutrients. The FDA recognizes whole grains as part of a healthy diet.
93031.benefits: Source of complex carbohydrates, dietary fiber, essential nutrients (B vitamins, iron, magnesium), supports digestive health, may reduce risk of heart disease and type 2 diabetes
93031.risks: Gluten sensitivity or celiac disease in susceptible individuals, potential overconsumption of refined grains linked to metabolic disorders

94261.name: Green Kiwifruit (Hayward)
94261.description: Fresh green kiwifruit variety, raw whole fruit with no additives. Rich source of vitamin C, dietary fiber, and antioxidants. Recognized as safe to consume and widely used in fresh fruit consumption and culinary uses. No FDA concerns for raw fruit.
94261.benefits: High vitamin C content, rich in dietary fiber, antioxidants, supports immune function, promotes digestive health
94261.risks: Allergic reactions (rare), potential oxalate content in susceptible individuals

94269.name: Koncentrirani limunov sok
94269.description: Concentrated lemon juice, a food ingredient derived from lemon juice with reduced water content. Contains citric acid, vitamin C, and various phytochemicals. Commonly used as a flavoring and preservative agent in foods and beverages.
94269.benefits: Source of vitamin C, antioxidants, supports immune function, natural preservative, adds flavor
94269.risks: Possible dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, potential acid reflux aggravation

94569.name: Turmeric Colors
94569.description: Coloring agents derived from turmeric, primarily curcumin, a natural polyphenol used as a food dye and spice with recognized safety and anti-inflammatory properties.
94569.benefits: Natural coloring agent, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, potential health benefits including improved digestion and joint health
94569.risks: Possible allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, photoallergic dermatitis (rare)

94664.name: Naturlig hallonarom
94664.description: Swedish for 'Natural raspberry flavor'; typically refers to flavoring derived from natural sources such as raspberry or other natural extracts. While labeled natural, such flavors can vary widely in composition and purity and may include processing aids or carriers.
94664.benefits: Provides natural fruity flavor, enhances palatability
94664.risks: Possible allergens, variability in composition, potential presence of processing solvents, ultra-processed with low nutritional value

94671.name: Äppelsyra (Malic Acid)
94671.description: Malic acid is an organic acid used as a food acidulant to impart sour taste and as a pH control agent.
94671.benefits: Enhances flavor as a souring agent, used to adjust acidity in foods and beverages
94671.risks: Irritation risk at high concentrations, potential gastrointestinal discomfort if consumed in large amounts

94781.name: CI 15985/FD&C Yellow No. 6
94781.description: Synthetic azo dye used as a color additive in foods, drugs, and cosmetics. Approved by FDA but associated with some adverse reactions and potential health concerns.
94781.risks: Allergic reactions, hyperactivity in children, possible carcinogenic metabolites, hypersensitivity, allergic dermatitis

94792.name: Strawberry & Banana Natural and Artificial Flavour
94792.description: A mixture of flavor compounds extracted from natural sources to mimic strawberry taste, combined with other natural flavorings. Used to impart flavor in foods and beverages.
94792.benefits: Imparts characteristic strawberry flavor, used to enhance palatability and sensory appeal of products
94792.risks: Potential for allergenic reactions, possible presence of trace pesticides or contaminants from natural sources, lacks transparency on exact chemical composition, risk of ultra-processing solvents or carriers

94926.name: Agmapure Agmatine Sulphate
94926.description: Agmatine sulfate is a dietary supplement form of agmatine, a biogenic amine derived from the amino acid arginine; it is used for potential cognitive, mood, and pain modulation benefits but is not an FDA-approved drug. It is generally regarded as safe for consumption in typical supplemental doses but lacks extensive long-term safety data.
94926.benefits: May support cognitive function, neuroprotection, mood enhancement, pain modulation, nitric oxide synthesis
94926.risks: Possible gastrointestinal upset, headache, hypotension in sensitive individuals, limited long-term safety data

95187.name: Calcium Disodium EDTA Added to Protect Flavor
95187.description: A chelating agent used as a sequestrant to bind metal ions and improve stability in food and cosmetic products.
95187.benefits: Prevents metal-catalyzed oxidation, preserves product stability and color
95187.risks: None at typical use levels, potential for digestive upset at high oral doses

95336.name: Vand
95336.description: Water, a universal solvent used as a base in food formulations.
95336.benefits: Hydration, solvent for ingredients, essential for life

95354.name: Sodium Benzoate [Preservative]
95354.description: Benzoic acid salt used as a preservative to inhibit microbial growth in acidic foods and beverages.
95354.benefits: Preserves food by inhibiting microbial growth, extends shelf-life
95354.risks: Irritant potential, possible formation of benzene under certain conditions, sensitivity reactions in some individuals

95441.name: Regulador de acidez INS 330
95441.description: Citric acid is an organic acid commonly used as an acidity regulator and flavoring agent in food and beverages.
95441.benefits: Acidity regulation, flavor enhancement, preservative effect by pH reduction
95441.risks: Dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, minor gastrointestinal irritation in sensitive individuals

95565.name: Nitrates/Nitrites
95565.description: Preservatives commonly used in processed meats to prevent bacterial growth and maintain color; nitrates can convert to nitrites and potentially form carcinogenic nitrosamines under certain conditions.
95565.benefits: Prevent growth of Clostridium botulinum in meats, preserve color and flavor
95565.risks: Possible increased risk of certain cancers, especially colorectal cancer, if consumed in large amounts; potential methemoglobinemia in infants

95570.name: Natürliches Zitronenaroma
95570.description: Natural lemon flavor derived from lemon oils or extracts, used to impart lemon taste in foods. Considered safe by FDA when used as intended, but composition can vary.
95570.benefits: Adds flavor, may contain beneficial compounds from lemon oils
95570.risks: Possible allergic reactions, generally safe but some natural flavor components may cause sensitivity

95645.name: Vitamin C Powder
95645.description: Ascorbic acid in powdered form, a potent antioxidant vitamin essential for immune function, collagen synthesis, and antioxidant protection. Recognized as safe and essential by FDA.
95645.benefits: Antioxidant, supports immune health, collagen production, wound healing
95645.risks: High doses may cause gastrointestinal upset, kidney stones in susceptible individuals

95665.name: Organic
95665.description: Label indicating that the ingredient was grown without synthetic pesticides, herbicides, and genetically modified organisms. Organic certification ensures compliance with specific agricultural standards.
95665.benefits: Reduced pesticide exposure, environmental benefits, supports sustainable agriculture

95754.name: Potassium Sorbate [Preservative]
95754.description: Salt of sorbic acid used as a food and cosmetic preservative to inhibit mold and yeast growth.
95754.benefits: Effective preservation against fungi, extends shelf life of products
95754.risks: Mild irritation potential, possible sensitization in rare cases, generally low toxicity at typical use levels

95834.name: Acesulfamo potásico
95834.description: Acesulfame potassium (acesulfame K) is a calorie-free artificial sweetener approved by FDA. It is used to provide sweetness without calories but has some concerns about long-term safety.
95834.benefits: Calorie-free sweetener, helps reduce sugar intake, stable under heat
95834.risks: Potential metabolic effects, controversial data regarding carcinogenicity and gut microbiome changes

95972.name: Acidificante: acido citrico
95972.description: Citric acid is a common food acidulant used for flavor and preservation; generally recognized as safe; excessive consumption may cause mild gastrointestinal discomfort.
95972.risks: Possible mild gastrointestinal irritation at very high intake

95988.name: Cloruro de benzalconio
95988.description: Benzalkonium chloride, a quaternary ammonium compound used as a disinfectant and surfactant.
95988.risks: Skin and eye irritation, potential respiratory sensitizer, toxic if ingested in large amounts

96007.name: Karbondioksit
96007.description: Carbon dioxide (CO2) is a colorless gas commonly used in food processing (e.g., carbonation, modified atmosphere packaging). It is non-toxic at typical exposure levels and generally recognized as safe for food applications.
96007.benefits: Used for food preservation and carbonation
96007.risks: None in normal use; excessive inhalation can cause respiratory distress

96008.name: Antioksidan: askorbik asit
96008.description: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) is a well-known antioxidant used as a food additive to prevent oxidation and preserve freshness. It is essential for human health and FDA recognized as safe.
96008.benefits: Antioxidant, supports immune function, collagen synthesis, food preservation
96008.risks: Rare gastrointestinal discomfort with excessive intake

96069.name: Benzoate de potassium
96069.description: Potassium benzoate is a potassium salt of benzoic acid used as a preservative to inhibit microbial growth in food and beverages.
96069.benefits: Effective antimicrobial preservative, extends shelf life of products
96069.risks: Potential mild irritation, possible formation of benzene under acidic conditions, allergic reactions in sensitive individuals

96203.name: Chlorure de calcium
96203.description: Calcium chloride is a salt used in food processing as a firming agent, preservative, and electrolyte additive. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used in accordance with good manufacturing practices.
96203.benefits: Provides calcium, acts as a preservative, improves texture in canned or processed foods
96203.risks: Excessive ingestion may cause gastrointestinal irritation, hypercalcemia in rare cases

96241.name: Vitamin B5 Supplement
96241.description: Water-soluble vitamin (pantothenic acid) essential for synthesizing coenzyme A, important in energy metabolism and synthesis of fatty acids.
96241.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, aids synthesis of fatty acids and coenzyme A, essential nutrient
96241.risks: Rarely causes irritation or sensitization at high topical doses, excessive oral intake may cause mild gastrointestinal symptoms

96563.name: Sodium Lauryl Phosphate Ester Magnesium Salt
96563.description: An anionic surfactant and phosphate ester salt used for cleaning and emulsifying. It belongs to the class of phosphate esters and is a derivative of sodium lauryl phosphate with magnesium counterion.
96563.benefits: Effective surfactant for soil removal, good emulsifying properties, biodegradable
96563.risks: Skin irritation, eye irritation, potential for mild sensitization at higher concentrations

96602.name: Erythrit
96602.description: A sugar alcohol used as a low-calorie sweetener that provides sweetness with minimal digestion and absorption.
96602.benefits: Low calorie sweetener, does not raise blood glucose or insulin, dental-friendly
96602.risks: Gastrointestinal discomfort at high doses, laxative effect in sensitive individuals

96761.name: Pentapotassium bis(peroxymonosulphate) bis(sulphate)
96761.description: Sulphates are salts or esters of sulfuric acid, commonly present as ions in water and various compounds.
96761.benefits: Essential dietary mineral in small amounts, involved in detoxification and synthesis of biological molecules
96761.risks: Irritation potential depending on compound form, ingestion in high amounts may cause laxative effects, potential contamination with heavy metals in industrial forms

96775.name: Natural colour (purple carrot concentrate)
96775.description: Natural colorant derived from purple carrots, primarily providing anthocyanin pigments. Used to impart purple color in food products.

96840.name: Prírodná minerálna voda
96840.description: Natural mineral water containing essential minerals beneficial for hydration and mineral intake; recognized as safe for consumption by regulatory authorities.

96841.name: Kyselina citrónová
96841.description: Organic acid commonly used as an acidity regulator and preservative in food products.
96841.benefits: Controls acidity, enhances flavor, improves preservation by inhibiting microbial growth
96841.risks: Irritant to skin and eyes in concentrated form, potential dental enamel erosion with excessive ingestion, minor sensitizer

96938.name: Steviablätter
96938.description: Steviablätter are the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant, commonly used as a natural sweetener. They contain steviol glycosides, which provide sweetness without calories. In their whole leaf form, stevia leaves have been consumed traditionally and are generally recognized as safe. The FDA permits purified steviol glycosides as additives but does not approve whole leaf or crude extracts as food additives due to a lack of sufficient safety data.
96938.benefits: Natural zero-calorie sweetener, may help regulate blood sugar, antioxidant properties
96938.risks: Potential allergenicity, possible gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals, whole leaf not FDA approved as additive

96963.name: Kolsyra
96963.description: Kolsyra is the Swedish term for carbonic acid, which forms when carbon dioxide dissolves in water. It is commonly used in beverages as carbonation and is recognized as safe for consumption.
96963.benefits: Adds carbonation and mild acidity to beverages, enhances taste

97043.name: Jus d'orange concentré biologique
97043.description: Organic concentrated orange juice is derived from freshly squeezed orange juice that has been concentrated by removing water content. It retains natural vitamins and nutrients but has a higher sugar concentration. It is considered safe for consumption and provides vitamin C and antioxidants. The organic designation indicates production without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers.
97043.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, antioxidants, supports immune function, natural source of nutrients
97043.risks: High sugar content, potential dental erosion with excessive consumption

97064.name: Sweetener: E 955 (Sucralose)
97064.description: Sucralose is a non-nutritive artificial sweetener used to provide sweetness without calories.
97064.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, does not raise blood sugar, supports calorie reduction
97064.risks: Potential for gut microbiota alterations, possible digestive discomfort in some individuals

97161.name: Calcium pantothenate [Vitamin B5]
97161.description: Water-soluble vitamin serving as a precursor to coenzyme A, important in fatty acid metabolism.
97161.benefits: Supports energy production, fatty acid metabolism, and wound healing
97161.risks: Generally low toxicity, safe at recommended intake levels

97220.name: Conservante Benzoato de Sódio
97220.description: Sodium benzoate is a commonly used preservative that inhibits microbial growth in acidic foods and beverages.
97220.benefits: Effective antimicrobial preservative, extends shelf life of acidic products
97220.risks: Irritation potential in sensitive individuals, possible allergen, limited endocrine disruption concerns at typical use, formation of benzene under certain conditions

97222.name: Acidifier E338 (Phosphoric Acid)
97222.description: Phosphoric acid is an inorganic acid used in food and beverages to acidify and add tartness.
97222.benefits: Provides sour taste, acts as a preservative and pH regulator in foods and beverages
97222.risks: Dental erosion with excessive consumption, potential mineral imbalance with high intake

97223.name: Conservante (sorbato de potássio)
97223.description: Potassium sorbate is a commonly used food preservative that inhibits mold, yeast, and some bacteria growth. It is generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA when used within approved limits.
97223.benefits: Prevents food spoilage, extends shelf life
97223.risks: Possible allergic reactions, mild gastrointestinal irritation in sensitive individuals, potential hypersensitivity

97286.name: Doğal maden suyu
97286.description: Natural mineral water containing dissolved minerals and trace elements from geological sources.
97286.risks: Contaminants possible depending on source quality, microbiological contamination if untreated

97287.name: Asitliği düzenleyici (sitrik asit)
97287.description: Citric acid, a natural organic acid used to regulate acidity in foods. Generally recognized as safe by the FDA and commonly used in food products.
97287.benefits: Maintains food pH, natural preservative, enhances flavor
97287.risks: May cause mild dental erosion with excessive consumption

97288.name: Karadut
97288.description: Black mulberry fruit, a natural whole food rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and fiber. Safe and nutritious for consumption.
97288.benefits: Rich in antioxidants, vitamins C and K, dietary fiber

97289.name: Frenk üzümü
97289.description: Currant fruit, a natural source of vitamins, antioxidants, and dietary fiber. Generally safe and beneficial to include in diet.

97290.name: Sodyum benzoat
97290.description: Sodium benzoate, a synthetic preservative widely used to prevent microbial growth in acidic foods and beverages. Approved by FDA but may cause adverse reactions in sensitive individuals.
97290.risks: Potential to cause allergic reactions, rare hypersensitivity, possible benzene formation with ascorbic acid

97291.name: Potasyum sorbat
97291.description: Potassium sorbate, a synthetic preservative used to inhibit molds and yeasts in foods. Generally recognized as safe but can cause mild irritation or allergies in some individuals.
97291.benefits: Prevents microbial spoilage, prolongs product shelf life
97291.risks: Possible mild allergic reactions, skin irritation

97292.name: Renklendirici (antosiyanin)
97292.description: Anthocyanins, natural pigments found in fruits and vegetables that provide red, purple, and blue colors. They have antioxidant properties and are considered safe as natural colorants.

97320.name: Kalsiyum
97320.description: Calcium, an essential mineral vital for bone health, nerve transmission, and muscle function. Commonly supplemented in diet.
97320.benefits: Supports bone density, muscle function, nerve signaling
97320.risks: Hypercalcemia with excessive intake rare in normal consumption

97510.name: Tin
97510.description: Metal used industrially and occasionally as a food packaging material (tin cans). Trace amounts in food are generally regarded as safe by regulatory agencies, but tin metal itself is not a food ingredient.
97510.risks: Potential toxicity in high concentrations, gastrointestinal irritation if ingested in excess, not intended for direct consumption

97653.name: Fresh grapefruit juice
97653.description: Fresh grapefruit juice is rich in vitamin C, potassium, and bioactive flavonoids. It has nutritional benefits but is known for interactions with many medications due to furanocoumarins inhibiting cytochrome P450 enzymes. Generally safe to consume but caution advised if taking certain drugs.
97653.benefits: Rich in vitamin C, antioxidants, supports immune function
97653.risks: Drug interactions (especially with statins, calcium channel blockers), photosensitivity, potential gastrointestinal irritation

97776.name: Aroma de naranja
97776.description: Orange flavor, may be natural or artificial, used to enhance taste. Artificial flavors are often considered ultra-processed additives with limited transparency.
97776.risks: Potential exposure to synthetic chemicals, allergic reactions in sensitive individuals

97910.name: Preservative Potassium metabisulfite E224
97910.description: Potassium metabisulfite is a sulfite preservative used to prevent microbial growth and oxidation in food and beverages.
97910.benefits: Prevents microbial spoilage, inhibits enzymatic and oxidative browning, extends shelf life
97910.risks: Irritation, allergic sensitization especially in sulfite-sensitive individuals, potential respiratory irritation, contamination risk due to residual sulfur dioxide

98379.name: Concentrate
98379.description: A general term referring to a substance in concentrated form, often fruit or vegetable juice concentrate in food contexts, containing nutritive components in reduced volume.
98379.benefits: Contains concentrated nutrients and natural flavor compounds if from fruit or vegetable origin
98379.risks: Can have increased sugar content if fruit-based, potential processing contaminants depending on source

98380.name: Acidifier: E330
98380.description: Citric acid, a naturally occurring organic acid used extensively as a flavoring and acidifying agent; generally recognized as safe by FDA.
98380.benefits: Enhances flavor, acts as a preservative by lowering pH, antioxidant properties
98380.risks: May cause dental erosion in excessive amounts, mild gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals

98424.name: Přírodní minerální voda
98424.description: Natural mineral water derived from underground sources containing minerals. Generally safe and hydrating with essential mineral content varying by source. Recognized as a food ingredient with no inherent harm.
98424.benefits: Hydration, source of natural minerals like calcium, magnesium

98425.name: Regulátory kyselosti: kyselina citronová
98425.description: Citric acid used as an acidity regulator and preservative in foods. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by FDA though can cause mild irritation or tooth enamel erosion in excess.
98425.benefits: Preserves food freshness, enhances flavor, aids mineral absorption
98425.risks: Dental enamel erosion with high consumption, possible mild digestive irritation

98496.name: Non-nutritive sweetener sucralose
98496.description: Sucralose is a chlorinated artificial sweetener used to provide sweetness without calories.
98496.benefits: Provides intense sweetness without calories, does not raise blood glucose levels, stable under heat allowing use in cooking
98496.risks: Potential gut microbiota alterations, possible glucose metabolism effects in sensitive individuals, minor gastrointestinal discomfort reported, processing byproduct concerns

98499.name: Color: beta carotene (E160a)
98499.description: A red-orange pigment found in plants and fruits, used as a natural colorant and a precursor to vitamin A in the human body.
98499.benefits: Source of provitamin A, supports vision and immune function, provides natural coloring
98499.risks: High-dose supplementation associated with increased lung cancer risk in smokers, potential skin discoloration at excessive intake

99164.name: Wild Indigo Herb
99164.description: Herbal ingredient derived from Baptisia species, traditionally used in herbal medicine for its immune-support and antimicrobial properties. Not a typical food ingredient; used in supplements and herbal preparations.
99164.benefits: Immune support, antimicrobial activity, traditional use for respiratory and inflammation ailments
99164.risks: Potential allergic reactions, gastrointestinal upset, toxicity at high doses

99313.name: Alkalinity sources
99313.description: Chemical compounds used to increase the pH in cleaning products, commonly including sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide, sodium carbonate. Serve to enhance cleaning efficiency by breaking down organic soils.
99313.benefits: Improved cleaning efficacy through saponification and soil dispersion, enhanced grease removal
99313.risks: Skin irritation, eye irritation, chemical burns (depending on type and concentration), respiratory irritation (dust or vapors from strong alkalis)

100024.name: Reguladores de la acidez: ácido cítrico
100024.description: Food additives used to control or adjust the acidity or alkalinity (pH) of foods; examples include citric acid, phosphates, and carbonates.
100024.benefits: Preserve food stability, improve flavor, enhance shelf life
100024.risks: Generally low toxicity; excessive intake of some (e.g., phosphates) may affect mineral balance, potential digestive irritation at high levels
