112520.description: Carbonated water containing dissolved carbon dioxide gas, providing effervescence.
112520.benefits: Hydration, calorie-free alternative to sugary beverages
112520.risks: Mild dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, potential gastrointestinal discomfort

112690.name: Sitronjuicekonsentrat
112690.description: Concentrated lemon juice used for flavor and acidity, source of vitamin C and organic acids.
112690.benefits: Source of vitamin C, natural acidulant for flavor and preservation
112690.risks: Potential dental enamel erosion from acidic content with chronic exposure

112922.name: Kuldioxid
112922.description: Kuldioxid is carbon dioxide, a gas commonly used for carbonation in beverages and as a preservative agent.
112922.benefits: Used as a preservative and carbonation agent, non-toxic in typical food use levels
112922.risks: Inhalation at high concentrations can cause respiratory irritation or asphyxiation in confined spaces

112923.name: Konserveringsmiddel (E202)
112923.description: Potassium sorbate (E202) is a commonly used food preservative inhibiting mold and yeast growth.
112923.benefits: Prevents microbial growth, extends shelf life of food products
112923.risks: Possible mild irritation or sensitization in sensitive individuals, rare allergic reactions

113327.name: Dye (copper chlorophyllin)
113327.description: A water-soluble derivative of chlorophyll used as a green food coloring agent.
113327.benefits: Stable green colorant used to improve appearance of foods
113327.risks: Possible irritation or sensitization in rare cases, minimal toxicity at approved usage levels

113410.name: Vegetable Extract (Carrot, Pumpkin) for Color
113410.description: Extracts derived from carrot and pumpkin vegetables used primarily as natural colorants in food and cosmetic products.
113410.benefits: Natural coloring agent, provides carotenoids which have antioxidant properties
113410.risks: Irritation or sensitization risk in sensitive individuals, potential contamination with pesticide residues depending on source, oxidation instability in some formulations

113613.name: Sulfato Ácido de Sodio
113613.description: Sodium acid sulfate, an acidic agent used as a pH adjuster or preservative.
113613.risks: Potential mild irritation if concentrated, no significant toxicity at typical food use

113919.name: Jus d'orange à base de concentré
113919.description: Orange juice made from concentrate containing 4% juice, typically reconstituted by adding water and sometimes sweeteners or preservatives.
113919.benefits: Source of vitamin C and some antioxidants, rehydration beverage
113919.risks: Contains natural sugars, potential for added sugars or preservatives in processing, possible loss of vitamins compared to fresh juice

114049.name: Jahodové aróma
114049.description: Strawberry flavoring, typically a mixture of natural and/or synthetic aroma compounds to impart strawberry scent.
114049.benefits: Improves palatability and sensory appeal of products
114049.risks: Potential for allergenic reactions or sensitization in sensitive individuals, potential synthetic chemical exposure

114419.name: Sucre Liquide
114419.description: Liquid sugar primarily composed of sucrose dissolved in water, used as a sweetener and humectant in food products.
114419.benefits: Provides sweetness and moisture retention in food products
114419.risks: Excessive intake associated with increased caloric consumption and potential contribution to obesity and dental caries

114546.name: Fruit Juices from Concentrate (Orange, Strawberry, Lemon) (3%)
114546.description: Concentrated fruit juices reconstituted with water to original juice concentration, providing flavor and some nutrients.
114546.benefits: Source of natural flavor, vitamins (notably vitamin C), antioxidants
114546.risks: Natural sugars contributing to caloric intake, possible allergen risk in sensitive individuals, potential acidity irritation

114596.name: Food Acid [Citric Acid]
114596.description: Organic acid commonly used to adjust acidity and preserve foods.
114596.benefits: Preserves food by lowering pH, enhances flavor by adding sourness
114596.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, dental enamel erosion risk if consumed excessively

114881.name: Syre (E330)
114881.description: Citric acid, a weak organic acid commonly used as a acidulant and preservative in food and beverages.
114881.benefits: Acidulant for flavor and preservation, antioxidant synergist
114881.risks: Dental erosion with excessive consumption, mild irritant at high concentrations

114918.name: Acidity Regulators (INS 330, INS 331 (iii), INS 296)
114918.description: Substances used to control the acidity or alkalinity of food products. E330 is citric acid, E296 is malic acid, and E331 is sodium citrate.
114918.benefits: Control pH to improve product stability, taste profile enhancement, preservation of food quality
114918.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, possible dental erosion from acids, minimal systemic toxicity at typical use

114948.name: Carbonat
114948.description: Likely referring to carbonate salts, commonly used as acid regulators or raising agents in food products.
114948.benefits: Used to regulate acidity and improve texture in food applications
114948.risks: Generally low risk at typical exposure; excessive ingestion of carbonate salts may cause gastrointestinal discomfort

115197.name: Menthe (Mint)
115197.description: Mentha species leaves, widely used as a flavoring and aromatic herb, containing menthol and other volatile compounds.
115197.benefits: Flavoring agent, mild digestive aid, aroma enhancer
115197.risks: Potential skin and mucous membrane irritation, allergic sensitization in some individuals

115567.name: Trans fat
115567.description: Type of unsaturated fat with at least one double bond in trans configuration, often industrially produced through partial hydrogenation of oils.
115567.risks: Increased cardiovascular disease risk, raises LDL cholesterol, lowers HDL cholesterol, associated with coronary heart disease

115569.name: Saturated Fat
115569.description: A class of fatty acids with no double bonds, found in animal fats and some plant oils, contributing to energy storage and cell membrane structure.
115569.benefits: Energy source, supports cell membrane integrity and hormone production
115569.risks: Excessive intake associated with increased LDL cholesterol and cardiovascular disease risk

115867.name: Kalsiyum klorür
115867.description: Calcium chloride, an inorganic salt used as a firming agent, flavor enhancer, and preservative in foods.
115867.benefits: Provides calcium, improves texture and shelf-life of foods
115867.risks: High ingestion amounts may cause gastrointestinal discomfort

115946.name: Acidity Regulator (E330, E331(iii))
115946.description: E330 is citric acid, a weak organic acid used to control the acidity of food and beverages. E331(iii) is trisodium citrate, a sodium salt of citric acid used as an acidity regulator, sequestrant, and preservative enhancer.
115946.benefits: Controls acidity, preserves food stability, enhances flavor
115946.risks: Irritation to mucous membranes in high amounts, excessive sodium intake from trisodium citrate

115967.name: Třtinový cukr
115967.description: Sugar derived from sugarcane, primarily sucrose used as a sweetener.
115967.risks: Excessive intake associated with obesity, dental caries, and metabolic disturbances

116052.name: Sarı demir oksit
116052.description: Yellow iron oxide is an inorganic pigment commonly used for coloring in cosmetics, paints, and coatings.
116052.benefits: Provides stable, non-toxic pigmentation, UV protection in cosmetics
116052.risks: Potential for dermal and respiratory irritation in powder form, contamination risk if impurities present

116141.name: Farbstoff E 141
116141.description: Colorants used in cleaning products to provide color. Chemical composition varies widely depending on specific dye used.
116141.benefits: Improves product aesthetic appeal, consumer acceptance
116141.risks: Potential skin irritation, potential allergic reactions depending on dye type

116265.name: Citroenzuur [E330]
116265.description: Citric acid is a weak organic acid used primarily as an acidity regulator, preservative, and flavor enhancer in food products.
116265.benefits: Enhances flavor, preserves food stability, chelates metal ions to prevent spoilage
116265.risks: Potential minor irritation with excessive ingestion or contact, erosion risk to dental enamel with overconsumption

116309.name: Total sugars
116309.description: Total sugars represent the sum of all monosaccharides and disaccharides present in a product, contributing to caloric content and sweetness.
116309.risks: Excessive intake associated with increased risk of obesity and dental caries

116387.name: Orange and black carrot concentrate
116387.description: Concentrated extract from black carrots primarily used as a natural colorant due to its high anthocyanin content.
116387.benefits: Natural coloring agent, contains antioxidant anthocyanins
116387.risks: Irritation or sensitization rare but possible in sensitive individuals, potential contamination depending on processing, minimal ingestion toxicity at typical use levels

116866.name: Potassium Sorbate (food grade preservative)
116866.description: Mixture of common food preservatives: potassium sorbate (antimicrobial), BHT and TBHQ (antioxidants), and citric acid (acidulant and preservative).
116866.benefits: Prevent microbial growth and oxidation, extend shelf life of products
116866.risks: Irritation and sensitization potential, possible endocrine disruption (BHT, TBHQ), contamination risk from processing byproducts, regulatory limits on TBHQ levels

116885.name: Lycopene and beta-apo-8'-carotenal (for color)
116885.description: Natural carotenoid pigments used as food colorants; lycopene commonly found in tomatoes, beta-apo-8'-carotenal is a cleavage product of carotenoids.
116885.benefits: Provide natural red to orange color in foods, potential antioxidant properties
116885.risks: Rare allergic reactions or sensitivities; excessive intake could cause carotenodermia

116915.name: Conservante: benzoato de sodio
116915.description: Sodium benzoate is a widely used preservative in food and cosmetic products, functioning primarily to inhibit microbial growth and extend shelf life.
116915.benefits: Effective antimicrobial preservative at low concentrations, extends product shelf life, prevents spoilage
116915.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, potential to form benzene under acidic conditions, possible allergen, concerns over hyperactivity in children disputed

117251.name: Gaz carbonique
117251.description: Carbon dioxide gas used primarily as a carbonation agent in beverages to impart effervescence.
117251.benefits: Provides carbonation and texture in beverages

117259.name: Naturlige aromaer
117259.description: Natural flavor compounds extracted from natural ingredients used to enhance taste and aroma in foods.
117259.benefits: Enhances sensory appeal of food products
117259.risks: Possible allergenicity, variable chemical composition, potential processing contaminants

117324.name: Cukr
117324.description: Common term for sugar, primarily sucrose derived from sugarcane or sugar beet. 'Ekologické zemědělství' denotes organic farming practices used in cultivation.
117324.risks: Excessive consumption linked to dental caries, weight gain, and metabolic disorders

117364.name: Acide carbonique
117364.description: Carbonic acid, a weak acid formed when carbon dioxide dissolves in water. Commonly used in carbonated beverages to provide fizz and acidity.
117364.benefits: Provides carbonation and acidity in beverages, contributes to flavor
117364.risks: Dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption, mild irritation risk in concentrated form

117741.name: Organic-Cane Sugar
117741.description: Sucrose derived from sugarcane, used as a sweetener in foods and beverages.
117741.benefits: Provides energy as a carbohydrate source
117741.risks: Excessive intake associated with obesity, dental caries, and metabolic disorders

117846.name: Beyaz şeker
117846.description: Refined white sugar primarily composed of sucrose used as a sweetener in foods and beverages.
117846.risks: Excessive intake associated with obesity, type 2 diabetes risk, dental caries

117953.name: Trimethoprim Sulfate
117953.description: An inorganic anion commonly found in water, food, and many products. Sulfates are naturally occurring and essential in small amounts for various biological processes.
117953.benefits: Essential nutrient in dietary sources, supports biological functions
117953.risks: None at typical low exposure levels

118001.name: Carbon dioxide of natural origin
118001.description: Inorganic gas used in cleaning products primarily as a propellant or in carbonation. Non-toxic at typical exposure levels but can cause asphyxiation in confined spaces at high concentrations.
118001.benefits: Non-flammable, non-toxic under normal conditions, inert propellant
118001.risks: Asphyxiation at very high concentrations, dizziness in enclosed areas

118114.name: Organic KSM-66 Ashwagandha Root Fruiting Body Extract
118114.description: Standardized extract of Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) root and fruiting body, used as an adaptogen.
118114.benefits: Stress modulation, adaptogenic effects, potential improvement in cognitive function and physical performance
118114.risks: Mild gastrointestinal discomfort, potential allergenicity, possible interactions with thyroid or sedative medications

118359.name: Edulcorantes Sucralosa 11
118359.description: Sucralose is a synthetic non-nutritive sweetener used to provide sweetness without calories.
118359.benefits: Provides intense sweetening without calories, does not raise blood glucose, heat stable for cooking
118359.risks: Possible alteration of gut microbiota, potential digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals, environmental persistence

118474.name: Acidifying Agent (Citric Acid)
118474.description: Organic acid used to acidify foods and beverages, acts as a preservative and flavoring agent.
118474.benefits: Preserves food by lowering pH, enhances flavor, natural antioxidant properties
118474.risks: Mild irritant potential to skin, eyes, or mucous membranes at high concentrations

118517.name: Gold Extract
118517.description: Gold is a heavy metal sometimes present in trace amounts in water and products.
118517.benefits: None relevant at trace environmental or dietary levels
118517.risks: None at trace levels, potential for skin sensitization in some topical forms

118611.name: Eau minérale naturelle gazeuse
118611.description: Naturally carbonated mineral water sourced from spring, containing dissolved minerals and carbon dioxide.
118611.benefits: Hydration, mineral content, carbonation can aid digestion

118783.name: Ciclamato de sódio
118783.description: Cyclamate is an artificial sweetener used as a sugar substitute in food and beverages.
118783.risks: Potential carcinogenicity in high doses based on animal studies, regulatory restrictions in some countries

118863.name: Kulsyre
118863.description: Carbonic acid formed when carbon dioxide is dissolved in water; used to create carbonation in beverages.
118863.benefits: Provides effervescence and sensory enhancement in beverages

118940.name: Edulcorantes: E-950
118940.description: Aspartame and acesulfame potassium (acesulfame K) are low-calorie artificial sweeteners used to provide sweetness without added calories.
118940.benefits: Provides sweetness with minimal calories, useful for sugar reduction and glycemic control
118940.risks: Possible neurobehavioral effects debated, phenylketonuria concerns for aspartame, potential effect on gut microbiota under study

119370.name: Naturally Occurring Mineral Water
119370.description: Water sourced from natural mineral springs containing various dissolved minerals such as calcium, magnesium, and bicarbonates.
119370.benefits: Provides hydration, source of dietary minerals such as calcium and magnesium

119373.name: Naturally occurring carbonation
119373.description: Dissolved carbon dioxide in water, producing carbonic acid and effervescence.
119373.benefits: Provides effervescence and sensory experience in beverages
119373.risks: Mild dental enamel erosion risk with frequent acidic exposure

119382.name: Lightly mineralized natural mineral water
119382.description: Water sourced from natural springs containing low levels of dissolved minerals such as calcium, magnesium, and bicarbonates.
119382.benefits: Hydration, source of minerals like calcium and magnesium at low concentrations

119385.name: Natural Mineral Water with Carbonation (Fuente Primavera)
119385.description: Natural mineral water containing dissolved natural carbon dioxide gas for carbonation.
119385.benefits: Hydration, provides mineral content, carbonation sensation

119391.name: Cold Pressed Lemon Extract
119391.description: Extract obtained by mechanically pressing lemon peel or fruit without heat, preserving volatile compounds and flavor constituents.
119391.benefits: Provides natural flavor and aroma, contains phytochemicals including limonene with antioxidant properties
119391.risks: Irritation potential especially in sensitive skin or when exposed to sunlight (photosensitivity), allergenic potential

119393.name: Agua mineral natural con gas
119393.description: Natural mineral water with dissolved carbon dioxide gas, resulting in carbonation.
119393.benefits: Hydration, source of minerals depending on origin

119394.name: Sulfat
119394.description: Sulfate compounds are salts or esters of sulfuric acid; often used in food additives and water treatment processes.
119394.benefits: Used for mineral supplementation, water purification
119394.risks: None at typical dietary exposure, excessive ingestion may cause mild gastrointestinal effects

119396.name: Magnesium (14.2 mg/L)
119396.description: Magnesium is an essential mineral involved in numerous enzymatic reactions, muscle and nerve function, and bone health.
119396.benefits: Supports muscle and nerve function, enzymatic activity, bone health
119396.risks: None at typical low concentrations in water

119397.name: Sodium (<0.2 mg/L)
119397.description: Sodium is an essential electrolyte important for fluid balance and nerve and muscle function; concentrations below 0.2 mg/L are very low.
119397.benefits: Supports fluid balance, nerve transmission, muscle contraction
119397.risks: None at low concentration in water

119398.name: Sparkling Artesian Water
119398.description: Water sourced from an artesian aquifer that is naturally carbonated or carbonated by addition of CO2 to create effervescence.
119398.benefits: Hydration, contains natural minerals depending on source

119691.name: Conservante (E202)
119691.description: INS 202 is potassium sorbate, a preservative to inhibit mold and yeast growth; INS 955 is sucralose, a non-nutritive artificial sweetener.
119691.benefits: Potassium sorbate preserves product safety and shelf life, sucralose provides sweetening without calories
119691.risks: Potassium sorbate may cause mild irritation or allergies in some; sucralose has debated safety but generally considered low risk at typical intake, potential impact on gut microbiota

119872.name: Citron 1
119872.description: Lemon content at about 1%, used for flavor and acidity in formulations.
119872.benefits: Natural flavor, source of vitamin C and antioxidants
119872.risks: Possible mild skin irritation in sensitive individuals upon topical exposure, None in ingestion at low concentrations

119874.name: Naturlig sötning från frukt
119874.description: Natural sweetener derived from fruit sources, likely fructose or glucose-rich syrups.
119874.benefits: Provides sweetness from natural sources, avoids synthetic sweeteners
119874.risks: Excessive intake may contribute to increased caloric consumption and metabolic effects

119937.name: Persica
119937.description: A herbal extract derived from the seeds of Prunus persica (peach), traditionally used in oral hygiene products for its potential antimicrobial properties.
119937.benefits: Antimicrobial activity, may reduce oral bacteria
119937.risks: Possible skin and mucosal irritation, potential allergen sensitization

120633.name: Göm arabik
120633.description: Gum arabic, also known as acacia gum, is a natural polysaccharide obtained from the sap of Acacia trees, used primarily as a stabilizer, emulsifier, and thickening agent in foods.
120633.benefits: Dietary fiber source, stabilizes emulsions, thickening and film-forming properties
120633.risks: Possible minor allergic reactions or digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals

120703.name: Acid regulator [e331]
120703.description: Sodium citrates, salts of citric acid used to regulate acidity and act as emulsifiers in food.
120703.benefits: Controls acidity, stabilizes textures, acts as emulsifier
120703.risks: High sodium intake if consumed excessively

121273.name: Orange Juice (10%) [Reconstituted from Orange Juice Concentrate]
121273.description: Orange juice reconstituted from concentrate containing natural sugars, vitamins, and antioxidants.
121273.benefits: Source of vitamin C and antioxidants, hydration, natural flavoring
121273.risks: High sugar content, potential for dental erosion, possible loss of some nutrients during concentration and reconstitution

121407.name: Dry place
121407.description: Storage instruction indicating product should be kept in a moisture-free environment to maintain quality.
121407.benefits: Helps preserve product stability and prevent spoilage

121703.name: Koruyucu (potasyum sorbat)
121703.description: Potassium sorbate is a widely used preservative to inhibit molds and yeasts in food products.
121703.benefits: Prevents microbial spoilage, extends shelf life of food products
121703.risks: Skin and eye irritant potential, rare hypersensitivity reactions

122032.name: Antioksidans (askorbinska kiselina)
122032.description: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C), a water-soluble antioxidant used to prevent oxidation and nutrient degradation in foods.
122032.benefits: Antioxidant, preserves food quality, supports immune function
122032.risks: None at typical dietary or food additive levels

122176.name: Jus de pomme à base de concentré
122176.description: Apple juice concentrate is a concentrated form of apple juice with reduced water content, primarily used as a sweetener or flavoring agent in food and beverages.
122176.benefits: Source of natural sugars and flavor
122176.risks: High sugar content, potential dental caries risk, caloric contribution

122487.name: Aroma natural de limão
122487.description: Natural lemon flavoring derived from lemon peel oils or extracts, used for imparting lemon scent or taste in food and beverages.
122487.benefits: Provides lemon flavor and aroma, contributes to sensory appeal, natural flavoring alternative
122487.risks: Skin sensitization in sensitive individuals, potential allergen, possible presence of phototoxic compounds like limonene

122863.name: White Peach Juice from Concentrate (2%)
122863.description: Juice derived from concentrated peach juice, used as a flavoring and sweetening agent in beverages and foods at low concentration (2%).
122863.benefits: Provides natural flavor and some micronutrients, dietary fluid source
122863.risks: Possible sugar content contributing to caloric intake, minimal allergenicity

122864.name: Stabilizers: Gum Arabic and Glycerol Esters of Wood Rosins
122864.description: Gum Arabic is a natural polysaccharide used as an emulsifier and stabilizer. Glycerol esters of wood rosins are food-grade emulsifiers derived from pine wood resin, used to stabilize beverages by suspending oils.
122864.benefits: Effective emulsification and stabilization of beverages, improve texture and uniformity
122864.risks: Gum Arabic may cause rare allergic reactions; glycerol esters of wood rosins have low toxicity but concern exists over resin-derived contaminants at high intake

123015.name: Agavesirup
123015.description: Sweetener derived from the agave plant, primarily composed of fructose and glucose.
123015.benefits: Natural sweetener alternative to refined sugar
123015.risks: High fructose content with potential for excessive caloric intake, potential impact on weight gain

123884.name: Natural strawberry flavouring
123884.description: Extracted flavor compounds derived from strawberries or related natural sources used to impart strawberry flavor in foods and products.
123884.benefits: Flavor enhancement, improves palatability and consumer acceptance
123884.risks: Potential allergen, sensitization risk, possible contamination with solvent residues, lack of transparency in composition

123937.name: Thiamine
123937.description: Water-soluble vitamin B1 essential for carbohydrate metabolism and neural function.
123937.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, nerve function, prevents deficiency-related disorders
123937.risks: Rare allergic reactions at high doses

124152.name: Quellwasser
124152.description: Natural spring water collected from a natural underground source, typically used for drinking and hydration.
124152.benefits: Hydration, source of minerals depending on origin

125488.name: Juice från koncentrat
125488.description: Juice reconstituted from concentrate, commonly used as a beverage ingredient.
125488.risks: Possible sugar content leading to excessive intake if consumed in excess

125577.name: Reconstituted Cranberry Juice
125577.description: Cranberry juice made by diluting concentrated cranberry juice back to original water content; contains natural fruit sugars, organic acids, and polyphenols.
125577.benefits: Source of dietary antioxidants, provides vitamin C, hydration, and fruit-derived phytochemicals
125577.risks: High natural sugar content, potential dental erosion with excessive consumption, possible gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals

125615.name: Natural and Nature-identical Flavouring Substances
125615.description: Chemical substances used to impart flavor in food products; natural flavorings are derived from natural sources, while nature-identical flavors are synthetically produced but chemically identical to natural ones.
125615.risks: Potential allergic sensitization, presence of undeclared allergens, ultra-processed ingredient, may contain solvents or additives

125696.name: Sweeteners E955 (Sucralose)
125696.description: Sucralose is an artificial non-nutritive sweetener approximately 600 times sweeter than sucrose, used to provide sweetness without calories.
125696.benefits: Provides sweetness without calories, useful in sugar reduction strategies
125696.risks: Potential gut microbiota alterations, possible glucose intolerance in some studies, controversial metabolic effects

126364.name: Aroma: chinina monocloridrato diidrato
126364.description: Chloroquine dihydrate is a synthetic bitter compound; here likely referring to quinine hydrochloride dihydrate used as a flavoring agent with bitter tonic properties.
126364.benefits: Bitter flavor agent, used in tonic beverages
126364.risks: Allergic reactions, potential hypersensitivity, possible interaction risks on ingestion at high doses, regulatory restrictions in food at high concentrations

126643.name: Cloruro de potasio
126643.description: Potassium chloride and/or dicalcium phosphate, minerals used for fortification and electrolyte balance.
126643.benefits: Provide essential electrolytes and calcium for bone health and cellular processes
126643.risks: Excessive intake of potassium chloride may cause hyperkalemia in susceptible individuals

126700.name: Michigan Blueberries
126700.description: Blueberries cultivated in Michigan, rich in vitamins, antioxidants, and dietary fiber. Commonly consumed as food or in dietary supplements.
126700.benefits: Source of antioxidants (anthocyanins), vitamins C and K, dietary fiber, potential cardiovascular and cognitive support
126700.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, pesticide residue potential depending on cultivation

126724.name: Fläder
126724.description: Fläder is the Swedish term for elderflower, derived from the Sambucus nigra plant. Elderflower is commonly used as a flavoring or botanical ingredient in beverages and food products.
126724.risks: Potential mild allergen or sensitizer in sensitive individuals, contains trace amounts of cyanogenic glycosides in raw parts but not in processed flower products

127020.name: Arôme naturel de citron vert
127020.description: Natural lime flavoring, typically composed of volatile compounds extracted from lime; used to provide citrus aroma and taste.
127020.benefits: Enhances flavor, natural source of aroma compounds
127020.risks: Possible skin or respiratory sensitization in susceptible individuals, depending on specific constituents

127197.name: Apă minerală naturală
127197.description: Naturally sourced mineral water, used as a base liquid providing hydration and minerals.

127222.name: Acidity Regulators (Ins 330, Ins 331(III), Ins 296, Ins 327)
127222.description: Food additives used to control acidity and pH in products. Includes Citric acid (Ins 330), Sodium tartrate (Ins 331(III)), Malic acid (Ins 296), and Calcium lactate (Ins 327).
127222.benefits: Maintain product stability, preserve flavor, control microbial growth
127222.risks: Irritation risk at high concentrations, dental erosion potential with acids

127241.name: Natuurlijk fruitaroma
127241.description: Flavoring derived from natural fruit sources used to enhance taste in foods and beverages.
127241.benefits: Flavor enhancement at low use levels
127241.risks: Potential allergen, possible synthetic solvent residues, ultra-processed ingredient

127242.name: Zoetstof
127242.description: Non-sugar sweetener substance used to provide sweetness with fewer calories than sugar.
127242.benefits: Sweetness without added calories, aids sugar reduction
127242.risks: Depends on type, some linked to gastrointestinal effects and metabolic changes

127243.name: B8 en B12
127243.description: Vitamins B8 (Inositol) and B12 (Cobalamin) involved in cellular metabolism and neurological function.
127243.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, nervous system maintenance
127243.risks: Rare adverse effects with excess vitamin B12 including acneiform eruptions

127244.name: Zuurstof
127244.description: Oxygen gas essential for cellular respiration, commonly used in food packaging and medical applications.
127244.benefits: Supports aerobic metabolism, preserves freshness under controlled use
127244.risks: Oxidative instability in foods, inhalation toxicity at high concentrations or pressure

127909.name: Flavourings [Antioxidant (Ascorbic Acid)]
127909.description: Flavoring components stabilized with ascorbic acid (vitamin C) as an antioxidant to prevent oxidation and prolong shelf life.
127909.benefits: Antioxidant, prevents flavor oxidation, enhances shelf life
127909.risks: Irritation possible at high concentration, sensitization rare

128503.name: Butter Caramel 4% (Glucose-Fructose Syrup, Sweetened Condensed Milk, Salted Butter (Milk), Water, Stabiliser: Pectin)
128503.description: A confectionery ingredient blend consisting mainly of glucose-fructose syrup, condensed milk, butter, water, and pectin used as stabilizer and flavoring agent.
128503.benefits: Provides sweet flavor, contributes to texture and mouthfeel in food products
128503.risks: Contains high levels of free sugars (glucose-fructose syrup), dairy allergens, potential risk from excessive sugar intake

129009.name: Sauerungsmittel (Citronensäure)
129009.description: Citric acid, a weak organic acid used as an acidulant and preservative in food and beverages.
129009.risks: Irritant in high concentrations, possible mild skin or mucous membrane irritation

129422.name: Kullsyre
129422.description: Kullsyre is the Norwegian and Danish term for carbonic acid, commonly produced by dissolving carbon dioxide in water, resulting in carbonated water.
129422.benefits: Provides effervescence, enhances sensory experience of beverages

129589.name: Konzentrat aus Schwarzer Johannisbeere
129589.description: Concentrate derived from black currant fruits, primarily used as a flavoring or nutritional additive.
129589.benefits: Source of vitamin C, antioxidants, and flavonoids

129936.name: Added sugars
129936.description: Sugars added to food products during processing to enhance sweetness and palatability.
129936.risks: Excessive intake associated with weight gain, dental caries, increased risk of type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease

130037.name: Sodio
130037.description: An essential mineral (sodium) important for fluid balance and nerve signaling.
130037.benefits: Supports electrolyte balance, nerve and muscle function
130037.risks: Excessive intake associated with hypertension and cardiovascular disease

130496.name: Savanyúságot szabályozó anyag: citromsav
130496.description: Citric acid used to control acidity and preserve freshness in food products.

130616.name: Sodium Salts of Citric Acid
130616.description: Inorganic salts derived from citric acid, commonly used as chelating agents and pH buffering agents in cleaning products. Typically include trisodium citrate and disodium citrate.
130616.benefits: Effective chelating agent, pH buffer, biodegradable, enhances cleaning efficacy
130616.risks: Minimal skin irritation at high concentrations, rare eye irritation

130926.name: Magnezyum Karbonat
130926.description: Magnesium carbonate is a magnesium salt commonly used as an antacid and dietary magnesium supplement.

131927.name: Stabilizator: guar guma
131927.description: Guar gum is a polysaccharide used as a stabilizer and thickening agent in food and pharmaceuticals.
131927.benefits: Improves texture and stability in formulations, acts as a soluble dietary fiber
131927.risks: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort or allergic reactions in sensitive individuals

132379.name: Sodium sulfate and/or Sodium chloride
132379.description: Inorganic salts commonly used as bulking agents, fillers, or abrasives in various products including detergents and cosmetics.
132379.benefits: Function as fillers and bulking agents, inexpensive and widely available
132379.risks: Irritant at high concentrations, drying to skin, none at typical use levels in rinse-off products

133540.name: Methylcobalamin [Vitamin B12]
133540.description: A biologically active form of vitamin B12 that acts as a coenzyme in DNA synthesis and neurological function.
133540.benefits: Essential coenzyme for red blood cell formation, DNA synthesis, and neurological health
133540.risks: Allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, rare cases of acneiform eruptions

135633.name: Polyoxymethylene
135633.description: Thermoplastic polymer known for high stiffness, low friction, and excellent dimensional stability, used in precision parts and engineering applications.
135633.benefits: High mechanical strength, low wear, chemical resistance, useful in durable components
135633.risks: Risk of formaldehyde release upon degradation, potential irritation on skin or mucous membranes from formaldehyde exposure, low inherent toxicity when stable, inhalation hazard minimal under normal use

135867.name: Australian Mineral Water
135867.description: Naturally sourced water from Australia containing dissolved minerals such as calcium, magnesium, and bicarbonates. Used primarily for hydration and mineral replenishment.
135867.benefits: Hydration, source of essential minerals like calcium and magnesium

136313.name: EDTA-Calcium Disodium [to Protect Flavor & Color]
136313.description: A chelating agent used to bind metal ions, preventing spoilage and discoloration in foods by protecting flavor and color.
136313.benefits: Enhances product stability by preventing oxidation and discoloration
136313.risks: Possible minor gastrointestinal effects when consumed in large amounts; limited absorption reduces toxicity

136436.name: Natural flavor and carob bean gum
136436.description: Natural flavor is a complex mixture of aroma compounds from natural sources; carob bean gum is a polysaccharide used as a thickener and stabilizer.
136436.benefits: Enhances flavor complexity; carob bean gum improves texture and stability of products
136436.risks: Natural flavors may contain trace allergens or solvents; carob bean gum may cause digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals

136509.name: Sodium hydroxide (sugar-derived)
136509.description: Inorganic alkaline compound used as a strong base and pH adjuster in cleaning products. Derived from salt via electrolysis.
136509.benefits: Effective pH adjuster, grease and fat saponification, essential for cleaning efficacy
136509.risks: Severe skin and eye irritation, chemical burns, respiratory irritation if inhaled as dust or mist

136561.name: Potassium Sorbate (E302)
136561.description: Potassium sorbate is a potassium salt of sorbic acid used as a preservative to inhibit mold, yeast, and fungi in food and cosmetic products.
136561.benefits: Effective antimicrobial preservative, extends shelf life of products
136561.risks: Irritation to skin and eyes at high concentrations, possible hypersensitivity reactions, minor sensitizer

136849.name: Mikan Juice
136849.description: Juice extracted from Mikan, a type of citrus fruit similar to mandarin orange, commonly consumed as a beverage or flavoring.
136849.benefits: Source of vitamin C and antioxidants, provides hydration, natural flavoring agent
136849.risks: Potential for oral irritation in sensitive individuals, possible pesticide residues depending on cultivation, high natural sugar content

137102.name: Less than 0.5% incidental non-recycled fiber
137102.description: A minor component of fiber materials included incidentally at less than 0.5%, sourced from non-recycled origins; likely used as filler or structural agent in materials.

137152.name: Sucralose [1.65mg per 50g]
137152.description: Sucralose is a synthetic non-nutritive sweetener used to provide sweetness without calories at low doses.
137152.benefits: Zero-calorie sweetener, helps reduce sugar intake
137152.risks: May alter gut microbiota at high doses, minor potential for digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals

137154.name: Steviol Glycosides [from Stevia Leaf Extract]
137154.description: Sweetening compounds extracted from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant, used as non-caloric sweeteners.
137154.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, supports blood sugar management by reducing caloric intake
137154.risks: Possible allergenicity in sensitive individuals, potential mild digestive effects at high intake

137235.name: Polyether
137235.description: Polyether is a class of polymers characterized by ether (–O–) linkages; used in plastics, coatings, and various industrial applications.
137235.benefits: Provides flexibility, chemical resistance, and durability in material formulations
137235.risks: Potential for skin irritation or sensitization upon dermal contact, inhalation hazards possible during processing as dust or vapor, contamination risk depends on impurities

137836.name: Reb A (Stevia Leaf Extract)
137836.description: Reb A (Rebaudioside A) is a purified steviol glycoside extracted from the leaves of the Stevia rebaudiana plant, used as a high-intensity, non-nutritive sweetener.
137836.benefits: Non-caloric sweetener, does not raise blood glucose levels, suitable for diabetic and weight management diets
137836.risks: Possible mild gastrointestinal discomfort at high doses, rare allergic reactions

137843.name: Beta-Carotene, Lutein, Lycopene Oleoresin from Tomatoes
137843.description: Oleoresin extracted from tomatoes containing carotenoids beta-carotene, lutein, and lycopene, used primarily as a natural colorant and antioxidant source.
137843.benefits: Antioxidant properties, natural colorant, source of provitamin A and carotenoids supporting eye health
137843.risks: Irritation potential, photosensitivity at high doses, minimal allergenicity

137889.name: Herbal tea leaves
137889.description: Plant leaves used in infusions excluding Camellia sinensis, varying widely by plant species and composition.
137889.benefits: Varied bioactive compounds providing aroma and flavor
137889.risks: Variable depending on species; potential for allergies or mild irritant reactions; limited data for general category

137895.name: Sodium acid
137895.description: Term is incomplete; possibly refers to sodium acid salts such as sodium acid pyrophosphate or sodium acid sulfate, which are used as leavening agents or pH adjusters.
137895.benefits: Function as leavening agents, pH regulators, or preservatives depending on specific compound
137895.risks: Depends on specific sodium acid compound; some may cause mild irritation, excessive intake linked to electrolyte imbalance

138786.name: Lait partiellement écrémé reconstitué
138786.description: Partially skimmed reconstituted milk made by rehydrating skimmed milk powder with water, typically contains around 90% milk solids.
138786.benefits: Source of calcium, protein, vitamins (especially B vitamins), and minerals important for nutrition
138786.risks: Lactose intolerance in sensitive individuals, potential microbial contamination if improperly processed or stored

138816.name: D-Calcium Pantothenate [Source of Vitamin B5]
138816.description: Supplemental form of pantothenic acid (vitamin B5), essential for coenzyme A synthesis and energy metabolism.
138816.benefits: Supports energy metabolism, skin health, and synthesis of fatty acids
138816.risks: None at typical supplemental doses; very high intake may cause mild gastrointestinal upset

139205.name: Extracto de té blanco
139205.description: Extract derived from white tea leaves, containing polyphenols and antioxidants commonly used for flavor and purported antioxidant properties.
139205.benefits: Contains antioxidants, may contribute mild flavoring and antioxidant effects when ingested
139205.risks: Potential skin sensitization in topical use, caffeine content with stimulatory effects in ingestion, possible interaction with medications

139229.name: 2% or Less of: Natural and Artificial Pistachio Flavor
139229.description: Flavoring agents used to impart pistachio taste; natural flavors are derived from pistachio or other sources, artificial flavors are synthesized chemicals.
139229.risks: Potential for allergic reactions, sensitization, presence of synthetic chemicals in artificial flavors, ultra-processed nature

139358.name: Sparkling Mountain Spring Water
139358.description: Carbonated water sourced from mountain springs, containing dissolved minerals and carbon dioxide for effervescence.
139358.benefits: Hydration, mineral content, alternative to sugary beverages

139426.name: 26g Og, Cholest
139426.description: Not a distinct ingredient, appears to be a notation referring to cholesterol amount (26 grams) which is not a food ingredient but a nutritional component metric.

139641.name: Caramel Pieces (4.5%) [Sugar]
139641.description: Sugar that has been heated until it undergoes caramelization, leading to a brown color and distinct flavor. Used primarily as a sweetener and for color/flavor in foods.
139641.risks: High sugar content, excessive intake linked to dental caries and metabolic disorders, potential formation of acrylamide and other heat-induced compounds during caramelization

140462.name: Glycerolesters van houthars
140462.description: Esters formed from glycerol and wood resin acids, used as additives or emulsifiers. The ingredient contains a source of phenylalanine, an amino acid relevant for phenylketonuria patients.
140462.benefits: Emulsifying and stabilizing properties in formulations
140462.risks: Contains phenylalanine, potential allergen or irritant depending on exposure, possible sensitization

140588.name: Sweeteners
140588.description: Various substances used to provide sweet taste, including natural and artificial compounds. The exact composition at 18% is unspecified.
140588.benefits: Provide sweetness and palatability, can reduce calorie content when replacing sugar
140588.risks: Potential metabolic effects depending on type, risk varies widely; artificial sweeteners may carry mild to moderate concerns including possible effects on gut microbiota; excessive intake of caloric sweeteners linked to obesity and related diseases

140859.name: Fruit juices from concentrate (26%) (orange, blood orange (5%), lime)
140859.description: Reconstituted fruit juices derived from concentrated extracts of orange, blood orange, and lime. Used primarily for flavoring and providing natural sweetness and acidity in beverages and foods.
140859.benefits: Source of natural flavor compounds, provides some vitamins such as vitamin C, contributes to palatability
140859.risks: Contains natural sugars, may contribute to caloric intake, potential for dental erosion with excessive consumption

141945.name: Folna kiselina
141945.description: Folic acid, a synthetic form of vitamin B9 used for supplementation and food fortification to prevent folate deficiency.
141945.benefits: Supports DNA synthesis, cell division, and prevention of neural tube defects
141945.risks: Excessive intake may mask vitamin B12 deficiency and delay diagnosis; generally safe at recommended doses

141969.name: Carbon Dioxide (min. 3.0 g/L)
141969.description: A colorless, odorless gas used primarily for carbonation in beverages.
141969.benefits: Provides carbonation and sensory enhancement in beverages
141969.risks: None at typical beverage carbonation levels

142061.name: Sodium benzoate (0.01%) as a preservative
142061.description: A preservative commonly used to inhibit microbial growth in acidic foods and beverages.
142061.benefits: Effective preservative, prolongs shelf life by inhibiting bacteria and fungi
142061.risks: Potential irritant in high concentrations, may form benzene in presence of ascorbic acid under heat/light, limited concerns at approved use levels

142626.name: Edulcorante E951
142626.description: Aspartame, an artificial sweetener used to provide sweetness with low caloric content.
142626.risks: Possible intolerance/allergic reactions in phenylketonuria patients, moderate controversy on safety although approved by major regulators

143176.name: Lemon Flavouring
143176.description: A mixture of natural and/or synthetic compounds used to impart lemon aroma and taste in food products.
143176.benefits: Provides lemon aroma and taste, enhances flavor profile
143176.risks: Sensitization/irritation potential in sensitive individuals, may contain synthetic additives or contaminants depending on source

143225.name: Apfelsaft aus Apfelsaftkonzentrat (60%)
143225.description: Apple juice made from 60% apple juice concentrate, used as a beverage or ingredient for flavor and sweetness.
143225.benefits: Source of hydration, contains some vitamins and antioxidants from apples
143225.risks: High sugar content, potential for dental caries, limited nutrient density compared to whole fruit

143239.name: Specific Gravity: 0.81
143239.description: Specific gravity is a physical property indicating the ratio of the density of a substance to the density of water. It is not a chemical ingredient but a measurement that can help identify or characterize a substance.

143801.name: Acesulfame-K [E950]
143801.description: Artificial high-intensity sweetener used as a sugar substitute in food and beverages. Approximately 200 times sweeter than sucrose.
143801.benefits: Calorie-free sweetening agent, stable under heat and pH variations, useful for weight management and glycemic control
143801.risks: Potential toxicity at high doses in animal studies, possible gastrointestinal discomfort at excess intake, minimal evidence of carcinogenicity in humans

143926.name: Çilek
143926.description: Strawberry fruit, commonly consumed fresh or processed. Source of dietary fiber, vitamins (notably vitamin C), and polyphenols.
143926.benefits: Nutrient-rich fruit providing vitamin C, antioxidants, dietary fiber, may support overall nutritional quality
143926.risks: Low risk, potential mild allergen or irritant in sensitive individuals

144416.name: Sukraloz
144416.description: Artificial sweetener derived from sucrose by chlorination, non-nutritive and intensely sweet, used to replace sugar in food and beverages.
144416.risks: Potential gut microbiota alteration, mild digestive intolerance in sensitive individuals

144685.name: Arômes naturels de citron avec autres arômes naturels
144685.description: A flavoring syrup composed of natural lemon flavor combined with other natural flavors, typically used to impart lemon taste in foods/beverages.
144685.benefits: Provides lemon flavoring, enhances sensory appeal of products
144685.risks: Possible allergenicity or sensitization from complex natural extracts, lack of detailed composition transparency, potential minor irritation in sensitive individuals

146439.name: Rougemont Mellow Doux Smooth Low Acid 100% Pure Apple Juice from Concentrate Vitamin C Added No Sugar Added Canada Choice
146439.description: Apple juice from concentrate with added vitamin C, labeled low acid and no added sugar. Typically consumed as a beverage providing sugars and vitamin C.
146439.benefits: Source of vitamin C, provides hydration, natural fruit-derived nutrients
146439.risks: High natural sugar content, potential contribution to dental caries, excessive consumption may impact blood sugar levels

146721.name: Concentrated Orange Juice
146721.description: Fruit juice concentrate derived from oranges, used primarily for flavoring and sweetening in food products.
146721.benefits: Source of vitamin C and natural flavoring compounds
146721.risks: High sugar content, potential allergen for citrus-sensitive individuals

146723.name: Concentrated Grape Juice
146723.description: Concentrated fruit juices derived from grapes and/or pears, concentrated to reduce water content for flavoring or sweetening in foods and beverages.
146723.benefits: Natural flavoring, source of some vitamins and antioxidants depending on processing, provides sweetness
146723.risks: High sugar content, potential for contribution to excessive caloric intake and dental caries

146864.name: Agua mineral natural
146864.description: Natural mineral water containing dissolved minerals and trace elements, sourced from underground springs.
146864.benefits: Hydration, source of minerals such as calcium and magnesium

147299.name: Bicarbonate de potassium
147299.description: Potassium bicarbonate is a salt used primarily as a leavening agent in food, as well as a buffering and acid neutralizing agent.
147299.benefits: Functions as a leavening agent, acid regulator, and electrolyte source
147299.risks: Excessive intake can cause electrolyte imbalance, hyperkalemia in sensitive individuals

147345.name: Carbon Dioxide (at least 0.3%)
147345.description: Carbon dioxide is a colorless gas commonly added to beverages for carbonation and as a propellant.
147345.benefits: Provides carbonation in beverages, acts as a preservative by reducing pH and microbial growth

147366.name: Peppermint-Lemon-Cucumber Natural Flavor
147366.description: A proprietary blend of flavor compounds derived from peppermint, lemon, and cucumber sources.
147366.risks: Potential allergen or sensitizer depending on composition; lack of transparency on exact constituents

148111.name: Renk (kurkumin)
148111.description: Curcumin is a natural polyphenolic compound found in turmeric, used primarily as a colorant and flavoring agent.
148111.risks: Irritation at high doses, potential allergen

148320.name: Bruisend natuurlijk mineraalwater
148320.description: Naturally carbonated mineral water containing dissolved minerals and carbon dioxide gas.
148320.benefits: Hydration, source of minerals, natural carbonation

148414.name: Colorant (Rouge Allura)
148414.description: Synthetic azo dye used as a red food and cosmetic colorant.
148414.benefits: Colorant to enhance appearance of food and cosmetic products
148414.risks: Allergic reactions, hypersensitivity, potential hyperactivity in children, regulatory limits on usage concentration

148855.name: Natural Color (Paprika Oleoresins)
148855.description: A blend typically consisting of a carrier oil infused with paprika oleoresin, which contains natural pigments and flavor compounds from Capsicum annuum. Used primarily as a colorant and flavoring agent in foods.
148855.benefits: Natural coloring, flavor enhancement, contains carotenoids which have antioxidant properties
148855.risks: Irritation and sensitization potential due to capsaicin content, possible allergenicity, contamination risk depending on source purity

149224.name: Süßungs Antioxidationsmittel: Ascorbinsäure
149224.description: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) used as antioxidant and sweetening agent to preserve freshness and improve taste.
149224.benefits: Antioxidant preventing oxidation, nutrient (vitamin C) contribution, flavor enhancer
149224.risks: Rare allergic reactions, generally safe at food additive levels

149322.name: Kiwi 1%
149322.description: Edible fruit rich in vitamin C, dietary fiber, and actinidin enzyme.
149322.benefits: Source of vitamin C, antioxidants, dietary fiber
149322.risks: High allergenic potential, can cause oral allergy syndrome and contact dermatitis

149440.name: Additifs alimentaires (BPF): CO2 agent de carbonatation
149440.description: Carbon dioxide used as a food additive primarily for carbonation of beverages to create effervescence.
149440.benefits: Provides carbonation and effervescence to beverages

149504.name: Asitlik düzenleyici (sitrik asit)
149504.description: Citric acid used as an acidity regulator to adjust pH in foods and beverages.
149504.benefits: Stabilizes pH, enhances flavor, and prolongs shelf life by preventing microbial growth
149504.risks: Low risk irritant at high concentrations, minimal concern at typical use levels

149838.name: Stabilizers E339 (Sodium phosphates) and E452 (Polyphosphates)
149838.description: Inorganic salts used as emulsifiers, sequestrants, and texturizers in food products to improve texture and moisture retention.
149838.benefits: Improves food texture, enhances moisture retention, acts as emulsifier and stabilizer
149838.risks: Excessive consumption may disrupt mineral absorption (e.g., calcium, magnesium), potential gastrointestinal irritation, contributes to dietary phosphorus load

150887.name: Orangensaft aus Orangensaftkonzentrat
150887.description: Orange juice made from concentrated orange juice; a reconstituted fruit juice product primarily composed of water, sugars, vitamins, and phytonutrients.
150887.benefits: Source of vitamin C, antioxidants, hydration, provides natural sugars and micronutrients
150887.risks: High natural sugar content, potential dental erosion with excessive consumption, possible loss of some heat-sensitive vitamins during concentration

151446.name: Pomelo Juice Concentrate
151446.description: Concentrated juice derived from pomelo fruit, containing natural sugars, acids, vitamins, and phytochemicals. Used primarily for flavoring and nutritional content.
151446.benefits: Source of vitamin C, antioxidants, and phytochemicals, provides natural flavor and sweetness
151446.risks: High sugar content may contribute to excessive caloric intake or dental erosion if consumed in large amounts, potential allergic reactions in sensitive individuals

151735.name: Vitamin B6; natürliches Citrusaroma
151735.description: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) is a water-soluble vitamin involved in amino acid metabolism; natural citrus aroma is a complex mixture of volatile compounds used for flavoring.
151735.benefits: Vitamin B6 supports nervous system function and metabolism; citrus aroma provides flavor enhancement
151735.risks: Vitamin B6 in excess can cause sensory neuropathy; natural citrus aroma may cause sensitization in sensitive individuals

151852.name: Apfelsaft aus Apfelsaftkonzentrat (3 %)
151852.description: Apple juice made from concentrate, used as a flavoring and sweetening ingredient in beverages.
151852.benefits: Source of natural sugars, provides flavor and some micronutrients
151852.risks: High sugar content, potential for dental caries, energy-dense

151932.name: Doğal Renklendirici (Beta Karoten)
151932.description: Natural coloring agent derived from beta-carotene, a carotenoid that provides orange-yellow color to foods.
151932.benefits: Provides color, precursor of vitamin A with antioxidant properties
151932.risks: Potential irritant or sensitizer in high concentrations, minimal concern at typical food use levels

152282.name: Vegetable Juice Concentrate [Color]
152282.description: Concentrated juice derived from various vegetables used primarily as a natural coloring agent in foods.
152282.benefits: Provides natural color, minimal nutritional contribution

153100.name: Antioxidants (E300)
153100.description: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C), used as an antioxidant to prevent oxidation and extend shelf life of products.
153100.benefits: Prevents oxidation, preserves product quality, essential nutrient
153100.risks: Low risk at typical use levels; rare skin irritation or hypersensitivity possible

153125.name: Natürliches Mineralwasser mit Kohlensäure
153125.description: Natural mineral water with added carbon dioxide for carbonation. Consumed as a beverage for hydration.
153125.benefits: Hydration, source of minerals depending on source water

153437.name: Correcteur d'acidité (E 331)
153437.description: Sodium citrate, an acidity regulator used to maintain pH in foods.
153437.risks: Rare hypersensitivity possible; generally safe for consumption

154268.name: Natural Colours (Safflower and Lemon)
154268.description: Color additives derived from safflower petals and lemon peel used to impart natural yellow to orange hues in foods and beverages.
154268.benefits: Provides natural coloring without synthetic dyes, improves product appearance
154268.risks: Potential minor sensitization in sensitive individuals, generally low risk at typical exposure levels

154856.name: Correcteur d'acidité (citrates de sodium)
154856.description: Sodium citrate used as an acidity regulator in food products to control pH and improve stability and taste.
154856.benefits: Improves food stability and taste by regulating acidity
154856.risks: Excess sodium intake can contribute to hypertension in sensitive individuals

155287.name: C20-40 Acid/Polyethylene
155287.description: A synthetic polymer formed from long-chain fatty acids (C20-40) and polyethylene used as a film-forming agent or emollient in cosmetic formulations.
155287.benefits: Provides texture modification, emollient properties, and film formation in cosmetic products
155287.risks: None at typical topical use levels, low irritation potential

155774.name: Polysulfone
155774.description: A high-performance thermoplastic polymer known for thermal stability, chemical resistance, and mechanical strength, commonly used in medical devices, membranes, and filtration applications.
155774.benefits: High chemical and thermal resistance, mechanical durability, biocompatibility enabling medical use
155774.risks: Potential skin irritation from dust or particles, inhalation toxicity risk if airborne particles generated during processing, no significant ingestion toxicity as it is not used as food additive

155801.name: Ugljični dioksid
155801.description: Carbon dioxide used as a gas for carbonation in beverages and as a preservative under modified atmosphere.
155801.benefits: Carbonation enhances sensory profile and preserves freshness
155801.risks: None at typical beverage levels; rare risk of gas embolism if improperly handled industrially

156459.name: Edulcorantes aspartamo y acesulfamo K
156459.description: Artificial sweeteners aspartame and acesulfame potassium used to provide sweetness without calories.
156459.benefits: Low-calorie sweetening to reduce sugar intake
156459.risks: Controversial metabolic effects, possible headache or hypersensitivity in susceptible individuals

156601.name: Dextrine résistante [fibre de maïs soluble]
156601.description: Resistant dextrin is a soluble dietary fiber derived from corn starch, used to increase fiber content and improve gut health.
156601.benefits: Improves digestive health by supporting beneficial gut bacteria, soluble fiber source
156601.risks: Potential gastrointestinal discomfort at high doses

157518.name: Curcuma
157518.description: Plant-derived spice from turmeric root, used primarily for flavoring and coloring in foods.
157518.benefits: Culinary flavoring and coloring, contains curcuminoids with antioxidant properties
157518.risks: Rare allergic reactions, possible minor gastrointestinal irritation at high doses

158041.name: Local naturally carbonated spring water
158041.description: Water sourced from natural springs containing dissolved carbon dioxide, resulting in natural effervescence.
158041.benefits: Hydration, natural carbonation without added CO2

158055.name: INS 330 (Citric Acid)
158055.description: A weak organic acid commonly used as a preservative, flavoring agent, and pH adjuster in food products.
158055.benefits: Enhances flavor, preserves food by inhibiting microbial growth, regulates acidity
158055.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, potential dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption

158256.name: Natürliches schwarzes Johannisbeer-Aroma mit anderen natürlichen Aromen
158256.description: Natural black currant flavor combined with other natural flavors, may contain trace amounts of egg residues.
158256.risks: Potential allergen presence (egg), possible variability in composition, lack of full ingredient disclosure

158780.name: Extrait d'orange
158780.description: Orange extract is obtained from orange peel or juice; commonly used as flavoring.
158780.risks: Potential for phototoxicity and skin sensitization, mild allergen

158966.name: CALCIUM DISODIUM EDTA (TO PRESERVE FRESHNESS)
158966.description: A chelating agent used as a preservative to bind metal ions and prevent oxidation in food products.
158966.benefits: Prevents metal-catalyzed oxidation, extends product shelf life
158966.risks: Minor irritation risk at high doses, generally recognized as safe at approved usage levels

159112.name: Calcium (naturally occurring)
159112.description: Essential mineral required for bone structure, muscle function, and nerve signaling.
159112.benefits: Supports bone health, muscle contraction, nerve transmission, blood clotting
159112.risks: Excessive intake may cause gastrointestinal discomfort, kidney stones in susceptible individuals

159527.name: Aromas naturais
159527.description: Natural flavorings derived from plant or animal sources used to impart flavor to food products.
159527.benefits: Provide flavor enhancement with sensory appeal
159527.risks: Potential allergenicity depending on source, possible trace solvent residues depending on extraction

159908.name: Expanded Rice
159908.description: Rice grains that have been puffed or expanded by heat or pressure, commonly used as a snack or cereal ingredient.
159908.benefits: Low calorie, gluten-free carbohydrate source, easily digestible
159908.risks: Low nutrient density compared to whole rice, potential ingestion choking hazard in children

160169.name: Acidity regulator [330]
160169.description: Citric acid, used as an acidity regulator and preservative in foods.
160169.risks: Possible minor irritation if consumed in excess

160648.name: Surhedsregulerende middel (E 331)
160648.description: Sodium citrate, used as an acidity regulator and emulsifier in foods and beverages.
160648.benefits: Regulates acidity and improves taste and stability of food products
160648.risks: Generally low toxicity; excessive intake can cause gastrointestinal discomfort

160993.name: Concentré de jus de grenade
160993.description: Concentrated pomegranate juice derived from the fruit Punica granatum, primarily used as a flavoring and colorant in food products.
160993.benefits: Contains antioxidants, source of vitamins and bioactive compounds
160993.risks: Possible allergenicity in sensitive individuals, high sugar content if consumed in large amounts

162037.name: Eau minerale naturelle
162037.description: Natural mineral water obtained from underground sources, containing minerals and trace elements.
162037.benefits: Source of hydration, provides minerals and trace elements

162231.name: Mangosaft aus Mangosaftkonzentrat
162231.description: Mango juice from mango juice concentrate, primarily a source of natural sugars, vitamins, and antioxidants.
162231.benefits: Source of vitamin C and antioxidants, natural flavoring and sweetness
162231.risks: High sugar content, potential allergen for sensitive individuals

162362.name: Electrolytes (potassium bicarbonate, calcium chloride, magnesium chloride)
162362.description: Electrolytes are minerals that conduct electricity when dissolved in water, essential for maintaining fluid balance, nerve transmission, and muscle function. Potassium bicarbonate acts as a potassium source and pH buffer; calcium chloride supplies calcium for physiological roles; magnesium chloride provides magnesium necessary for enzymatic processes.
162362.benefits: Supports hydration, nerve and muscle function, acid-base balance
162362.risks: Excessive intake may cause electrolyte imbalance, gastrointestinal irritation, hyperkalemia or hypercalcemia in sensitive individuals

162387.name: Geliermittel: Pektine; Säuerungsmittel: Citronensäure
162387.description: Citric acid as acidulant and maltodextrin as carbohydrate additive and bulking agent.
162387.benefits: Citric acid imparts sourness and preserves; maltodextrin provides texture and energy
162387.risks: Citric acid may cause mild irritation in sensitive individuals; maltodextrin excessive intake linked to glycemic impact

162913.name: Fruit pectin natural flavors
162913.description: Natural polysaccharides extracted from fruit cell walls used as gelling agents in food products.
162913.benefits: Dietary fiber source, gelling and thickening agent, aids texture and stability in foods

162988.name: Acidifiants: acide citrique et acide ascorbique
162988.description: Acidifying agents used to adjust pH and preserve food products; citric acid is naturally occurring in citrus fruits, ascorbic acid is vitamin C with antioxidant properties.
162988.benefits: pH regulation, antioxidant properties (ascorbic acid), preservation
162988.risks: Potential minor oral irritation at high concentrations
